jobs.description: We're hiring recent graduates and early-career engineers who build on their own initiative, teach themselves what they need, and already work AI-native. You'll work directly with our CTO and founding team on voice interfaces, agents running at scale, and a product that's changing how enterprises learn about their customers. The bar is high. From your first weeks you'll own real problems, decide how to solve them, and ship the result to customers. We care far more about what you've built on your own than about where you've worked. ABOUT KEPLAR Keplar is an AI-powered market research platform that lets companies run qualitative research at quantitative scale. Using voice AI and agentic analysis, Keplar holds natural conversations with hundreds of customers at once, turning months of research into insights within hours. Our mission is to help every business grow by being customer-obsessed. Founded in 2022 and backed by Kleiner Perkins, SV Angel, Common Metal, and South Park Commons, Keplar serves global brands including Clorox, P&G, Comcast, and Atlassian. Customer understanding is a critical but underserved part of business, and it shapes how iconic brands innovate, market, and position themselves. WHY KEPLAR - Ownership from day one. You'll own problems, not tickets. You spec, build, and ship to customers like Clorox, P&G, and Comcast, and see how they use it. - A high bar, high growth. You’ll work and learn alongside teammates who have built at Google Research, Meta, and fast-paced startups. - AI-native by default. We build with AI coding tools every day. You'll shape how the team works with agents, not follow a playbook. - Problems at the frontier. Live voice AI, agent orchestration, generative UI, and more. - Small team, wide scope. There's no one to hand problems off to, and no ceiling on how much you can own. WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON - Product features, end-to-end: Take features from design through production. - Our voice agent platform: Contribute to the pipelines behind live, one-on-one AI-led customer conversations. - Agent-led UX: Much of Keplar is used by talking to an agent. You'll help build and test new interfaces, including generative UI. - Our data model: Change schemas and write migrations as data moves between our API, voice pipeline, and agent services. Interview and customer data is sensitive, and you'll be trusted to handle it carefully. - Customers: Join customer and growth conversations and bring what you learn back into the roadmap. - What you'll work with: TypeScript and Node.js, PostgreSQL, cloud-hosted services, agent frameworks, LLM and speech APIs, and AI coding tools like Claude Code. WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR We hire for ability and drive, not years of experience. The bar is high. We measure it by what you've built and how you learn. - You don't wait to be told. You find the problem, dig for context, and make the call. Some calls will be wrong, and you own the fix when they are. - You build on your own. You've made things nobody assigned you: side projects, tools for yourself or friends, hackathon builds you kept working on afterwards. You care whether people use it, not about technical purity. - You already build with AI. AI coding tools are part of how you work today. You know where they're great and where they go wrong. You read and understand what they produce, and you stand behind what ships under your name. - You teach yourself. You have formal CS training and have gone beyond it on your own. You’ve recently picked up something new, like a language, framework, or problem area, and you can explain how you did it. - You keep momentum. You ship often, finish what you start, and keep pulling on a problem past the first answer. You'd rather show a working version than describe one. WHAT YOU BRING TO THE INTERVIEW - Something you built and shipped on your own that you can walk us through in detail: what you decided, what broke, and what you'd change. This could be a side project, hackathon build, or internship work all count. Bonus if it's a voice or chat agent. - Working knowledge of voice/chat agents: You can explain how it works under the hood: the LLM and speech APIs behind it, how it manages conversation state and tool calls, and where it breaks. - Working knowledge of full-stack web and data schema design. - Your own way of building with AI tools, and clear opinions on where they help and where they don't. - Bonus: you've gone in-depth on agent building, worked with real-time voice (speech-to-text, text-to-speech, turn-taking), or worked on a small team or at a startup. COMPENSATION AND LOCATION - Compensation: Full-time role with competitive salary and meaningful early-stage equity. - Location: This role is remote for now. Candidates must live in Toronto, Waterloo, or a nearby city, and be able to work in person with the team from time to time. Please only apply through Ashby.

jobs.description: About the Role Hopper powers travel for some of the world’s largest banks, airlines and travel companies, and our Research team builds travel-specialized models. As a Forward Deployed AI Engineer you take that work into a partner’s environment and make it theirs: building the evaluation with their team, preparing their data, training and evaluating the model, and putting it into production where it delivers measurable results. You work in a small forward-deployed team as the person who leads model training on site, across servicing, loyalty, commerce and more, and you are the bridge between our partners and Research. What would your day-to-day look like - Work with a partner’s data and business teams to turn their real tasks into a frozen, held-out benchmark across their priority use cases - Define what success means for each task, covering task completion, policy adherence, cost and response time, and build the automated graders with human spot checks - Establish baselines so results can be compared fairly - Prepare training data inside the partner’s environment through extraction, redaction, deduplication, labelling and train/test splits, using only the data the agreed tasks need - Run post-training in partnership with Research, applying modern fine-tuning methods to partner use cases - Run training on the partner’s cloud and GPUs, or in an environment they approve, under their security and access rules - Design experiments that show partners clearly what drives the results - Take models from evaluation into production based on evidence, then monitor quality, latency and cost once they are live - Use production results to keep improving the model - Present results, method and trade-offs to partner data and technology leaders, and defend them - Work closely with Research, feeding back what you learn in the field - Turn each deployment into reusable tooling so the next partner goes faster - Uphold strict data handling, privacy and security standards in every partner environment, and support partner model-risk, security and compliance reviews with clear documentation of data, training and evaluation An ideal candidate has - Run the full post-training loop end to end themselves, from data preparation through fine-tuning an open-weight model, evaluation and serving, rather than only calling a vendor’s fine-tuning service - Working experience with supervised fine-tuning and at least one of preference optimization or reinforcement learning, including parameter-efficient methods such as LoRA - Experience in travel or travel-adjacent financial services: airlines, hotels, OTAs, metasearch, travel technology, or bank travel and loyalty programs. - You understand how travel actually works behind the scenes: bookings, changes, refunds, disruptions and loyalty, and why they're hard. - Strong Python and command of the standard training stack, for example PyTorch, Hugging Face and vLLM, with comfort running jobs on rented or customer GPUs - Built benchmarks and graders from messy real-world data and used them to show that one model beats another on quality, cost and latency - A habit of thinking in held-out sets, baselines and ablations, and can explain a result’s limits as clearly as its headline - At least two deployments embedded with an enterprise customer, working inside their systems, data controls and security reviews - Confidence presenting to and pushing back on senior customer stakeholders, including data and technology leaders - Strong data engineering skills across SQL, HTS, pipelines, PII handling and redaction - An understanding of the privacy, security and model-risk requirements of regulated customers such as banks and airlines - Bonus: forward-deployed, applied research or applied AI experience at an AI-native company that trains its own models for a domain - Bonus: multilingual training and evaluation, or experience with travel, airline or banking systems and data such as PSS, GDS, NDC, ticketing, loyalty and contact-centre data - Bonus: experience with agent systems and tool use, or working alongside a research team to turn their methods into results at a customer - Willingness to travel and spend multi-week stretches on site with partners, plus a base in the Eastern or Central time zone with daily overlap across the partner and Research teams you work with Perks and benefits of working with us - Well-funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary and upsides of pre-IPO equity packages - Hopper covers 100% of the premiums for group insurance plan - Hopper offers life, short term and long term disability coverage - HSA that covers eligible medical and dental expenses - All employees and dependents have access to Dialogue’s telemedicine services, anytime, anywhere - All employees have access to an RRSP plan with automatic pre-tax withdrawals per pay - Please ask us about our very generous parental leave, much above industry standards! - Unlimited PTO - Carrot Cash travel stipend - Access to co-working space on demand through FlexDesk AND Work-from-home stipend - Entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business - Open communication with management and company leadership - Small, dynamic teams = massive impact About Hopper At Hopper, we’re building the leading travel technology platform in the world, and we’re doing it by solving real problems for real travelers globally. Our Hopper consumer booking platforms and HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), our B2B business, work together to give travelers something the industry has never reliably offered: transparency, flexibility, and real savings on every trip. We combine massive amounts of data and AI with proprietary fintech products to make that happen, not just another booking engine, but a fundamentally better way to plan and experience travel for our customers and our partners. We are proof that better-for-the-customer and better-for-the-business can be one in the same And we’re continuing to grow fast! The Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times, with 70% of our users being Gen Z and Millennials, next-generation travelers. Today, our biggest opportunity is powering travel fintech, commerce, and loyalty for some of the biggest brands in the industry. Our first HTS partnership with Capital One helped launch a dedicated travel portal for a major financial brand’s cardholders, and we’ve since expanded across some of the biggest names in travel and banking, including Air Canada, Uber, Royal Bank of Canada (RBC), and Nubank, powering everything from a single fintech integration to a full end-to-end travel loyalty portal. That’s our trajectory: we started as a small, disruptive app within the travel space, and now we’re the engine under the hood powering how Travel Tech works. What that looks like in practice: - Billions of dollars in travel and travel fintech move through Hopper and HTS every year. - Our fintech products, including Cancel for Any Reason and Disruption Assistance for Any Reason, post exceptionally strong customer satisfaction because the terms are clear and resolutions are instant, no questions asked. - Nearly 30% of app customers add a fintech product to their booking, and those customers are 1.6x more likely to book with us again. - HTS now drives more than 90% of the business, proof of how fast B2B has scaled. - Through HTS, any travel provider (airlines, hotels, banks, travel agencies) can plug the company’s fintech, commerce and AI solutions into their own channels, whether that’s a single integration or a full end-to-end travel portal. jobs.description: ABOUT JUNIPER SQUARE Private markets are one of the largest, most complex, and most underserved corners of global finance. Our mission at Juniper Square is to unlock their full potential. We’re the Operations Partner trusted by 2,300+ GPs, unifying technology, data, and fund administration services into a single platform that helps GPs move faster, make better decisions, and scale with precision. With $300B+ under administration and 700,000+ LPs on platform, we’ve built the scale to match our ambition. And with JunieAI, our purpose-built AI platform, we’re reimagining how private markets operate, embedding intelligence across every workflow. Founder-led since 2014, backed by $350M+ in funding, and now 1,000+ employees strong, we’re building a company designed to shape the future of private markets for decades to come. Our culture is built for people who want to do ambitious, meaningful work alongside exceptionally talented teammates. We think like owners, move with urgency, and take pride in solving hard problems that truly matter to our customers and the future of private markets. We believe the best ideas come from open debate, deep collaboration, and diverse perspectives, which is why we believe transparency is the default and feedback makes us stronger. If you’re energized by high standards, rapid growth, and the opportunity to help define a category at a pivotal moment, come join us! Juniper Square offers employees a variety of ways to work, ranging from a fully remote experience to working full-time in one of our physical offices. We invest heavily in digital-first https://blog.junipersquare.com/juniper-square-ponders-future-of-office-with-digital-first-hybrid-workplace-strategy/ operations, allowing our teams to collaborate effectively across 27 U.S. states, 2 Canadian Provinces, India, Luxembourg, and England. We also have physical offices in San Francisco, New York City, Mumbai and Bangalore for employees who prefer to work in an office some or all of the time. ABOUT YOUR ROLE Juniper Square is the system of record for private-capital funds. We move LP capital, hold investor data our customers are legally responsible for, and enforce the boundaries that keep one fund’s information away from another’s. As Senior Director, Security Engineering, you will report to the Head of Security and build the engineering half of a sustainable security function. You will own and operate Cloud Security, Infrastructure Security, and Core Security Engineering, growing them from a small group of senior engineers into multiple teams with managers and technical leads. The foundation is in place: a CNAPP on AWS, Cloudflare Zero Trust, Google SecOps, CrowdStrike, and external attack surface management. The mandate now is to turn that foundation into an owned, measured program that protects a platform institutional investors diligence before they sign and audit after. WHAT YOU’LL DO - Set the multi-year strategy and roadmap for Cloud Security, Infrastructure Security, and Core Security Engineering, and deliver it through a team you build: hire, develop, and lead managers and staff-level engineers across North America and India. - Own security architecture for our AWS and Kubernetes platform, including cloud posture and runtime protection, network security (IDS/IPS, egress controls, AWS Network Firewall), identity and secrets management, and zero-trust architecture developed with our Security Operations and IT teams. - Build the core security engineering platform: security tooling, automation, detections-as-code pipelines, telemetry coverage mapped to MITRE ATT&CK, and the AI security framework and MCP gateway controls that govern AI and LLM systems in use at Juniper Square. - Act as the Tier 3 technical escalation point alongside Security Operations for critical incidents, and drive engineering remediation of cloud, infrastructure, and software supply-chain risk (SBOM, build integrity, ephemeral-workload visibility) with Application Security and SRE. - Establish metrics that reflect real security posture (coverage, exposure, time to remediate, control effectiveness) and report them to executive leadership, auditors, and customers in support of SOC 2 and ISO 27001, 27017, 27018, and 42001. - Embed security into platform design and delivery with Engineering, SRE, IT, GRC, and Legal, and own vendor relationships and budget for the security engineering toolchain. QUALIFICATIONS - 12+ years in information security, including 6+ years leading security engineering teams and experience building a function and managing managers. - Hands-on depth in cloud security (AWS required; Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, CNAPP/CSPM), network security, and identity and secrets architecture, with the ability to review designs and code with senior engineers. - Track record of taking a security program from tool deployment to an owned, measured operation: defining metrics, SLAs, and risk-acceptance processes and making them stick across an engineering organization. - Experience securing AI and LLM systems and agentic workflows, and using AI to change how a security team works. - Experience in a regulated or fintech environment with SOC 2 and ISO 27001 obligations and institutional customer security diligence. - Demonstrated ability to work across Engineering, IT, and compliance functions and to communicate risk and trade-offs to executives and board audiences. - Bachelor’s degree in a technical field or equivalent experience. At Juniper Square, we believe building a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture makes us a better company. If you think this job sounds like a fit, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all the qualifications. COMPENSATION Compensation for this position includes a base salary, bonus, equity, and a variety of benefits. The U.S. base salary range for this role is $260,000 - $325,000 USD. Actual base salaries will be based on candidate-specific factors, including experience, skillset, and location, and local minimum pay requirements as applicable. À quoi ressemblera votre quotidien - Travailler avec les équipes de données et d’affaires du partenaire pour transformer ses tâches réelles en un banc d’essai figé et réservé, couvrant ses cas d’usage prioritaires - Établir des références afin que les résultats puissent être comparés équitablement - Préparer les données d’entraînement dans l’environnement du partenaire par extraction, caviardage, déduplication, étiquetage et répartition entraînement/test, en utilisant uniquement les données nécessaires aux tâches convenues - Concevoir des expériences qui montrent clairement aux partenaires ce qui détermine les résultats - Faire passer les modèles de l’évaluation à la production sur la base de preuves, puis surveiller la qualité, la latence et le coût une fois en service - Collaborer étroitement avec l’équipe de Recherche en lui transmettant ce que vous apprenez sur le terrain - Transformer chaque déploiement en outils réutilisables afin que le prochain partenaire avance plus vite - Maintenir des normes strictes de traitement des données, de confidentialité et de sécurité dans chaque environnement partenaire, et appuyer les examens de risque lié aux modèles, de sécurité et de conformité du partenaire avec une documentation claire des données, de l’entraînement et de l’évaluation Le ou la candidat(e) idéal(e) possède - jobs.description: WHO WE ARE AeroVect is transforming ground handling with autonomy, redefining how airlines and ground service providers around the globe run day-to-day operations. We are a Series A company backed by top-tier venture capital investors in aviation and autonomous driving. Our customers include some of the world’s largest airlines and ground handling providers. For more information, visit www.aerovect.com http://www.aerovect.com. We are looking for an experienced Senior Software Engineer who can design and build best-in-class behavior planning systems for autonomous driving in structured, low-speed environments. In this role, you'll own the design and implementation of key modules in the behavior planner — the decision-making layer that determines what the vehicle should do in complex, dynamic airside scenarios. You'll work at the intersection of mission-level goals and motion-level execution, tackling problems in multi-agent interaction modeling, rule-based and learned decision-making, and robust handling of edge cases unique to airport ground operations. This opportunity offers a deeply technical engineer the chance to shape a market-defining enterprise product that combines autonomous vehicle technology with a robotics-as-a-service (RaaS) business model. This role reports to our Planning Tech Lead and works closely with the autonomy engineering team. YOU WILL - Develop and implement advanced behavior planning algorithms for autonomous vehicles - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure robust integration and functionality of planning systems - Design, write, and maintain efficient and scalable code in C++ and Python - Contribute to the architecture and continuous improvement of behavior planning software - Conduct extensive testing in simulated environments and real-world scenarios to validate and refine behavior planning algorithms - Analyze system performance and implement enhancements based on data and feedback - Maintain comprehensive documentation of code, algorithms, and system designs - Work closely with other engineering teams to ensure seamless coordination and development YOU HAVE - Proficient in modern C++ (11/14/17) and object-oriented programming - Skilled in Python for rapid prototyping and testing - Strong in debugging, profiling, and optimizing code - Deep understanding of behavior planning algorithms such as state machines, behavior trees, and probabilistic planning - Familiarity with path planning algorithms like A*, RRT, or optimization-based methods - Master’s degree in Computer Science, Robotics, or a related field - Minimum of 3 years of industry experience in autonomous driving, robotics, or a related field WE PREFER - Knowledge of state machines, behavior trees, and decision-making under uncertainty - Expertise in path planning algorithms such as A*, D*, and Rapidly-exploring Random Trees (RRT) - Knowledge of machine learning techniques, especially in the context of behavior prediction and planning - Experience with ROS / ROS2 - Implementing systems that can re-plan at high frequencies to adapt to dynamic changes in the environment - Ensuring that behavior planning algorithms can execute with minimal latency for real-time navigation - Proficiency in optimization techniques and probabilistic models for making informed planning decisions under uncertainty - Master’s degree or PhD in Robotics, AI, Mathematics, or a related field with a focus on planning, optimization, or control theory is a plus

jobs.description: ABOUT THE TEAM The Integrations Ecosystem org builds the drivers, SDKs, connectors and BI integrations that make ClickHouse feel native in any stack. The Language Clients team maintains the official clients for Python, JavaScript, Java, Go, Rust, C++ and C#, plus the ODBC, JDBC and ADBC drivers. We're small, senior and remote across North America and EMEA. THE ROLE We're looking for a product-minded engineer to own ClickHouse's Go clients. You'll decide what the clients should do by talking to the developers who use them, reading the issues and the telemetry, and listening to the community. Then you'll build it, with deep Go expertise, and measure whether it worked. Your scope is the SDK and what builds on it: clickhouse-go and ch-go, and the collectors, pipelines, agents and tools that write millions of rows per second through your code. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Know who uses the clients and what they're trying to do. Define what good looks like (time to first query, error clarity, throughput, adoption by key integrations), measure it, and let that drive the roadmap. - Be the voice of ClickHouse for Go developers. Speak at GopherCon and Go meetups, and write the posts, tutorials and examples that developers and AI assistants find when they search for how to use ClickHouse from Go (SEO and GEO). Answer questions where the community asks them. - Own the Go clients and their ecosystem: clickhouse-go, ch-go, database/sql, releases and support. Evolve them without breaking the people who depend on them. - Keep the clients the fastest Go option for the fastest analytical database, and make sure the client is never the bottleneck. Performance is part of every release, not an afterthought: profile, change, measure again, catch regressions in CI, and publish the numbers. - Partner with the projects built on the clients, from the OpenTelemetry Collector to ClickHouse Grafana datasource and ClickPipes, and catch their regressions before they ship. - Review and co-maintain other clients, and take part in cross-client decisions on types, errors and protocol features. - Bring written proposals about where we invest next. You set direction rather than wait for it. - Make the clients enterprise-ready: TLS and mTLS, cloud authentication, safe credential handling, vulnerability response, a small dependency footprint, and the questions large Go shops ask before they adopt. - Shape the clients for agents as users: an API, docs and error messages an AI coding agent can use correctly on the first try. - Extend our AI development platform, with new workflows for maintaining the clients: consistency checks across languages, issue triage, release checks. ABOUT YOU - Product-minded with a bias for action. You'd rather run an experiment and bring back data than wait for approval, you measure whether it worked, and you can explain what you chose not to build. - 5+ years in software, much of it on data-intensive systems: drivers, SDKs, ingestion, streaming, observability or analytics. - Deep Go expertise: the runtime and garbage collector, escape analysis, the memory model, pprof and the execution tracer. You reason about throughput and latency down to allocations and bytes on the wire, and you prove it with tests and benchmarks. - Strong Go concurrency instincts: context, goroutines and channels, bounded pools, backpressure, clean shutdown, and the leaks and races that come with each. - Beyond Go, productive in at least one more of our client languages (Python, JavaScript, Java, Rust, C++, C#). You'll review and co-own across clients. - You've built or substantially extended a Go module other engineers depend on. You understand semantic import versioning and treat breaking changes accordingly. - Strong grasp of database fundamentals: SQL, query execution and analytical workloads. Judgment about when to use database/sql and when to drop down to the protocol. - Enthusiastic about working in public. You've given talks or written technical content, or you're keen to, and you see it as part of the job rather than a distraction from it. - Thoughtful use of AI development tools, with the judgment to review what comes out. - Clear writing. Most coordination happens in design docs, PRs and RFCs. NICE TO HAVE - ClickHouse, especially its type system and native format, or another columnar or OLAP engine. - Contributions to Go data or observability infrastructure: OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Kafka clients, database drivers. - Building or maintaining a database/sql driver. - Apache Arrow or ADBC in Go. - Experience designing SDKs, docs or error messages with AI coding agents as the consumer. - Protocol or wire-format work on a database driver or network client. LEARN MORE - clickhouse-go on GitHub https://github.com/ClickHouse/clickhouse-go and ch-go on GitHub https://github.com/ClickHouse/ch-go - ClickHouse Go client documentation https://clickhouse.com/docs/integrations/language-clients/go - Chasing that 32 ms tail latency in ClickHouse https://clickhouse.com/blog/chasing-32ms-tail-latency-clickhouse PERKS - Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. jobs.description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.</p></div><p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p>Join Affirm as a Machine Learning Engineering Manager and lead our Commerce Optimization Machine Learning team. You will manage a team of ML engineers that builds and scales models, simulations, and optimization systems to improve how Affirm’s products are configured and offered. Under your guidance, the team will develop reusable user behavior models that power applications across Affirm, from personalized experiences and targeted incentives to consumer engagement and growth.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>In this role, you will help shape the future of machine learning at Affirm, partnering with engineering, product, and risk leaders to design, implement, and scale advanced ML solutions that drive critical capabilities across the company. jobs.description: MaintainX is a leading mobile-first work execution platform for industrial and frontline teams. More than 15,000 customers, including McDonalds, Michaels, Cintas, Redimix, and U.S. LBM, use MaintainX to cut unplanned downtime and run better operations, across 16 million managed assets and 92 million completed work orders. In August 2026 MaintainX became part of Autodesk, joining Autodesk Operations Solutions https://adsknews.autodesk.com/en/views/inside-autodesk-operations-solutions/, the organization unifying Autodesk's operations platform alongside Tandem, FlexSim and Fusion Operations. Autodesk's strategy is to converge design, make and operate into one continuous lifecycle: design an asset, build it, run it, then feed what you learn running it back into the next design. Autodesk had design and make. Operate is the phase that tells you what actually happened, and it is ours. ABOUT THE ROLE: Remote (Toronto or Montreal) As a Principal Engineer on the Quality Platform team, you'll build the shared testing infrastructure, frameworks, and AI-assisted tooling that every engineering team at MaintainX relies on to ship quickly and confidently. Rather than owning testing for a single product area, you'll create the platform, developer experience, and automation that make high-quality software the default across the organization. You'll partner closely with product engineering teams, Quality Advocates, and SRE to improve developer productivity, increase release confidence, and help shape the future of AI-powered testing at MaintainX. WHAT YOU'LL DO: - Build and evolve MaintainX's shared quality platform, test automation frameworks, and developer tooling. - Design and develop AI-assisted test authoring infrastructure that significantly reduces test creation time while maintaining high quality. - Own CI integration standards and improve build reliability across engineering teams. - Design test harnesses for AI-powered product capabilities, including health checks, graceful degradation, quota monitoring, and adversarial testing. - Identify and eliminate systemic test debt and flaky tests before they impact engineering teams. - Build shared testing utilities and frameworks adopted across the engineering organization. - Partner with Quality Advocates, product engineering teams, and SRE to continuously improve testing strategy and platform reliability. - Evaluate emerging AI testing tools and drive adoption where they create measurable engineering impact. ABOUT YOU: - Strong software engineering fundamentals with experience writing, debugging, and maintaining production application code. - Hands-on experience building and maintaining production-grade test automation frameworks using Playwright, Selenium, or similar technologies. - Experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and diagnosing flaky or failing test suites. - Experience building or maintaining shared developer tooling, testing infrastructure, or engineering platforms — comfort with cloud infrastructure (e.g., AWS), containerized environments, and observability tooling (e.g., Datadog) is a plus. - Experience using AI development tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or similar to accelerate engineering workflows while applying sound engineering judgment. - Comfortable owning systems end-to-end, from architecture and implementation through production support. - Experience mentoring engineers and helping raise engineering quality across teams. - Strong spoken and written English, as you'll collaborate daily with engineering leaders and managers across multiple teams and present technical priorities to executive stakeholders. NICE TO HAVE: - Experience building test harnesses for AI-powered features, including health checks, circuit-breakers, adversarial testing, or resilience testing. - Experience building or maintaining autonomous or agentic AI systems. - Experience evaluating AI-powered developer tools and integrating them into engineering workflows. - Experience building observability and quality metrics into testing platforms. - Experience working with large-scale developer platforms supporting multiple engineering teams. Our mission is to keep the physical world running. Factories, fleets, hospitals and campuses stay up because the people who maintain them have tools worth using. That is what we build. jobs.description: WHO WE ARE AeroVect is transforming ground handling with autonomy, redefining how airlines and ground service providers around the globe run day-to-day operations. We are a Series A company backed by top-tier venture capital investors in aviation and autonomous driving. Our customers include some of the world’s largest airlines and ground handling providers. For more information, visit www.aerovect.com http://www.aerovect.com. As a Senior Data Engineer at AeroVect, you will design, build, and scale the data infrastructure powering our autonomous ground support equipment (AGSE) operations. As our fleet expands across airports, you'll be responsible for ensuring that large volumes of vehicle telemetry, sensor data, and operational data are reliably ingested, processed, stored, and made accessible to engineering and operational teams. You'll work at the intersection of autonomous systems, cloud infrastructure, and data engineering, building robust pipelines that transform real-world vehicle data into actionable insights. From processing data generated by autonomous tractors to enabling fleet performance monitoring and engineering analysis, your work will directly impact how we operate, improve, and scale our autonomous fleet. This is a hands-on engineering role in a fast-paced environment where you'll have significant ownership over data architecture, pipeline reliability, and infrastructure scalability. You'll collaborate closely with software, infrastructure, autonomy, and operations teams to build systems that support vehicles operating in live airport environments. YOU WILL - Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines to ingest, process, and store large volumes of autonomous vehicle telemetry, sensor, and operational data. - Develop and operate reliable batch and streaming data pipelines, supporting both near-real-time monitoring and historical analysis. - Build and optimize cloud-based data infrastructure using AWS and modern distributed data processing technologies. - Develop systems to move data reliably from edge devices and on-premise infrastructure into cloud-based storage and processing environments. - Design and maintain data models, schemas, and storage architectures that enable efficient querying, analytics, and downstream engineering workflows. - Ensure data quality, consistency, availability, and observability across production pipelines. - Optimize data processing performance, storage efficiency, and infrastructure costs as fleet size and data volumes increase. - Collaborate with autonomy, software, and infrastructure engineers to support debugging, performance analysis, and continuous improvement of autonomous vehicle systems. - Build tools and infrastructure that make data easily accessible to engineering, product, and fleet operations teams. - Take end-to-end ownership of data infrastructure, from architecture and implementation to deployment, monitoring, and production troubleshooting. YOU HAVE - 5+ years of experience in data engineering, software engineering, or distributed systems, with a strong focus on building production-grade data infrastructure. - Strong programming experience in Python and SQL. - Hands-on experience designing and operating large-scale batch and streaming data pipelines. - Strong experience with AWS services such as S3, Kinesis, Lambda, Glue, Redshift, or similar cloud-native data infrastructure. - Experience designing data architectures, storage solutions, and data models for high-volume, complex datasets. - Strong understanding of distributed systems, data reliability, fault tolerance, and performance optimization. - Experience deploying, monitoring, and troubleshooting data pipelines in production environments. - Familiarity with terraform and Kubernetes is preferred. - Ability to work independently, navigate ambiguity, and take ownership of complex technical problems. - Strong communication skills and experience collaborating across engineering teams. WE PREFER - Experience working with autonomous vehicles, robotics, automotive telemetry, IoT, or other sensor-heavy systems. - Experience processing large-scale time-series, image, video, or other unstructured datasets. - Familiarity with edge-to-cloud data ingestion architectures and intermittent-connectivity environments. - Experience with data lake architectures, GCP BigQuery and AWS Athena. - Experience building data infrastructure supporting machine learning, simulation, or robotics development workflows. - Knowledge of ROS, ROS bags, or autonomous vehicle data formats. - Experience building data platforms from the ground up in a startup or rapidly scaling engineering organization.

jobs.description: BUILDING THE FUTURE OF OPEN FINANCE Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients. We’re looking for a Senior Staff Product Designer to lead design for Krak and help us build a neobank people trust with their everyday money. This is a high-impact individual contributor role with responsibility for design across the product. You’ll set the direction for the Krak experience, influence product strategy, and stay close to the details through execution. We’re a hardworking team that moves fast and ships with purpose. We’re straight-talking, no-nonsense, and deeply invested in the quality of what we build. We care about craft, we care about our customers, and we care about getting things right. Building a neobank means earning people’s trust in the moments that matter: getting started, moving money, making a payment, or understanding what’s happened when something goes wrong. WE PREFER - Experience building backend systems for autonomous vehicles, robotics, teleoperations, or remote assistance platforms. - Experience working with vehicle telemetry, fleet management, or real-time operational monitoring systems. - Knowledge of video streaming technologies such as WebRTC, RTSP, or other low-latency media protocols. - Experience developing systems that operate across unreliable or bandwidth-constrained networks. - Familiarity with safety-critical systems, operational safeguards, and secure remote interactions with physical devices. - Experience with edge-to-cloud communication architectures. - Experience building dispatching, scheduling, or resource allocation systems. - Previous experience in a fast-paced startup environment, building products and infrastructure from the ground up.

jobs.description: About Intellistack At Intellistack, we're committed to revolutionizing the way organizations collect information, automate workflows, and create seamless digital experiences. Founded with the belief that work should be simplified, Intellistack has grown into a leading provider of powerful, no-code productivity solutions that help teams do more with less. Across thousands of organizations worldwide, our tools and platform empower users to quickly build custom forms, automate document generation, capture eSignatures, and streamline data-driven processes—all without needing to write a single line of code. With intuitive solutions that put power in the hands of everyday users, we make it easier to build, automate, and optimize processes at scale. Who We Are At Intellistack, we don’t do status quo. We move fast, think deep, and build what’s next—powered by people, supercharged by AI. We’re a team of builders: curious, driven, and relentless about solving the real problem. Around here, feedback is fuel, clarity wins, and change is the default setting. If you’re hungry to grow and ready to leave a dent, you’ll fit right in. WHO YOU ARE You’re a hands-on technical leader who has designed, shipped, and owned complex software systems in production. You understand that ownership extends beyond writing code: you’ve seen systems fail, led recovery, found root causes, and made lasting improvements. You bring clarity to ambiguous problems, balance immediate needs with long-term architecture, and influence teams through sound judgment rather than authority alone. WHAT YOU’LL DO - Set technical direction for critical areas of Intellistack’s platform. - Design and deliver scalable, reliable customer-facing systems. - Lead complex initiatives from discovery and architecture through launch and operation. - Own production outcomes, including reliability, observability, incident response, root-cause analysis, and long-term remediation. - Improve system performance, resilience, security, and maintainability. - Guide architectural decisions across services, APIs, data, and event-driven systems. - Partner with Product and Design to turn customer needs into thoughtful technical solutions. - Mentor engineers and raise engineering standards across teams. - Communicate technical decisions, risks, and tradeoffs to technical and non-technical audiences. WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR - Mastery of at least one object-oriented programming language (Java, Python, C#, etc) - 10+ years of progressive software-engineering experience, including technical leadership across multiple teams. - A strong record of owning production systems through design, launch, operation, failure, recovery, and improvement. - Experience designing distributed, event-driven, customer-facing systems at scale. - Strong knowledge of service architecture, APIs, data modeling, asynchronous processing, and event-driven design. - Production experience with Kafka or comparable messaging technologies. - Experience diagnosing difficult reliability and performance problems across complex systems. - Sound judgment when balancing delivery speed, system quality, customer experience, and long-term maintainability. - A record of leading architecture discussions and influencing technical direction across organizational boundaries. - Strong product thinking and the ability to understand problems from the customer’s perspective. - A strong record of communicating complex technical decisions to technical and non-technical audiences. - A hands-on leadership style and a commitment to mentoring other engineers. BONUS POINTS - Experience building or integrating AI-powered product capabilities. - Familiarity with large language models, agentic systems, RAG, LangChain, or LangGraph. - Experience with AI evaluation and observability platforms such as LangSmith, Arize Phoenix, Weights & Biases, or MLflow. - Experience with document intelligence, workflow automation, eSignature, or SaaS platforms. - Familiarity with cloud infrastructure, containers, Kubernetes, CI/CD, or infrastructure as code. - Contributions to open-source projects or technical communities. Why You’ll Love Working Here We move fast. We think deep. We build what’s next. At Intellistack, we're redefining how teams work—powered by people and accelerated by AI. We hire builders who embrace curiosity, move with urgency, and care deeply about outcomes. Here, you'll have the opportunity to shape products that solve meaningful customer problems while working alongside talented teammates who challenge and inspire you every day. We blend flexibility with connection to create a work environment where you can thrive. We offer: - Flexible PTO that empowers work-life balance - Health and wellness benefits that support you and your family - Professional development support, including a learning stipend to help you grow - A hybrid work model for Stackers in locations where we have office hubs (e.g.: Denver, Fishers and Krakow), with in-office collaboration Tuesday - Thursday and flexible hours to support your schedule - An inclusive, authentic community where your voice matters and you can be yourself We are a hybrid workforce with key hubs in Denver, Fishers (Indiana), Menlo Park, Los Angeles, Toronto, and Krakow, Poland. While some roles offer flexibility in location, others may require proximity to one of our hubs. Wherever you’re based, our approach is built on trust, collaboration, and doing what works best for our people and the business. SALARY RANGE CAD $245,000-$275,000 annually. Actual compensation may vary within this range based on skills and experience. Intellistack is an equal opportunity employer, passionately committed to equitable hiring and boldly dedicated to diversity in our work and teams. jobs.description: Why Join Doppel Doppel is building the future of social engineering defense. Our AI-native platform uses agentic AI to protect executives, employees, customers, and brands from phishing, impersonation, fraud, and other AI-powered threats across digital channels. We help some of the world’s most recognized brands detect and dismantle attacker infrastructure while strengthening employee resilience through threat-informed training and simulation. By unifying Digital Risk Protection, Human Risk Management and Email Security, Doppel connects threats into a real-time intelligence graph to power faster disruption, smarter defense, and modern security awareness at scale. Backed by leading investors including Andreessen Horowitz and Bessemer Venture Partners, and trusted by leading enterprises, Doppel is a rapidly growing Series C startup building the future of social engineering defense. Our team combines deep cybersecurity expertise, operational rigor, and startup velocity to solve some of the internet’s most urgent trust and safety challenges. What We're Building We're building the AI-native social engineering defense platform. This means we're designing scalable systems that monitor billions of domains, social media accounts, apps, dark web forums, etc., and leverage AI agents to identify and neutralize digital threats. What We're Looking For We’re hiring a Senior Data Scientist to help our internal teams make better decisions, starting with Go-to-Market (GTM). We’re looking for someone who is customer-obsessed, takes ownership, and turns complex data into clear recommendations. You’ll shape how we measure performance, identify opportunities, and build the data foundations and AI tools that help Doppel scale. You’ll join a rapidly growing company making the internet safer every day. What You’ll Do - Translate sales lifecycle analysis into actionable recommendations for GTM, Engineering, and the founders, identifying opportunities to improve conversion and grow ARR. - Establish the foundational standards for how GTM data is defined, modeled, and trusted, and build the pipelines that support reliable reporting and analysis. - Build and evaluate AI agents that identify data quality issues early and surface relevant insights to the teams that need them. - Communicate findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, connecting what the data shows to what we should do next. What You’ll Bring - 4+ years of experience in data analytics, data science, or a related field. - Strong proficiency in SQL, BigQuery, dbt, and Python, with familiarity with semantic layers and AI agent evaluation. - A solid understanding of data pipelines and modeling. - Experience partnering across Revenue Operations, Engineering, and non-technical teams to turn business questions into measurable outcomes. Experience with GCP infrastructure and infrastructure as code is a plus. If you’re excited about the role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification, we encourage you to apply. What We Offer 🚀 A mission-driven culture with low ego, high ownership, deep customer obsession, and exceptional talent density 🍽️ Free lunch and dinner in the office 🌴 Flexible PTO ✈️ Quarterly team offsites JOIN DOPPEL Doppel is the first platform built to dismantle digital deception at scale. We scan over 150 billion entities daily and deploy continuously adaptive AI SOC agents, paired with expert human analysts, to uncover and disrupt the infrastructure behind phishing, impersonation, and online fraud before attacks can spread. Our Threat Grid turns every customer signal into shared intelligence, making each disruption smarter, faster, and more effective. We’re not just another cybersecurity company. We’re defining the future of social engineering defense, where trust is protected, and deception becomes unprofitable. Backed by top-tier investors and trusted by some of the world’s most recognized brands, Doppel is growing fast. jobs.description: About Intellistack At Intellistack, we're committed to revolutionizing the way organizations collect information, automate workflows, and create seamless digital experiences. Founded with the belief that work should be simplified, Intellistack has grown into a leading provider of powerful, no-code productivity solutions that help teams do more with less. Across thousands of organizations worldwide, our tools and platform empower users to quickly build custom forms, automate document generation, capture eSignatures, and streamline data-driven processes—all without needing to write a single line of code. With intuitive solutions that put power in the hands of everyday users, we make it easier to build, automate, and optimize processes at scale. Who We Are At Intellistack, we don’t do status quo. This may include AI-assisted scheduling and candidate communications, and AI-generated interview notes, guides or summaries to help our team focus on the conversation. All hiring decisions are made by our hiring team. ABOUT THE ROLE Credit is becoming one of the most important ways Canadian businesses use Float — and you'll be the person who makes it work from the ground up. As Product Manager, Credit & Risk, you'll own how we grow our credit products while keeping the business safe from credit losses and fraud. The opportunity for scale and innovation is real and we need someone who is as comfortable owning a roadmap as they are being an operator at the lowest level of detail across data-centric and complex domains. You'll work with a dedicated engineering team, data scientists, and experienced credit and risk leaders, with real room to shape how this domain grows. WHAT YOU'LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR - Own prioritization for the Credit & Risk engineering team, balancing customer-facing credit work, risk and fraud controls, and internal tooling. - Dig into credit and risk data yourself to understand what's happening and decide what to do about it. - Turn customer and operational problems into clear, well-scoped work that engineers can run with. - Build and shape internal tools and workflows with our credit and risk operations teams so they can scale with the business. - Partner with data scientists on the models and systems that decide who gets credit and how we catch risk early. - Help Float grow its credit business responsibly — more customers and volume, without a matching rise in losses. WHAT YOU'LL BRING - 4+ years in product management, product operations, strategy & operations, or consulting followed by a hands-on operating role. - Strong data skills — you pull and analyze your own data (SQL or similar) and use it to make decisions. - Experience working closely with engineering teams to ship products or systems. - A track record of improving internal tools, workflows or operations, not only customer-facing features. - The ability to learn a complex domain quickly and connect dots across teams. - Composure under pressure and a steady presence in fast-moving, high-stakes environments. - Practical, measurable use of AI tools in your day-to-day work. - Bonus: experience in fintech, lending, payments, risk or fraud. THIS MAY NOT BE THE ROLE FOR YOU IF - You prefer setting vision from the top down over working in the details. - You want a role centred on writing specs and launching a new product every quarter. - You'd rather someone else pull the data and hand you the answer. - You're not comfortable making decisions with incomplete or messy information. - High-stakes, fast-moving environments drain you rather than energize you. OUR HIRING PHILOSOPHY We hire for character, curiosity, and learning velocity before credentials. Titles matter less than impact, and every hire is expected to raise the bar for Float as a whole. WHY YOU SHOULD JOIN - Be part of an award winning company: we're one of Canada’s Top Growing Companies 2026 according to Report on Business, and Deloitte’s Technology Fast50 2026 - Make a real impact in a high-autonomy, high-growth role - Collaborate with an ambitious and supportive team - Competitive compensation, equity options, and benefits - Hybrid work model: we are based in Toronto with in-office days for connection and collaboration - Enjoy catered team lunches every Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday - Bring your pup to our dog-friendly office - Thrive in a high-trust, high-performance culture where your work truly matters IN SHORT At Float, you’ll thrive if you’re bold, curious, and eager to make a real impact. We're building something special—and having a lot of fun along the way. If you’re excited to build, grow, and win together, we’d love to meet you. Protect yourself from recruiting scams. Float only contacts candidates from @floatfinancial.com http://floatfinancial.com addresses and schedules interviews through Ashby or Float calendar invites. We will never ask you to install software, pay a fee, buy equipment or share bank or card details. If something looks off, don't engage. We’re committed to building a workplace that’s welcoming and accessible for everyone. If you need any accommodations during the hiring process or once you join Float, just let us know! You can reach out to Vic https://www.linkedin.com/in/victoria-boult-b21b2053/ (victoria@floatfinancial.com), and we’ll work with you to make sure you have what you need to succeed.

jobs.description: Lazer https://www.lazertechnologies.com is a world-class digital product studio composed of 180+ senior engineers and designers with backgrounds from companies like Apple, Google, Coinbase, and more. With our product experience, we have designed, engineered, and grown products from $0 to $200M in revenue. Clients seek out our help because we have the talent to deeply understand their needs and provide industry, technical, or product insights that are uniquely valuable to their efforts. Our clients range from early-stage startups and venture studios to recognizable retail brands and exciting enterprises. Some of our notable clients include Google, Shopify, Coinbase, Alchemy, Hinge, OVO, Polymarket, and more. We are a remote-first organization headquartered in Toronto, Ontario, with employees worldwide. We believe in providing the best experience possible for all Lazerites by fostering a strong community through regular events, company vacations, competitive compensation, unlimited PTO, and more! Join Lazer and help us solve problems and build the next generation of products! WHO YOU ARE - Seniority: At least 5 years of dedicated experience in DevOps, infrastructure, or SRE roles. - Expert tooling: Expertise with Docker, Kubernetes, and Terraform or Pulumi. - Cloud proficiency: Deep, proven expertise in AWS, GCP, or Azure, with the ability to apply core infrastructure concepts across cloud providers. - AI-native engineer: AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or Copilot are a core part of how you work, not an experiment. You can point to infrastructure or tooling you shipped faster because of them, and you know where they need a human in the loop—or should not be used at all—including IAM policies, billing, state migrations, and changes affecting production. - Development skills: Strong ability to write clean, maintainable automation code in Go, Python, or Node.js. - Security focus: Demonstrable experience implementing and maintaining modern cloud security controls and meeting relevant compliance standards, such as SOC 2, PIPEDA, HIPAA, GDPR, or PCI. - Independent, proactive, and cross-functional: Proven ability to onboard quickly, diagnose problems, and propose and implement solutions with minimal oversight. Experience in a consulting or freelance capacity, with a track record of communicating effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders. WHAT YOU’LL DO - Infrastructure as Code: Implement and adapt infrastructure using Terraform, Pulumi, or other major IaC tools. - AI-accelerated delivery: Use agentic tools to write and review IaC, generate runbooks, triage incidents, and automate toil, with guardrails such as plan review, policy-as-code, and scoped credentials for agents. - Containers: Design, build, and optimize secure, multi-stage Dockerfiles. Deep Docker knowledge is critical. - CI/CD: Design, build, and manage robust pipelines that automate testing, building, and deployment across environments. - Core cloud services: Provision and manage foundational services in AWS, GCP, or Azure. Deep expertise in one major provider is required, along with the ability to transfer that knowledge to others. - Container compute: Run production workloads on container platforms such as Cloud Run, ECS, Fargate, EKS, GKE, or AKS. Exercise judgment in choosing the right platform based on cost, scale, and operational overhead. - Networking: Design secure networks using VPCs, subnetting, routing, NAT, peering, VPNs, and load balancers, with a clear sense of when each is needed. Kubernetes networking experience—including ingress controllers, egress gateways, network policies, and service meshes such as Istio or Linkerd—is a strong plus. - Managed services: Work with object storage, managed databases, serverless functions, CDNs, and message queues, using services such as S3, Cloud Storage, RDS, Cloud SQL, Lambda, and Cloud Functions. - LLM application infrastructure: Deploy and operate LLM-backed services on Bedrock, Vertex AI, or direct provider APIs such as Anthropic and OpenAI. Manage secrets and API keys, rate limits, quotas, token-spend controls, and observability for latency and failures. - Agent infrastructure: Host and secure MCP servers and sandboxed execution environments for AI agents. - Security: Protect PII through encryption, secrets management, network firewalls, and web application firewalls such as AWS WAF or GCP Cloud Armor. Address AI-specific risks, including prompt injection and controlling sensitive data sent to third-party model providers. - Automation and scripting: Write high-quality automation and tooling in Go, Python, Node.js, or Bash to solve client-specific operational challenges. - Monitoring and operations: Ensure robust monitoring using native cloud-provider tooling and maintain high system uptime. NICE TO HAVE - Model serving and compute: Experience with self-hosted inference using tools such as vLLM or KServe, GPU/TPU provisioning—including GKE accelerator configuration—and vector databases such as pgvector or Pinecone. Familiarity with enabling extensions through tools such as StackGres is a plus. - LLM observability: Experience with Langfuse, LangSmith, Datadog LLM Observability, or similar tools. - Multi-cloud experience: Hands-on experience across multiple cloud providers and products, such as AWS, GCP, Azure, or Cloudflare. - Certifications: AWS, GCP, or Claude Certified Architect certifications are a plus, but not mandatory. - Advanced monitoring: Experience with Prometheus, Datadog, or similar monitoring and logging stacks. - GitOps: Experience with Argo CD or Flux. - Service mesh: Experience with a service mesh or ingress gateway. AI in our hiring process We use AI to help us review and shortlist applications based on job-related criteria. A human hiring manager always makes the call on who moves forward. As a company that builds with AI every day, we're all for candidates using it too — just be upfront about how it helped. Why Work With Us - 🚀 Accelerate Your Growth: Work across multiple industries and cutting-edge projects with a team that ships fast. - 💥 Maximum Impact: Shape the future of the tech industry by helping ambitious projects reach their potential. - 🏅 True Ownership: Everyone ships code and has real autonomy with minimal meetings. - 💡 Continuous Learning: Be part of a team of senior engineers and designers who love learning and knowledge sharing. WHY THIS MIGHT NOT BE FOR YOU - 🤖 You Resist Modern Tools: We leverage AI and cutting-edge technology to build rapidly and focus our energy on solving the most complex, high-impact challenges for our clients. - 🏗️ You Crave High Structure: We thrive in an autonomous, fast-moving environment, which means you need to be comfortable with some ambiguity. - 😴 You Prefer Conventional Careers: Our consulting approach involves varied projects and direct client interaction — it's not for everyone. - 1️⃣ You Like Staying in One Lane: Our projects require adapting to different tech stacks and modern tooling quickly. BENEFITS & PERKS - 🌐 Work From Anywhere: Choose your workspace — all you need is strong wifi and a passion for building! - 🧘‍♂️ Work / Life Balance: We believe in our team’s ability to have it all; a great career, and time to unplug and live…you know...life. - 🩺 Employee Care: We provide full benefits (healthcare, dental, vision) for our employees (401k for our US employees) - 🏖️ Unlimited PTO: Everyone needs a break. Take at least 15 days off a year, and more if you need—just be cool about it and keep the team in mind. - 🎉 Regular Team Retreat: Join us for a week of team bonding at amazing destinations. Recent trips include the Dominican Republic, Cancun, and Hawaii — plus ones welcome.

jobs.description: About the role ClickHouse Private brings ClickHouse Cloud capabilities to Kubernetes environments controlled by customers, from managed Kubernetes in their AWS, GCP or Azure accounts to clusters running on other infrastructure they provide. Today, much of our work focuses on adapting Cloud technology so it can be deployed, upgraded and supported in these environments, including regulated and disconnected deployments. Our plans also include building software and platform capabilities specifically for ClickHouse Private, such as tools and interfaces for managing ClickHouse clusters. We will reuse Cloud components where they fit and build our own implementations where customer-controlled environments require a different approach. Depending on the deployment model, these components may run in ClickHouse-managed infrastructure, in customer environments, or across both. You will join a small product engineering team with broad ownership and real architectural influence. The role combines hands-on software development with deep Kubernetes and infrastructure knowledge, from designing production services to making them reliable to deploy, upgrade and support. WHAT WILL YOU DO? - Design and build backend services and platform capabilities for ClickHouse Private, combining reusable Cloud components with purpose-built implementations. - Adapt and integrate existing ClickHouse Cloud components for Kubernetes-based deployments in customer-controlled cloud and self-hosted environments. - Build and maintain what customers actually install: Helm charts, Kubernetes operators, and deployment tooling. - Make installation and upgrades boring: build preflight validation, deterministic tooling, health diagnostics, and safe recovery paths. - Build release automation: assemble tested sets of components, define supported upgrade paths, and make failures diagnosable. - Adapt deployments for regulated and network-restricted environments. - Work alongside support engineers on customer deployments and troubleshoot problems in customer-controlled environments. - Turn recurring customer requirements and deployment constraints into reusable product capabilities rather than one-off solutions. - Write the documentation and runbooks customers and our support teams rely on. ABOUT YOU - You have 5+ years of experience building and shipping production software, including infrastructure or platform systems. - You have strong Kubernetes experience, managed or self-hosted. You are comfortable with Helm and understand how operators and controllers work. - You write and maintain production software. Go experience is preferred; strong experience in another language is welcome if you are ready to work in Go. - You have experience with AWS, GCP, Azure, or an equivalent on-premises cloud platform, plus solid Linux and networking fundamentals. - You can debug unfamiliar distributed systems and infrastructure, including across boundaries you do not control. - You communicate clearly in design docs, pull requests, and conversations with support and customer engineers. - You make pragmatic trade-offs, deliver incrementally, and take ownership from design through a supportable release. NICE TO HAVE - Experience shipping software into environments you do not operate: customer sites, on-premises installations, self-hosted products, Kubernetes operators, CSI drivers, or object storage integrations. - Experience with ClickHouse, or with other databases. - Experience with regulated, security-sensitive, or air-gapped environments, including public-sector deployments. - Experience designing and running performance benchmarks for infrastructure or distributed systems. - Security-related experience: vulnerability management, image hardening, secrets management, and internal PKI. PERKS - Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries. - Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare. - Equity in the company - Every new eligible team member who joins our company receives equity. - Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries. - A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee. - Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites. CULTURE - WE ALL SHAPE IT As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture. Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here https://clickhouse.com/company/careers. Check out our blog posts https://clickhouse.com/blog or follow us on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/clickhouseinc/life/0c1ee7f4-2129-488d-b413-e7f6270659fd/?viewAsMember=true to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse. EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & PRIVACY ClickHouse provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type based on factors such as race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. Please see here https://clickhouse.com/legal/applicant-privacy-notice for our Privacy Statement.

jobs.description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.</p></div><p>Our team sits within Developer Productivity, whose mission is to make software development at Affirm simpler and faster across the company. The broader org owns much of the path between a developer’s laptop and production, including developer environments, CI/CD pipelines, test automation, dependency management, and release engineering, all in service of helping engineers ship code quickly, safely, and with confidence.</p> <p>The Continuous Delivery team’s charter is centered on enabling engineering teams to release independently through strong automation, standard patterns, predictable rollouts, resilient recovery mechanisms, and less manual toil. This role is uniquely positioned to help solve one of Affirm’s most important engineering challenges: scaling developer productivity in an era where the software development lifecycle is increasingly AI-enhanced. The team builds and improves the platforms, workflows, and guardrails that help engineers move from idea to production faster, with better safety, consistency, and developer experience.</p> <p>We value engineers who listen closely, invite feedback, and work well across organizational boundaries, while also holding a high bar for ownership, technical judgment, and follow-through. Strong candidates will care about building reliable shared systems, reducing friction for other engineers, and making durable improvements that raise the quality and speed of software delivery across Affirm.<br><br><br><strong>What You'll Do</strong></p> <ul> <li>You will be responsible for owning and delivering quarterly goals for your team, leading engineers on your team through ambiguity to solve open-ended problems, and ensuring that everyone is supported throughout delivery.</li> <li>You will support your peers and stakeholders in the product development lifecycle by collaborating with product management, design &amp; analytics by participating in ideation, articulating technical constraints, and partnering on decisions that properly consider risks and trade-offs.</li> <li>You will proactively identify project, process, technology or business issues, advocate for them, and lead in solving them.</li> <li>You will support the operations and availability of your team’s artifacts by creating and monitoring metrics, escalating when needed, and supporting “keep the lights on” &amp; on-call efforts.</li> <li>You will foster a culture of quality and ownership on your team by setting or improving code review and design standards for your team, and advocating for them beyond your team through your writing and tech talks.</li> <li>You will help develop talent on your team by providing feedback and guidance, and leading by example.</li> </ul> <p><br><strong>What We Look For</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have 4+ years of experience designing, developing and launching backend systems at scale using languages like Python or Kotlin.</li> <li>You have a track record of developing highly available distributed systems using technologies like AWS, MySQL and Kubernetes.</li> <li>You have experience building or evolving CI/CD, deployment, or release automation systems that reduce manual toil and improve rollout predictability, recovery, and auditability across many engineering teams</li> <li>You are comfortable working on shared developer infrastructure and defining clear platform interfaces, templates, or guardrails that make it easier for product teams to adopt standard deployment patterns with confidence.</li> <li>You have experience defining a technical plan for the delivery of a significant feature or system component with an elegant, simple and extensible design. You write high quality code that is easily understood and used by others.</li> <li>You are proficient at making significant changes in a large code base, and have developed a suite of tools and practices that enable you and your team to do so safely.</li> <li>Your experience demonstrates that you take ownership of your growth, proactively seeking feedback from your team, your manager, and your stakeholders.</li> <li>You have strong verbal and written communication skills that support effective collaboration with our global engineering team.<br>&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>Base Pay Grade - N<br>Equity Grade - 6</p> <p><br>Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.<br><br>Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents). In addition, the employees may be eligible for equity rewards offered by Affirm Holdings, Inc. (parent company).<br><br>CAN base pay range per year: $153,000 - $213,000 CAD.</p> <p>Location - Remote Canada</p> <p>This remote role is open only to candidates residing in Alberta, British Columbia, Manitoba, New Brunswick, Newfoundland and Labrador, Nova Scotia, Ontario, Prince Edward Island, or Saskatchewan.</p> <p>#LI-Remote</p><div class="content-conclusion"><div> <p><strong>Remote-first with flexibility built in</strong><strong><br></strong>Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.</p> <p><strong>Benefits designed for you</strong><strong><br></strong>Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:</p> <ul> <li>Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.</li> <li>Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.</li> <li>Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.</li> <li>Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.</li> </ul> <p>We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.</p> <p>For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.</p> </div> <div> <p>By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's&nbsp;<a href="https://www.affirm.com/global-candidate-privacy-notice" target="_blank">Global Candidate Privacy Notice</a> and consent to the use of your personal information as described.</p> </div></div>
