jobs.description: ABOUT JUNIPER SQUARE Private markets are one of the largest, most complex, and most underserved corners of global finance. Our mission at Juniper Square is to unlock their full potential. We’re the Operations Partner trusted by 2,300+ GPs, unifying technology, data, and fund administration services into a single platform that helps GPs move faster, make better decisions, and scale with precision. With $300B+ under administration and 700,000+ LPs on platform, we’ve built the scale to match our ambition. And with JunieAI, our purpose-built AI platform, we’re reimagining how private markets operate, embedding intelligence across every workflow. Founder-led since 2014, backed by $350M+ in funding, and now 1,000+ employees strong, we’re building a company designed to shape the future of private markets for decades to come. Our culture is built for people who want to do ambitious, meaningful work alongside exceptionally talented teammates. We think like owners, move with urgency, and take pride in solving hard problems that truly matter to our customers and the future of private markets. We believe the best ideas come from open debate, deep collaboration, and diverse perspectives, which is why we believe transparency is the default and feedback makes us stronger. If you’re energized by high standards, rapid growth, and the opportunity to help define a category at a pivotal moment, come join us! Juniper Square offers employees a variety of ways to work, ranging from a fully remote experience to working full-time in one of our physical offices. We invest heavily in digital-first https://blog.junipersquare.com/juniper-square-ponders-future-of-office-with-digital-first-hybrid-workplace-strategy/ operations, allowing our teams to collaborate effectively across 27 U.S. states, 2 Canadian Provinces, India, Luxembourg, and England. We also have physical offices in San Francisco, New York City, Mumbai and Bangalore for employees who prefer to work in an office some or all of the time. ABOUT YOUR ROLE We’re looking for a Lead Product Manager to build our agent factory. You’ll start by turning how fund administration gets done today into automated workflows, where agents, code and people each take the steps they do best, and then quickly extend the factory more broadly into Private Markets. About 60% of your time goes to the agent factory, starting with core fund administration workflows such as capital calls and fund onboarding. The other 40% goes to partnering with the product executive team on AI strategy and long-term vision, and shaping how we bring agentic solutions to market. You will also play a role in building our internal R&D factory where agents help us design, code, test and deploy our own software. The work is early and the problems are hard, and engineering will look to you to make the call on ambiguous tradeoffs. AI fluency is a baseline expectation: you should prototype with agents, build your own automations, and use AI to move 10x faster than a traditional PM. This role would benefit from in-person collaboration in San Francisco, where many of our product management, design, and engineering personnel are based, although we also welcome exceptional candidates from elsewhere in the United States and Canada. WHAT YOU’LL DO The agent factory (about 60%) - Build the agent factory: Build the factory that turns how private markets work gets done into automated workflows, where agents, code and people each take the steps they do best. - Start with fund administration: Ship core workflows such as capital calls and fund onboarding with our fund administration team, and prove the model in production. - Extend across private markets: Quickly take the factory beyond fund administration to workflows and users across the private markets. - Make each one faster: Turn what every workflow teaches us into reusable building blocks and connectors, so the next one is faster to build than the last. AI strategy and beyond (about 40%) - Shape AI strategy: Partner with the product executive team on AI strategy and long-term vision. - Bring agentic solutions to market: Shape how we bring agentic solutions to our customers. - Help build the R&D factory: Play a role in building our internal R&D factory, where agents help us design, code, test and deploy our own software. - Lead through influence: Set direction across teams and raise the bar for product craft. QUALIFICATIONS - 7+ years of product management experience in B2B or enterprise SaaS, including owning a technically complex product area from strategy through execution. - Exceptional talent with AI. You use LLMs, agents and AI tools (e.g. Claude, Cursor) to build prototypes, automations and your own agents, and to move 10x faster than a traditional PM. AI fluency matters to us more than years of product management experience. - An entrepreneurial attitude. You’re comfortable taking ambiguous problems from zero to one, and you act like an owner. - A strong technical thinker who can go deep on workflow orchestration, deterministic versus agentic steps, connectors, identity and auditability. - Exceptional written and verbal communication, and comfort explaining complex technical ideas to engineers, executives and clients. - A track record of leading through influence and setting strategy that multiple teams execute against. Preferred qualifications - Former founders strongly preferred. - Experience with managed agent platforms such as Claude Managed Agents. COMPENSATION Compensation for this position includes a base salary, equity, and a variety of benefits. The U.S. base salary range for this role is $180,000 - $265,000. Actual base salaries will be based on candidate-specific factors, including experience, skillset, and location, and local minimum pay requirements as applicable. Benefits include: - Health, dental, and vision care for you and your family - Life insurance - Mental wellness coverage - Fertility and growing family support - Flex Time Off in addition to company-paid holidays - Paid family leave, medical leave, and bereavement leave policies - Retirement saving plans - Allowance to customize your work and technology setup at home - Annual professional development stipend Your recruiter can provide additional details about compensation and benefits. #LI-Remote #LI-NY1 #experiencedprofessional #Juniper-US #Juniper-Canada

jobs.description: BUILDING THE FUTURE OF OPEN FINANCE Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system. THE TEAM Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients. Consumer Growth builds mobile and web experiences that help people become Kraken customers, fund their accounts, invest, earn, access new products, build wealth and stay lifelong clients. Product, engineering, design, data, and lifecycle marketing build together. THE OPPORTUNITY - Own growth in viral, KOL- and creator-referred new transacting users (NTUs). Set aggressive NTU targets backed by a credible growth model, then beat them. Build and scale sharing, referral, and creator systems that drive 10x, then 50x growth while hitting payback targets. - Build sharing people find useful. Create natural reasons to pass on product value, and referral programs with modeled payback incentives, and without relying on aggressive incentives to hit targets. Make both work for the sender, recipient, and business. - Own the audience-to-customer journey. Build and test paths from recommendations and creator audiences to product value and a first transaction. Partner with the teams that own onboarding and core product experiences on shared journeys. - Own Consumer features and updates for the KOL Platform. Set the Consumer roadmap, ship features and ongoing improvements, and make measurement and commercial tools trustworthy and easy to use. Work with the teams that own KOL and affiliate relationships. - Build creator tools across Kraken’s app and web. Help creators, key opinion leaders (KOLs), and power referrers invite their followers and turn their audiences into valuable new transacting customers. Understand their different motivations and build with core product teams. - Make acquisition economics work. Own acquisition cost and gross-margin payback against clear targets, including fully loaded incentive, partner, operating, and fraud costs. Use downstream retention and revenue to judge what deserves more investment. - Increase virality per new transacting user and per returning user. Test ways to improve send conversion, invites per sender, and invite-to-first-transaction conversion. Improve repeat sharing and loop speed, and prove the gains create incremental valuable new transacting customers. - Build measurement you can trust. Validate instrumentation, define hypotheses and guardrails, and run tests that can detect meaningful effects. Separate attributed activity from incremental growth, interpret uncertainty honestly, and check that gains persist as you scale. WHAT YOU BRING - You’ve personally built a product, tool, feature, or experience that spread beyond its initial audience. You can explain why it spread, your contribution, and how it acquired valuable customers. - Repeated success beating acquisition targets through referrals, product virality, or creator-led growth. Show the baseline, target, result, timeframe, component rates you improved, and your personal contribution. Bring evidence the gains lasted. - Strong growth product sense. You understand sharing psychology and the different motivations of customers, creators, KOLs, and power referrers. You combine customer research, creative product instincts, and strong UX and copy to give people a reason to participate. - Analytical independence. You independently investigate behavior with SQL and product analytics, validate instrumentation, and build funnel, cohort, and growth models. - Experimentation and commercial judgment. You design reliable tests, interpret uncertainty honestly, and distinguish attribution from incremental growth. You understand acquisition cost and payback, including downstream retention, revenue, and fully loaded incentive and fraud costs. - Senior ownership and hands-on execution. You set strategy, make hard priority calls, align teams without relying on reporting lines, and deliver autonomously. You use AI and working prototypes to turn original ideas into experiences people can try. NICE TO HAVES - Experience building self-service creator or affiliate tools, revenue-share systems, or reliable partner payouts. - Consumer fintech, crypto, payments, or experience designing financial promotions and fraud controls. - Experience adapting growth journeys across markets, cultures, and regulatory environments. Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. This is a hands-on role with real responsibility. ABOUT YOU 👩‍🚀 - Likely have 2-4 years of professional full-stack software development experience - You’re a heavy user of AI tools like Claude Code, Cursor or Codex - You stay up to date with the latest in AI, including new LLMs, agent frameworks, and tooling - You have strong product and design taste and a clear sense of what “good” looks like - You take ownership and are comfortable driving an entire part of a product - You manage your own time and priorities well - You’re happy moving across frontend and backend when needed - You communicate clearly and work well with others, especially when things are ambiguous - You’ve built and maintained production systems used by real users - You’re comfortable learning new tools and building things from scratch - Bonus: - Experience at early-stage startups or building your own products - Have heard of Animations.Dev http://Animations.Dev, Devouring Details https://devouringdetails.com/, or InterfaceCraft https://www.interfacecraft.dev/ WHY YOU MIGHT BE EXCITED ABOUT THIS OPPORTUNITY 🙌 - Ship real products that get real usage, from customer-facing features to internal tools - Work cross-functionally. jobs.description: BUILDING THE FUTURE OF OPEN FINANCE Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system. THE TEAM Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients. Kraken’s Core Infrastructure Engineering team builds and operates the shared data systems behind critical production services. Our estate spans on-premises and cloud infrastructure, with MariaDB at its centre and Kafka, Redis and Elasticsearch across the wider platform. We’re hiring a Principal Database Engineer to bring long-term experience and technical judgment to this estate. You’ll assess it, set the goals and direction, and work hands-on with the team to deliver measurable improvements. This is an individual contributor role with influence across teams and several quarters of work. THE OPPORTUNITY - Review the estate against business needs and production evidence. Judge reliability, scale, cost and operational complexity, identifying what should be preserved and where investment or simplification would make a difference. - Define the target architecture and measurable goals. Agree a prioritised roadmap with engineering leads and dependent teams, explaining the trade-offs and sequencing work around delivery risks. - Execute that roadmap with the team through design, implementation and adoption. Stay personally involved in difficult migrations and scaling decisions, with representative benchmarks, data-integrity checks and credible cutover and rollback plans. Adapt the plan as evidence changes and verify the results in production before calling the work complete. - Investigate difficult MariaDB failures and performance limits through the engine, storage and application behaviour. Improve fleet reliability through useful observability, safer changes and tested backup, restore and disaster recovery procedures. Set recovery objectives with service owners and prove them through exercises. - Build and maintain production software for database provisioning, upgrades and routine maintenance. Make self-service workflows safe and auditable, incorporating access controls and change evidence with Security and Compliance. - Work with application teams on schemas, transaction boundaries, queries and data-store choices. Make the operational consequences clear and resolve dependencies that span teams. - Mentor engineers across the team through design reviews, pairing and incident analysis. Help them deepen their database expertise and take ownership of technical decisions. - Participate in on-call and incident response, leaving clear operational ownership and following through on lessons from production. WHAT YOU BRING - 8+ years operating and evolving production database estates at scale. You have assessed inherited systems, set technical direction and delivered improvements with engineering teams, and can explain how those decisions held up over time. - Strong understanding of high availability, replication and distributed database failure modes. You can explain consistency and availability trade-offs and reason about transaction boundaries and reliable event delivery, including transactional outbox patterns. - Deep, recent hands-on MariaDB expertise, including InnoDB, MVCC and transaction isolation, locking, query optimisation, binary logs and MariaDB GTID replication. You can explain the mechanisms and diagnostic evidence behind your decisions. - Personal ownership of MariaDB incident diagnosis, performance tuning and tested restore or point-in-time recovery. You can explain what you did, how you established data integrity and what remained uncertain. - Strong software engineering skills in Python, Go, Rust or a comparable language. You have personally built and maintained production software or automation for database workflows such as provisioning, failover, online schema changes and self-service operations, using version control, code review and delivery pipelines, with tested failure handling. - Strong low-level Linux, Kernel, storage and networking fundamentals, with the ability to investigate problems beyond the database process. - Clear written technical judgment and demonstrated delivery across teams without reporting-line authority. You help stakeholders make sound database design and lifecycle decisions, and develop experienced engineers through shared delivery. NICE TO HAVES - Experience operating databases in containerised, hybrid on-premises/cloud or multi-region environments. Familiarity with Kubernetes, infrastructure as code or GitOps, including their operational trade-offs. - Experience with database proxies or load-balancing layers (MaxScale, HAProxy, ProxySQL, or similar). - Experience with PostgreSQL, Vitess, TiDB, ScyllaDB, ClickHouse or internal database platforms; operational knowledge of Kafka, Redis/Valkey or Elasticsearch/OpenSearch. - Experience in regulated environments or contributions to database engines, operators and other infrastructure software. Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution. We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. OUR COMMITMENT Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto. We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision. As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. Stay connected Follow us on X https://twitter.com/krakenfx Learn on the Kraken Blog https://blog.kraken.com/#:~:text=Enter%20your%20email%20address Connect on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/kraken-exchange/ Candidate Privacy Notice https://www.kraken.com/legal/candidate-privacy-notice

jobs.description: ABOUT US Most AI is frozen in place - it doesn’t adapt to the world. We think that’s backwards. Our mandate is to build efficient intelligence that evolves in real-time. We bring together exceptional people with the drive and creativity to push the boundaries of continual adaptation. We’re looking for builders and creative thinkers ready to shape the next era of intelligence. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in accountability, initiative and shared success. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world. We operate with low egos, high velocity, and extreme ownership to build technology that expands access and benefits the many, not the few. HOW WE WORK - Impact over activity: We are building a generational company. We value people who execute on ideas rather than comment from the sidelines. We believe our competitive edge lies in caring about excellence across the entire lifecycle - from research to product. No task is beneath anyone: no one is too senior to test the build, clean the data, or unblock a teammate. - Vulnerable, low-ego collaboration: We believe exceptional work comes from people who challenge, support and push one another to think bigger. Rapid iteration requires stepping into discomfort. We encourage bold, half-baked, and unorthodox ideas. When we disagree, we share feedback directly, never through side channels. - Celebrate decisively: Extraordinary effort should be deeply memorable. We celebrate milestones generously and publicly - via spot bonuses, team dinners, spontaneous gifts, and company-wide recognition - to fuel each other for the next sprint. THE ROLE Our vision is AI systems that are flexible, adaptable, and accessible to everyone. We believe efficiency is what makes this possible. It’s how we expand access and ensure innovation benefits the many, not the few. This is a research role which is focused on real world impact. We care about building our frontier innovation around efficiency, gradient free exploration, real time learning and interface design. A revolution is underway where the cost of generating synthetic data is now low enough that we can treat the data space as malleable and something which can be optimized. We can steer synthetic data towards desirable properties and make previously invisible worlds with limited data coverage more visible. The most intelligent system will increasingly be defined by building an algorithm that can interact with the world. This means for the first time researchers who care about intelligence need also be obsessed with how a model interacts. If any of these statements resonate with you, we would like to hear from you. Our research principles Sweat the details. Technical excellence requires obsessing over every detail. We co-design serving, algorithms, and interface as one system to maximize efficiency and enable real-time adaptation. Move with conviction. Extraordinary results require extraordinary effort. We operate with urgency as a unified team, concentrating resources on a few high-conviction bets where research and impact intersect. Metrics that matter. The most intelligent system will increasingly be defined by building an algorithm that can interact with the world. Research ideas are tested through working products. If it doesn't improve what users can do, we question whether it matters. We share what moves the field; we don't optimize for paper count. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Innovation: innovate on our product to co-design algorithms that react real-time to product signal and feedback. Design new ways of giving feedback that drive better algorithms. - Cross-stack optimization: collaborate across software, hardware, and algorithmic domains to achieve system-wide efficiency gains - Measure what matters: we believe strongly that the ultimate signal of value is whether we have real world impact. Our current algorithms are capable of interacting with the world which is why product matters so much. SKILLS YOU'LL BRING We look beyond traditional markers of experience. What matters most to us is what you’ve built and the impact you’ve had. We value demonstrable output, curiosity and alignment with our core values: - A PhD or equivalent research experience in a computer science field - 4-5+ years of industry experience - Deep expertise in at least one area: model efficiency, real time alignment or algorithmic optimization - Systems thinking ability to understand and optimize across the full ML stack - Strong programming skills in Python. Experience with deep learning frameworks (PyTorch, JAX, TensorFlow) - Knowledge of model optimization techniques (RLHF, finetuning) - Experience in an industry lab with computing at scale Above all, we're looking for great teammates who make work feel lighter and aren't afraid to go out on a limb with bold ideas. You don't need to be perfect, but you do need to be adaptable. We encourage you to apply, even if you don't check every box. BENEFITS - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: A dynamic environment with opportunities to take on new challenges, expand your responsibilities, and make an impact beyond your immediate role. - Adaption Passport: An annual travel allowance to explore somewhere new, experience different cultures and keep expanding your horizons. It can be used to travel to any country you haven’t previously been to. - Lunch on us: A weekly allowance for takeout or grocery delivery, wherever you are in the world. Whether it's stocking your fridge or having dinner delivered, it’s one less thing to think about. - Comprehensive benefits: High-quality medical coverage and benefits designed to support your health and well-being. - Team offsites and visits to SF HQ: We're a global team, but believe there's real value in spending time together in person. We regularly bring teammates together at our SF HQ and for team offsites in locations around the world, including London, Mexico City, and New York.

HOW WE WORK - Impact over activity: We are building a generational company. We value people who execute on ideas rather than comment from the sidelines. We believe our competitive edge lies in caring about excellence across the entire lifecycle - from research to product. No task is beneath anyone: no one is too senior to test the build, clean the data, or unblock a teammate. - Vulnerable, low-ego collaboration: We believe exceptional work comes from people who challenge, support and push one another to think bigger. Rapid iteration requires stepping into discomfort. We encourage bold, half-baked, and unorthodox ideas. When we disagree, we share feedback directly, never through side channels. - Celebrate decisively: Extraordinary effort should be deeply memorable. We celebrate milestones generously and publicly - via spot bonuses, team dinners, spontaneous gifts, and company-wide recognition - to fuel each other for the next sprint. THE ROLE Our vision is AI systems that are flexible, adaptable, and accessible to everyone. We believe efficiency is what makes this possible. It’s how we expand access and ensure innovation benefits the many, not the few. This is a research role focused on building models that continuously evolve with the world. Our frontier work centers on efficiency, gradient-free exploration, real-time learning, and interface design. The most intelligent systems will increasingly be defined not just by what they know, but by how well they can interact with the world. For the first time, researchers who care deeply about intelligence and efficiency must also be obsessed with the interface through which a model acts. If any of this resonates, we'd love to hear from you. Our Research Principles Sweat the details. Technical excellence requires obsessing over every detail. We co-design serving, algorithms, and interface as one system to maximize efficiency and enable real-time adaptation. Move with conviction. Extraordinary results require extraordinary effort. We operate with urgency as a unified team, concentrating resources on a few high-conviction bets where research and impact intersect. Metrics that matter. The most intelligent system will increasingly be defined by building an algorithm that can interact with the world. Research ideas are tested through working products. If it doesn't improve what users can do, we question whether it matters. We share what moves the field; we don't optimize for paper count. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Innovation: You have ideas and you move fast. You care about impact, not just effort. - Cross-stack optimization: You collaborate across software, hardware, and algorithmic domains to unlock system-wide efficiency gains. - Measure what matters: The ultimate signal of value is real-world impact. Our current algorithms are capable of interacting with the world which is why product thinking is inseparable from research. SKILLS YOU'LL BRING We look beyond traditional markers of experience. What matters most to us is what you’ve built and the impact you’ve had. We value demonstrable output, curiosity and alignment with our core values: - A PhD or equivalent research experience in a computer science field - 4-5+ years of industry experience - Publishing record at ICML, NeurIPS, ACL, ICLR, EMNLP. - Deep expertise in at least one area: model efficiency, real time alignment or algorithmic optimization - Systems thinking ability to understand and optimize across the full ML stack - Strong programming skills in Python. Experience with deep learning frameworks (PyTorch, JAX, TensorFlow) - Knowledge of model optimization techniques (RLHF, finetuning) - Experience in an industry lab with computing at scale Above all, we're looking for great teammates who make work feel lighter and aren't afraid to go out on a limb with bold ideas. You don't need to be perfect, but you do need to be adaptable. We encourage you to apply, even if you don't check every box. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: A dynamic environment with opportunities to take on new challenges, expand your responsibilities, and make an impact beyond your immediate role. - Adaption Passport: An annual travel allowance to explore somewhere new, experience different cultures and keep expanding your horizons. It can be used to travel to any country you haven’t previously been to. - Lunch on us: A weekly allowance for takeout or grocery delivery, wherever you are in the world. Whether it's stocking your fridge or having dinner delivered, it’s one less thing to think about. - Comprehensive benefits: High-quality medical coverage and benefits designed to support your health and well-being. - Team offsites and visits to SF HQ: We're a global team, but believe there's real value in spending time together in person. We regularly bring teammates together at our SF HQ and for team offsites in locations around the world, including London, Mexico City, and New York.

This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US. What we're looking for: • Bring three or more years of experience in security, compliance, risk, audit, GRC, program management, or a related technical discipline. • Manage moderately complex, cross-functional compliance or security initiatives with a high degree of organization, ownership, and follow-through. • Apply one or more security or compliance frameworks, such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST 800-53, CMMC, FedRAMP, PCI DSS, or similar standards. • Support FedRAMP or comparable federal compliance programs, ideally in a program management, project management, or cross-functional coordination capacity. You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone https://blog.1password.com/inside-the-culture-powering-1passwords-next-chapter/. Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. jobs.description: WHO ARE WE? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems. We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! Why This Role? This role is the critical bridge that amplifies Cohere’s ability to execute from its deployed engineering teams into the partner ecosystem at scale. You will be the single point of influence who takes the high quality of our engineering delivery and extends it outward, ensuring that system integrator partners can deliver Cohere solutions with the same rigor, reliability, and innovation as our internal teams. As an Adoption Specialist, you will design, build, maintain, and deliver certification programs that validate partner expertise across infrastructure and agentic domains. You will report functionally into Customer Education & Transformation, with a dotted line into the Forward Deployed Engineering teams (Infrastructure and agentic), ensuring that every certification, every training program, and every competency standard reflects the latest innovation and the highest standards of delivery. We are seeking a unique individual: someone who is customer obsessed, has a background in infrastructure engineering with the technical grit and expertise to be a de facto member of the deployed engineering teams, while also bringing commercial acumen to scale these capabilities across the partner ecosystem. You will be the conduit between our internal engineering excellence and the broader market, and you will be the face of this program in front of partner networks and communities. In this role, you will: - Design, build, and maintain certification programs for system integrator partners across both infrastructure and agentic tracks, ensuring they reflect current technical realities and future innovation. This includes train-the-trainer programs with key system integrators that can certify on our behalf. - Develop deep subject matter expertise in end-to-end deployment of North in private cloud and on-premises environments, including planning, configuration, testing, and rollout. As well as assess infrastructure, security requirements, and data management practices. - Develop deep subject matter expertise in applied AI across the design, build, and deployment of agentic workflows powered by Large Language Models (LLMs), from early prototypes to production-grade AI agents, to deliver concrete business value in enterprise workflows - Collaborate with Forward Deployed Engineering teams on a dotted line basis to ensure certification content stays current with product innovation and hands-on development. - Collaborate with Product to ensure requirements are adapted into the core product. - Create dynamic training programs and enablement assets that drive self-service enablement and partner competency, building educational content specifically for developers. - Deliver the certification and education program publicly, serving as the face of this initiative to partner networks, partner communities, and customer communities, with the exposure and visibility that comes with representing Cohere’s technical excellence externally. You may be a good fit if your experience covers the following areas: - Execution flexibility in fast-paced environments, with the ability to work across infrastructure, and agentic areas. - Infrastructure and cloud expertise including enterprise software deployment in private/hybrid cloud environments, production Kubernetes administration, Helm, DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and version control. - Agentic and LLM stack expertise encompassing production-grade Python software development, RAG and agentic applications using patterns like ReAct or Plan-and-Execute, and robust evaluation framework design. - Developer relations and community engagement, including public speaking, presenting, with a natural comfort with visibility and being the face of technical initiatives. - Experience building enablement or education content specifically for developers. FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS: - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch. - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health. - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme. - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent. - Annual enrichment benefits: Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit. Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching. - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!) - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite. HOW AND WHERE WE WORK: - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon. - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events. - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city. - Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly. If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12a6IrLdF3kI2nonKSr4tiFuz18rLQbaeYV-JM9L4o9Q/edit, and we will work together to meet your needs. We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider. Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers https://cohere.com/careers page.

jobs.description: 1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $500M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing. About 1Password At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work. If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future. The Billing & Payments Engineering team builds and owns the mission-critical systems that power 1Password’s revenue engine end-to-end. We are responsible for the highly available architecture that enables seamless subscription management, complex payment processing, and global financial compliance. From managing the intricate logic of the subscription lifecycle—creations, renewals, upgrades, and cancellations—to integrating with diverse payment gateways and app-store ecosystems, our work ensures a frictionless experience for our customers. As a team, we are actively architecting the next generation of our billing infrastructure, modernizing and consolidating our systems to support rapidly scaling product lines, guarantee absolute data integrity, and ensure robust integrations with downstream financial workflows. In this role, you’ll design, build, and operate reliable backend services while owning complex initiatives from initial design through production. Your work will help create a safer, simpler digital future by making it easier for customers to access and rely on 1Password. How we’re using AI today Our Engineering, Product, and Design teams are thoughtfully integrating AI across the full software and product development lifecycle to move faster without sacrificing quality or security. In practice, that looks like engineers using AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate reviews and catch bugs earlier, product managers synthesizing user research at scale, and designers rapidly prototyping and iterating with AI-generated mockups. We approach AI the same way we approach security: with clear principles, human accountability at every consequential decision point, and rigorous evaluation before anything ships to customers. This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US. What we're looking for: - Demonstrated expertise in engineering robust backend architectures using Go, alongside a history of taking end-to-end ownership of complex initiatives from initial design to live production deployment - A drive for and proven experience in software development best practices, and coding standards - You enjoy solving complex problems with a demonstrated ability propose effective solutions - You like communicating and collaborating and can demonstrate experience in working effectively with team and communicating technical concepts to non-technical cross-functional partners - You’re passionate about testing methodologies and debugging techniques to ensure high-quality code Bonus points for: - Billing & Payments: Experience building or maintaining billing, payment processing, or subscription platforms (e.g., Stripe, native app stores). - Distributed Systems: A strong background in designing and scaling highly available, fault-tolerant distributed architectures. - API Integrations: Proven ability to build resilient integrations with third-party APIs, including handling webhooks, retries, and strict idempotency. What you can expect: - Code, test, debug, deliver and maintain production software systems for new and existing product features - Collaborate with cross functional teams and/or stakeholders throughout the development cycle to ensure smooth releases - Work with your teammates and project manager to communicate technical requirements to stakeholders and solve technical problems in a scalable and realistic way - Mentor junior and new team members by helping them understand team expectations, providing technical guidance, sharing knowledge, and engaging in pair programming sessions - Participate in planning by identifying major tasks and breaking down, estimating, and planning work - Write comprehensive tests during various stages of the development cycle, ensuring code is functioning as expected - Review code for others to maintain high code quality, knowledge share within the team, and support creating a safe environment of giving and receiving feedback - Generate and review documentation on code processes to ensure scalability - Stay informed about the latest industry trends, technologies, and best practices in development - Be available for on-call rotational work to ensure uninterrupted support and resolve emergencies USA-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $153,000 USD and $214,000 USD, plus immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs. Canada-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $144,000 CAD and $202,000 CAD, plus immediate participation in 1Password’s generous benefits program (health, dental, RRSP and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs. At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set. This posting is for an existing vacancy. Our culture At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first. You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone https://blog.1password.com/inside-the-culture-powering-1passwords-next-chapter/. Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. jobs.description: WHO ARE WE? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems. We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! WHY THIS ROLE? We're building the foundational infrastructure that will define how the world thinks about and deploys AI, and we want the sharpest, most driven, and most curious people to help us do it. As the founding lead of Agentic Analytics, a new team in our Analytics and Data Insights organization, you'll own how Cohere gets answers from its own data: an agentic analytics system that answers business questions over governed data, shows the source, query, and freshness behind every answer, and asks for clarification or declines when the evidence is insufficient. Agentic analytics is far from a solved problem, and correctness is the hard part. A query that runs can still answer the wrong question. Agents go wrong when a business term maps to more than one table, when data goes stale, and when the right context never reaches the model. The worst failures are silent and plausible: a join that double-counts, a wrong denominator, missing data read as zero. Getting this right takes governed definitions, context an agent can use, and an evaluation bar that decides what ships. You'll build on work already in motion: an internal analytics agent in pilot on our BigQuery warehouse, which is fed by tested ingestion pipelines and modeled in dbt. In your first year, you'll take it to production for teams across Cohere, one domain at a time, and make it replicable: each new domain stands up with configuration, a fresh evaluation set, and very little new code. This is a hands-on staff engineering role reporting to our Senior Director of Data Analytics. You'll write production code and evaluation sets yourself while managing a small founding team that grows as the system proves itself. You may have held the title software engineer, AI engineer, or data scientist; what matters is that you've built a system like this and run it in production. RESPONSIBILITIES As the lead of Agentic Analytics, you will: - Own the system end to end. Set the architecture for how a business question becomes a governed query and a verifiable answer: interpreting the question, retrieving the right context, applying approved definitions and joins, enforcing the asking user's permissions, and attaching the evidence (source, query, freshness) to every answer. - Build and run it in production. Design the core services and write much of the first version yourself: agent-facing data tools (MCP or equivalent), context retrieval, agent skills for analytics, and the APIs that serve answers. Hold them to production standards for reliability, latency, cost, security, and observability. Put it where people already work: Slack, North, IDEs, and other agents. - Hold every release to the evaluation bar. Build and run the evaluation harness, and define what correct means in each domain: ground-truth question sets, including held-out cases and questions the agent should clarify or decline; result-level scoring, correct-or-decline rates, coverage, and error severity; and regression tests on every change to context, skills, or models. Nothing ships below the bar, and the call on when a domain is ready for production is yours. - Engineer the context layer. Turn metric definitions, approved joins, documentation generated from the code that builds each table, a business glossary, and worked examples into context the agent can use. Every correction becomes a reviewed definition and a regression test. - Roll it out across Cohere. Bring domains such as marketing, revenue, finance, and product onto the system one at a time, each with named owners, certified definitions, and its own evaluation set. Measure adoption, accuracy, turnaround, and correction effort against how those teams work today. - Make it replicable. Package the tools, skills, context templates, and evaluations, and document them well enough that other teams at Cohere can run the system without you. - Hire and lead the team. Bring on the team's first engineers, set the technical bar, review the work, and develop the people doing it. - Partner across Cohere. Work with our data platform team on the warehouse and semantic models, our model evaluation team on evaluation methodology, our security team on access, and each domain's owners on definitions and rollout. QUALIFICATIONS You may be a good fit, if you have: - 10+ years building and operating production analytics or software systems, including technical leadership of a team or of systems that span teams - Experience shipping LLM agents to production: tool use, MCP or similar, retrieval and context engineering, guardrails, and observability, with firm opinions on where they fail - Hands-on experience building natural-language or agentic analytics (text-to-SQL, analytics agents, question answering over a semantic layer) that real users relied on, and evidence that it was right - Depth in evaluating LLM systems: golden sets, result-level comparison, abstention metrics, error taxonomies, and regression testing in CI, plus the judgment to tell a good demo from a system you'd put in front of a CFO - Strong Python and SQL, and experience designing and running production services and APIs on a major cloud (Google Cloud is a plus) - Fluency with data: cloud warehouses (BigQuery, Snowflake, or similar), dbt, and semantic layers (MetricFlow, LookML, Cube, or similar). You think in grain, metric definitions, and approved joins, and you can tell when a number is wrong before it reaches a decision - Experience building identity-aware access for agents, where the agent acts with the asking user's permissions and every query leaves an audit trail - Experience hiring and developing engineers, with a leadership style grounded in empathy as much as in data - Genuine excitement about AI: you follow the research, have opinions, and enjoy being in the weeds - Comfort operating in ambiguity, leading through partners you don't manage, and writing design docs and eval reports that settle decisions across teams If some of the above doesn't line up perfectly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply! FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS: - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch. - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health. - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme. - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent. - Annual enrichment benefits: Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit. Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching. - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!) - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite. HOW AND WHERE WE WORK: - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon. - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events. - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city. - Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up

jobs.description: MaintainX is a leading mobile-first work execution platform for industrial and frontline teams. More than 15,000 customers, including McDonalds, Michaels, Cintas, Redimix, and U.S. LBM, use MaintainX to cut unplanned downtime and run better operations, across 16 million managed assets and 92 million completed work orders. In August 2026 MaintainX became part of Autodesk, joining Autodesk Operations Solutions https://adsknews.autodesk.com/en/views/inside-autodesk-operations-solutions/, the organization unifying Autodesk's operations platform alongside Tandem, FlexSim and Fusion Operations. Autodesk's strategy is to converge design, make and operate into one continuous lifecycle: design an asset, build it, run it, then feed what you learn running it back into the next design. Autodesk had design and make. Operate is the phase that tells you what actually happened, and it is ours. ABOUT THE ROLE: Remote (Toronto or Montreal) As a Senior Engineer on the Quality Platform team, you'll build the shared testing infrastructure, frameworks, and AI-assisted tooling that every engineering team at MaintainX relies on to ship quickly and confidently. Rather than owning testing for a single product area, you'll create the platform, developer experience, and automation that make high-quality software the default across the organization. You'll partner closely with product engineering teams, Quality Advocates, and SRE to improve developer productivity, increase release confidence, and help shape the future of AI-powered testing at MaintainX. WHAT YOU'LL DO: - Build and evolve MaintainX's shared quality platform, test automation frameworks, and developer tooling. - Design and develop AI-assisted test authoring infrastructure that significantly reduces test creation time while maintaining high quality. - Own CI integration standards and improve build reliability across engineering teams. - Design test harnesses for AI-powered product capabilities, including health checks, graceful degradation, quota monitoring, and adversarial testing. - Identify and eliminate systemic test debt and flaky tests before they impact engineering teams. - Build shared testing utilities and frameworks adopted across the engineering organization. - Partner with Quality Advocates, product engineering teams, and SRE to continuously improve testing strategy and platform reliability. - Evaluate emerging AI testing tools and drive adoption where they create measurable engineering impact. ABOUT YOU: - Strong software engineering fundamentals with experience writing, debugging, and maintaining production application code. - Hands-on experience building and maintaining production-grade test automation frameworks using Playwright, Selenium, or similar technologies. - Experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and diagnosing flaky or failing test suites. - Experience building or maintaining shared developer tooling, testing infrastructure, or engineering platforms — comfort with cloud infrastructure (e.g., AWS), containerized environments, and observability tooling (e.g., Datadog) is a plus. - Experience using AI development tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or similar to accelerate engineering workflows while applying sound engineering judgment. - Comfortable owning systems end-to-end, from architecture and implementation through production support. - Experience mentoring engineers and helping raise engineering quality across teams. - Strong spoken and written English, as you'll collaborate daily with engineering leaders and managers across multiple teams and present technical priorities to executive stakeholders. NICE TO HAVE: - Experience building test harnesses for AI-powered features, including health checks, circuit-breakers, adversarial testing, or resilience testing. - Experience building or maintaining autonomous or agentic AI systems. - Experience evaluating AI-powered developer tools and integrating them into engineering workflows. - Experience building observability and quality metrics into testing platforms. - Experience working with large-scale developer platforms supporting multiple engineering teams. Our mission is to keep the physical world running. Factories, fleets, hospitals and campuses stay up because the people who maintain them have tools worth using. That is what we build. jobs.description: ABOUT THE TEAM Most providers make customers migrate their data to them. We're doing the opposite: bringing ClickHouse Cloud into the environments our customers already trust, so their data stays useful right where it lives. Those environments come in a few shapes. Some are major cloud data platforms that run ClickHouse as a native service, so customers get it without leaving the tool they already use. Some are BI and visualization tools that need ClickHouse to show up as a fast, first-class data source behind their dashboards. And some are developer and data platforms we connect through marketplaces and identity federation with a couple of clicks or agentic calls. Every integration is unique, but the goal is the same every time: ClickHouse should feel like a first-class citizen in every environment. The craft is finding the patterns underneath different integrations. As one of the first backend engineers, you'll help shape the technical defaults for this team. You'll have end-to-end ownership, but you'll also work inside the constraints of platforms you don't own: thin documentation, unfamiliar deployment topologies, and timelines governed by partner approval cycles. A lot of the challenge is engineering across trust boundaries you don't fully control. You won't be doing it alone. You'll work closely with your engineering manager, the product manager, a growing team, and experienced engineers across the broader org. If that sounds like your kind of challenge, let's talk. WHAT YOU'LL DO You'll own an integration end to end: the design, the code, and the production system that keeps running after launch. The patterns you set there become defaults the rest of the team builds on. Day to day, that looks like: - Owning the architecture: auth and identity flows, multi-tenancy, how data moves and where it's allowed to live, performance, and what happens in production - Running what you build. Which means owning the infrastructure, CI, deployment, observability behind it and on-call - Working on top of external platforms you can't change, and being straight about which risks are yours to manage and which aren't - Partnering closely with the internal teams whose services you depend on: iterating on product requirements, agreeing on interfaces and protocols, and proactively finding ways to keep moving ABOUT YOU These are the attributes of someone who will perform well in this role: - 8+ years building software, with a good chunk of it on data-heavy or integration-flavored systems - Preferably proficient in Go or TypeScript or comfortable contributing to each - Solid backend and systems instincts. You can reason about deployment topology, multi-tenancy, and data movement, and you're comfortable owning architectural tradeoffs you'll have to live with later - You've worked with modern auth protocols, service principals, and identity federation, and you know how to get it right across a trust boundary - You've built on someone else's platform and know what that's actually like: incomplete docs, unintended breaking changes, etc. - You're comfortable in ambiguity. jobs.description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.</p></div><p>Consumer Engineering builds the Affirm experience millions of people use to pay over time, honestly and without hidden fees. Our engineers work closely with product and design to ship fast, test often, and make every interaction simple and transparent.&nbsp;</p> <p>You will be matched with a role on Consumer Engineering after completing the interview evaluation process. Your recruiter will work closely with you throughout the process to understand your interests and experience to find the strongest role fit.</p> <h3><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h3> <ul> <li>You will be responsible for owning and delivering quarterly goals for your team, leading engineers on your team through ambiguity to solve open-ended problems, and ensuring that everyone is supported throughout delivery.</li> <li>You will support your peers and stakeholders in the product development lifecycle by collaborating with product management, design &amp; analytics by participating in ideation, articulating technical constraints, and partnering on decisions that properly consider risks and trade-offs.</li> <li>You will proactively identify project, process, technology or business issues, advocate for them, and lead in solving them.</li> <li>You will support the operations and availability of your team’s artifacts by creating and monitoring metrics, escalating when needed, and supporting “keep the lights on” &amp; on-call efforts.</li> <li>You will foster a culture of quality and ownership on your team by setting or improving code review and design standards for your team, and advocating for them beyond your team through your writing and tech talks.</li> <li>You will help develop talent on your team by providing feedback and guidance, and leading by example.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we look for</strong></h3> <ul> <li>You have 4+ years of experience designing, developing and launching backend systems at scale using languages like Python or Kotlin.</li> <li>You have a track record of developing highly available distributed systems using technologies like AWS, MySQL and Kubernetes.</li> <li>You have experience defining a technical plan for the delivery of a significant feature or system component with an elegant, simple and extensible design. You write high quality code that is easily understood and used by others.</li> <li>You are proficient at making significant changes in a large code base, and have developed a suite of tools and practices that enable you and your team to do so safely.</li> <li>Your experience demonstrates that you take ownership of your growth, proactively seeking feedback from your team, your manager, and your stakeholders.</li> <li>You have strong verbal and written communication skills that support effective collaboration with our global engineering team.</li> </ul> <p>This remote role is open only to candidates residing in Alberta, British Columbia, Manitoba, New Brunswick, Newfoundland and Labrador, Nova Scotia, Ontario, Prince Edward Island, or Saskatchewan</p> <p><strong>Pay Grade - N<br><br></strong><strong>Equity Grade - 6<br><br></strong>Employees new to Affirm&nbsp;<em>typically come in at the start of the pay range</em>. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.<br><br>Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.)<br><br>CAN base pay range per year: $153,000 - $213,000 CAD</p> <p>&nbsp;#LI-Remote</p><div class="content-conclusion"><div> <p><strong>Remote-first with flexibility built in</strong><strong><br></strong>Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.</p> <p><strong>Benefits designed for you</strong><strong><br></strong>Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:</p> <ul> <li>Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.</li> <li>Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.</li> <li>Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.</li> <li>Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.</li> </ul> <p>We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.</p> <p>For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.</p> </div> <div> <p>By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's&nbsp;<a href="https://www.affirm.com/global-candidate-privacy-notice" target="_blank">Global Candidate Privacy Notice</a> and consent to the use of your personal information as described.</p> </div></div>

jobs.description: <p>"We may say most aptly that the Analytical Engine weaves algebraic patterns just as the Jacquard loom weaves flowers and leaves."</p> <p>— Ada Lovelace, 1843</p> <p>What Lovelace saw in the loom was the pattern — flowers and leaves, repeated faithfully, each one begun by a hand that chose it. Mercury is built from patterns too. Every component, every interaction our customers come to trust, starts with someone deciding how it should go, and making it good enough to be used again and again. Tending those patterns, and giving everyone at Mercury the means to weave with them, is the work of our Design System team, and the north star of this role.</p> <p>As a Senior Frontend Engineer on the Design Systems team, you will build and care for those patterns: the components and foundations that everything else at Mercury is built on. Done well, a single decision here makes every product team faster.</p> <p>The ground under that work is shifting, though. Software is being built in new ways, and AI is increasingly part of how design systems are made and used. We are looking for someone who is fluent at that intersection: deeply versed in design systems, and equally as serious about what it takes to build a system that holds up at the leading edge of AI.</p> <p><strong>As part of this role, you will:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build and maintain the components, patterns, and foundations (tokens, type, color, layout) that Mercury's product is woven from, holding a high bar for accessibility, performance, and pixel-level craft.</li> <li>Lead projects that ship new UI patterns to solve real pain points for product teams, helping them build better experiences faster.</li> <li>Develop a design system that's as ready for AI as it is for people, applying the technology to create leveraged outcomes.</li> <li>Invest in the design system's prototyping experience, shaping the next iteration of how our design function rapidly prototypes, iterates on the product, and explores new concepts.</li> <li>Raise the craft and AI fluency of the people around you, through mentorship and clear best practices.</li> </ul> <p><strong>The ideal candidate for the role:</strong></p> <p>We're looking for someone who cares about the foundational work that lets other people do their best work, and who's eager to help define what a design system means in a world where agents build alongside us. A successful candidate will likely have:</p> <ul> <li>7+ years of frontend development, with deep experience in React, TypeScript, and modern web technologies.</li> <li>Experience building or maintaining a design system or shared component library.</li> <li>A thorough command of modern frontend tooling: build systems, CI/CD, and testing.</li> <li>High agency, and comfort creating clarity in ambiguous spaces. You take ownership and move without waiting for a defined path.</li> <li>First-principles systems thinking that stays oriented to outcomes. You make clear decisions that drive toward results instead of getting stuck in open questions.</li> <li>Strong product taste, and an instinct for leverage: the change that makes many teams better, not the one component polished in isolation.</li> <li>Hands-on fluency at the intersection of AI and software development: a real command of how emerging AI paradigms are changing the way software gets built, and the ability to turn that into practical leverage, both for the design system itself and for the people who build on it.</li> </ul> <p>If this role interests you, we invite you to explore our public demo at <a href="https://demo.mercury.com/">demo.mercury.com</a>.&nbsp;</p> <p><em>*Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.</em></p> <p>Mercury values diversity &amp; belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All individuals seeking employment at Mercury are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities or special needs. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.</p> <p>#LI-MC1</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><strong>Total Rewards</strong><br>The total rewards package at Mercury includes base salary, equity (stock options/RSUs), and benefits.</p> <p>Our salary and equity ranges are highly competitive within the SaaS and fintech industry and are updated regularly using the most reliable compensation survey data for our industry. New hire offers are made based on a candidate’s experience, expertise, geographic location, and internal pay equity relative to peers.</p> <p>Our target new hire base salary ranges for this role are the following<strong>:</strong></p></div><div class="title">US employees (any location):</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$200,700</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>$250,900 USD</span></div></div><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">Canadian employees (any location):</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$189,700</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>$237,100 CAD</span></div></div></div>

jobs.description: WHO ARE WE? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems. We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! WHY THIS TEAM? Internal Infrastructure builds the infrastructure and tools used to train, evaluate, and serve Cohere's foundation models. You will work with AI researchers and ML engineers on stability, scalability, and observability. The work accelerates the models behind Cohere's platform, North. You will run the shared Kubernetes fleets those workloads land on: multi-cloud GPU and TPU clusters, node health, performance, and the partnership with cloud providers and hardware vendors. The role includes a compensated 24x7 on-call rotation. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Deploy and operate GPU Kubernetes clusters across clouds, and bring up new hardware generations and providers. - Work with cloud providers and hardware partners on reliability, performance, and cost, including RDMA and high-speed interconnects. - Automate node, GPU, and fabric fault detection and remediation so most faults are fixed without a human. - Improve fleet utilization, track cost, and cut the time it takes to get a faulty node back into service. - Troubleshoot production failures and performance problems, and leave the system easier to operate than you found it. We hire at more than one level. We set level based on the scope you've owned and how independently you drive work. YOU MAY BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU HAVE - Run GPU Kubernetes clusters with thousands of GPUs for ML or HPC workloads. - Debugged Linux, networking, and performance problems. Familiarity with RDMA, NCCL, or accelerator health is a plus. - Written software in Python or Go. You would rather extend a solid open-source project than rebuild it. - Worked with researchers, ML engineers, or another team whose goals were not identical to yours. - Found a bottleneck, proposed a fix, and driven it in a fast-moving environment. If this does not line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching. - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!) - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite. HOW AND WHERE WE WORK: - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon. - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events. - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city. - Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly. If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply.
