jobs.description: ABOUT KEYCARD At Keycard, we're building identity and access infrastructure for the agent-native era, where software isn't static but a dynamic, constantly changing system of AI agents working on behalf of people and businesses. Keycard gives every agent a verified identity and issues short-lived, task-scoped credentials at runtime, so agents can only do what they were asked to do, and every action is fully auditable. We're backed by a16z, Boldstart, and Acrew, and our founding team built and scaled Snyk, Auth0, HashiCorp, and Heroku. THE ROLE We're hiring a staff-level Software Engineer, Security. This is a software engineering role: you'll build and run the security program for what Keycard ships and runs, across our product, our infrastructure, and what we publish, mostly as code and automation. Security is everyone's job here. You'd be the first engineer whose whole job is security, working with engineers who already know the field. It matters because security is what we sell: a hole in our token exchange or policy checks hands a customer's agent access nobody granted. You find those holes early and build the tooling that catches the next ones. Keycard is a control plane for agents: identity, credential exchange, delegation, policy, and audit. It has to hold even when the agent itself is compromised. Agents are part of how we build, and part of how you'll do this job. You'll also secure Keycard itself: our cloud accounts, customer-hosted deployments, our pipeline, and secrets. You set the controls and run security response. Platform engineering runs the infrastructure; operations handles audits and customer reviews. You prioritize product and company security work by risk to customers and Keycard. WHAT YOU'LL DO SECURE THE PRODUCT - Threat modeling. Trace how an agent gets access, from token exchange through delegation to the per-tool check at our MCP gateway, then attack it: confused deputies, poisoned tool descriptions, prompt injection, issuer and audience mix-ups, token passthrough. Credentials shouldn't leak between hops, and delegated access should end when it expires or is revoked. - Assume compromise. Even a compromised agent should be stopped from escalating privileges or crossing tenants. Document what it can still do with its access. - Design review. Review designs and code across the token service, Cedar policy engine, MCP gateway, CLI, SDKs, and Console, mostly for who can do what and whether zones stay isolated. - Attack with agents. Run scoped agents against an isolated instance and chase the authorization failures they find. Confirmed failures become CI regressions for token exchange, impersonation, or per-tool policy. Example: a harness that follows a delegated credential end to end and checks it never gains scope or lifetime. - Customer reviews. Be the technical voice when customers' security teams review or pentest us; operations runs the process. SECURE KEYCARD - Cloud and delivery controls. Build agents that find and fix misconfigurations in cloud accounts, pipelines, and published artifacts, with scoped access and human review for their changes. With platform engineering, test isolation between deployments and audited break-glass access. - Our own credentials. Keep them short-lived and narrow. Design service identity and PKI, sign what we ship to customers, and manage dependency risk. You also use Keycard to scope what our own agents can reach. - Incident response. Investigate vulnerabilities and security events, coordinate fixes, and automate detection and routine fixes where you can. You'll also work out with engineering how on-call works for security. - Compliance. Own the engineering behind SOC 2 and other compliance frameworks: controls that live in code and config, evidence pulled automatically from cloud accounts, CI, and Keycard’s own audit logs, and a clear line between the controls we own and the ones customers own when Keycard runs in their cloud. Operations runs the audits; you make sure what we claim is true. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - You've shipped and maintained production code, not only security tooling, and you've found and fixed vulnerabilities in applications or identity systems. - You can read unfamiliar code, build an exploit or reproduction, and ship the fix with a regression test. - You know OAuth 2.0 and 2.1, OIDC, and token exchange (RFC 8693), and can describe failures you've seen, like refresh-token misuse. - You can spot the problem in an IAM policy, a network path, or a cloud audit log, even if you've never run cloud infrastructure. - You've built security tooling other engineers adopted that prevents recurring bugs, and you can explain what it catches, what it misses, and when fixes need human review. - You’ve been the engineer behind a SOC 2 Type II or other compliance program, not only the person answering auditors. You’ve turned controls into code and automated the evidence, and you can say which controls cut real risk and which only satisfy an audit. - Agents at work. You use agents for review, triage, or testing, and know how to check their output and limit their access. STRONG CANDIDATES MAY ALSO HAVE - Experience in identity infrastructure, developer tools, or multi-tenant SaaS. - Experience with DPoP, Cedar, or SPIFFE/SPIRE. - Hands-on AWS security: IAM, SCPs, logging, infrastructure as code. - Securing agents or MCP servers, including tool permissions and sandboxing. - Public security work: CVEs, bug bounties, write-ups, or OAuth and MCP standards work. YOUR FIRST 90 DAYS - Month one: map trust boundaries in token exchange and one priority delegation flow, attack them, and compare findings with our risk register. Review the company security setup with platform engineering. - Ship fixes for the findings we agree matter most, each with a CI regression. - Build reusable evidence for customer reviews and a triage process for pentest findings; questionnaires stay with operations. - By day 90: a product and company security roadmap with owners and incident roles, built from the risk register you now own. WHO WILL LOVE THIS JOB - You'd rather break the product yourself than wait for a customer's red team to. - You'd rather fix a class of bugs once than file the same finding twice. WHAT WE OFFER - Build at the Frontier: Work every day at the frontier of agent-native systems — shipping, inventing, and iterating on technology that hasn’t been built before. You’ll be given huge autonomy, the opportunity to gain mastery, and the chance to work in a team that holds each other accountable to succeed. - Truly Agent-Native Culture: At Keycard, we don’t just enable others to adopt agents — we use them ourselves to build. You’ll help shape an organization that embeds AI into its foundation as an enduring competitive advantage. - Compensation With Upside: Market-competitive salaries and generous equity packages (4-year vest, 1-year cliff) give you the security to focus on building — and the asymmetric upside of ownership in a company chasing a category-defining mission. - Comprehensive Benefits & Recharge: Health, dental, vision, and paramedical coverage for you and your family, plus 4 weeks vacation, 11 statutory holidays, and 1 volunteer day annually. We encourage at least 2 weeks off each year to fully recharge. - Tools That Keep You Ahead: A new MacBook Pro, a $500 stipend for peripherals, and the best AI tools available so you can work at the forefront of agent-native workflows. - Remote-First Flexibility: We are a remote-first team prioritizing asynchronous collaboration, with hiring focused in North and South America. Work where you’re strongest — we just want the best.

jobs.description: <p>As the story goes, in 1949 Frank McNamara finished dinner at a New York restaurant and found he'd left his wallet in another suit. His fix was a card that let members eat now and pay later. That card became Diners Club, widely credited as the first multipurpose charge card. It was a piece of cardboard and a promise: the restaurant trusted the card, the card trusted the member, and someone had to make sure the money actually moved.</p> <p>More than seventy-five years later, the promise hasn't changed, but the machinery has. When a Mercury customer taps their card, the request goes from the merchant's terminal through an acquirer and a card network to us. In a fraction of a second, we check the balance, apply the customer's spend controls, screen for fraud and say yes or no. After that comes clearing, settlement, disputes and reporting, and every cent has to reconcile.</p> <p>Cards <em>are</em> the way Mercury customers spend money. The Cards Integration team owns the whole Mercury card, not just the swipe: issuance, physical card shipping, spend controls, lifecycle management, authorization, money movement, settlement and reporting, and the infrastructure underneath. We're a full-stack team, and our job is to make the Mercury Debit and IO cards reliable, correct, useful, and innovative.</p> <p>We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer who thinks deeply about systems architecture, cares about the customer experience, and will dive into any problem to move the team forward. We value high ownership, working in pairs and teams rather than alone, and attention to detail. Those matter when you run systems held to four nines of reliability, and everyone around you will care about them too.</p> <p><strong>In this role, you will</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead projects from idea to tech spec to implementation to launch, working with your PM, EM, tech lead, and teammates at each stage. When you lead a project, it's yours to see through.</li> <li>Learn how debit and credit cards actually work under the hood (authorization, clearing, settlement, disputes) and use that knowledge every day.</li> <li>Build features across the stack, from the card experiences customers use to the backend systems that move money.</li> <li>Help keep our operations excellent. Our systems are some of the most observable at Mercury, and with great observability comes great responsibility.</li> <li>Mentor other engineers and raise engineering quality through design reviews, code reviews, and collaboration.</li> <li>Work with product, design, operations, risk, compliance, sales, and many other teams.</li> </ul> <p><strong>You should</strong></p> <ul> <li>Have strong full-stack experience, a product mindset, systems thinking, and a knack for getting things across the line.</li> <li>Have made architectural decisions on complex systems, and be able to explain your reasoning and the trade-offs.</li> <li>Be excited to put new features in customers' hands, and care just as much about keeping existing ones working like a charm.</li> <li>Care about correctness in systems where failure has real financial consequences.</li> <li>Communicate clearly, handle ambiguity well, and enjoy mentoring others.</li> <li>Be comfortable with our tech stack (Haskell and TypeScript) or be ready to learn.</li> <li>Bonus: experience in fintech, payments, or card issuing.</li> </ul> <p>We encourage you to try our <a href="https://demo.mercury.com/dashboard">demo site</a> if you're interested in applying for the role.</p> <p><em>*Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.</em></p> <p>Mercury values diversity &amp; belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All individuals seeking employment at Mercury are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities or special needs. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.</p> <p><span data-sheets-root="1">#LI-ES1</span></p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><strong>Total Rewards</strong><br>The total rewards package at Mercury includes base salary, equity (stock options/RSUs), and benefits.</p> <p>Our salary and equity ranges are highly competitive within the SaaS and fintech industry and are updated regularly using the most reliable compensation survey data for our industry. New hire offers are made based on a candidate’s experience, expertise, geographic location, and internal pay equity relative to peers.</p> <p>Our target new hire base salary ranges for this role are the following<strong>:</strong></p></div><div class="title">US employees (any location):</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$166,600</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>$208,300 USD</span></div></div><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">Canadian employees (any location):</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$157,400</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>$196,800 CAD</span></div></div></div>

jobs.description: WHO WE ARE AeroVect is transforming ground handling with autonomy, redefining how airlines and ground service providers around the globe run day-to-day operations. In this role, you'll be the technical backbone of the planning stack — owning the design and implementation of production-grade mission planning, behavior planning, and motion planning software. You'll work across the full planning pipeline to achieve category-defining vehicle autonomy for the airside, tackling hard problems in trajectory optimization, decision-making under uncertainty, and real-time constraint optimization. This opportunity offers a deeply technical engineer the chance to shape a market-defining enterprise product that combines autonomous vehicle technology with a robotics-as-a-service (RaaS) business model. You Have: - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Math, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, Physics, or a related field. - Extensive hands-on experience designing and implementing planning modules for autonomous systems shipped to production or deployed in real-world operations. - Strong programming skills in C++ (preferred) or Python, and experience with Linux-based operating systems. - Demonstrated ability to take ambiguous technical problems and drive them to well-architected solutions independently. - Excellent communication skills, proactiveness, and a strong sense of ownership. We Prefer: - MS or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Robotics, or a related field. - Mastery of Modern C++ (14 and beyond) and safety-critical coding practices (e.g., MISRA, ISO 26262). - 5+ years of industry experience in planning for robotic ground vehicles. - In-depth understanding of DDS frameworks like ROS/ROS2 or other networking middleware. - Experience in startup environments, demonstrating adaptability to rapidly changing priorities.

jobs.description: <p>In 1965, an engineer in Scotland was given a mundane task with a tricky problem to it - banks wanted to close on Saturdays and still serve customers, but they didn’t know how to solve authentication of the right user. James Goodfellow, working at Smiths Industries, uncovered the insight that you needed something you have (a card) and something you know (a PIN). Because someone told him they could only remember 4 digits instead of his proposed 6, today over 3 million ATMs use a card+4 digit PIN over 60 years later.&nbsp;</p> <p>Like the ATM, Mercury is building technology that pushes forward financial interfaces for the long term. Command is Mercury's LLM-powered financial assistant, launched to all customers in June 2026. It lets users understand their finances and take action in plain language, from asking about cash flow to sending payments, issuing cards, and managing invoices. With the product now in customers' hands, the work is to evolve it, extend its capabilities, and find new ways to leverage LLMs to give Mercury customers a more powerful banking* experience.</p> <h3><strong>What You'll Do:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Ship new capabilities users love</li> <li>Feel a strong sense of product ownership and actively seek responsibility – help design and ship new Command skills</li> <li>Partner with product and compliance teams to define what "working correctly" means for each new capability, then build the tests that prove it</li> <li>Join a small but mighty team of experienced product and AI engineers building the future of Mercury</li> <li>This list is illustrative. Command is a product in motion and priorities will shift as we learn. The right person should be comfortable working in ambiguity, in a scrappy startup environment</li> </ul> <h3><strong>The Ideal Candidate:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Has 1-4 years of backend or full-stack development experience, with knowledge of or excitement to learn Haskell, React, TypeScript, and Redux</li> <li>Experience building LLM powered products</li> <li>A builder who is passionately product-minded and has experience building and shipping new products</li> <li>Empathizes with users and can channel their perspective to build lovable products</li> <li>Can balance tradeoffs and find creative solutions to accomplish goals</li> <li>Actively incorporates AI tools into their workflow and is excited about leveraging them to amplify their impact — whether that's accelerating development, improving code quality, or finding creative solutions to hard problems</li> </ul> <p>If this role interests you, we invite you to explore our public demo at <a href="http://demo.mercury.com">demo.mercury.com</a>.</p> <p>Mercury values diversity &amp; belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All individuals seeking employment at Mercury are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities or special needs. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.</p> <p>#LI-RA1</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><strong>Total Rewards</strong><br>The total rewards package at Mercury includes base salary, equity (stock options/RSUs), and benefits.</p> <p>Our salary and equity ranges are highly competitive within the SaaS and fintech industry and are updated regularly using the most reliable compensation survey data for our industry. New hire offers are made based on a candidate’s experience, expertise, geographic location, and internal pay equity relative to peers.</p> <p>Our target new hire base salary ranges for this role are the following<strong>:</strong></p></div><div class="title">US employees (any location):</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$122,400</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>$176,000 USD</span></div></div><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">Canadian employees (any location):</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$115,700</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>$166,399 CAD</span></div></div></div>

jobs.description: ABOUT JUNIPER SQUARE Private markets are one of the largest, most complex, and most underserved corners of global finance. Our mission at Juniper Square is to unlock their full potential. We’re the Operations Partner trusted by 2,300+ GPs, unifying technology, data, and fund administration services into a single platform that helps GPs move faster, make better decisions, and scale with precision. With $300B+ under administration and 700,000+ LPs on platform, we’ve built the scale to match our ambition. And with JunieAI, our purpose-built AI platform, we’re reimagining how private markets operate, embedding intelligence across every workflow. Founder-led since 2014, backed by $350M+ in funding, and now 1,000+ employees strong, we’re building a company designed to shape the future of private markets for decades to come. Our culture is built for people who want to do ambitious, meaningful work alongside exceptionally talented teammates. We think like owners, move with urgency, and take pride in solving hard problems that truly matter to our customers and the future of private markets. We believe the best ideas come from open debate, deep collaboration, and diverse perspectives, which is why we believe transparency is the default and feedback makes us stronger. If you’re energized by high standards, rapid growth, and the opportunity to help define a category at a pivotal moment, come join us! Juniper Square offers employees a variety of ways to work, ranging from a fully remote experience to working full-time in one of our physical offices. We invest heavily in digital-first https://blog.junipersquare.com/juniper-square-ponders-future-of-office-with-digital-first-hybrid-workplace-strategy/ operations, allowing our teams to collaborate effectively across 27 U.S. states, 2 Canadian Provinces, India, Luxembourg, and England. We also have physical offices in San Francisco, New York City, Mumbai and Bangalore for employees who prefer to work in an office some or all of the time. ABOUT YOUR ROLE As Juniper Square's R&D organization grows globally, we're adding senior technical product leaders. We're looking for an experienced product manager who does well in technically complex problem spaces that cut across teams. In this role, you will own capabilities that benefit teams across the company, where reaching our business goals depends on cross-functional collaboration and leadership. You'll shape the vision, turn it into a roadmap, and drive adoption across the organization, while holding a high bar for quality and security. You'll own a business or product domain end to end, with direct impact on Juniper Square's growth. You'll bring a product mindset to everything you own and operate autonomously in a fast-growing, global R&D organization. In line with our values, you'll bring first-principles thinking to your domain and put clients first in every decision. You should be comfortable taking an active part in technical discussions and be curious about technical topics. Many people come to this role after working as engineers, but that isn't required. We'll decide your specific area during the interview process, based on your experience and business priorities. WHAT YOU’LL DO - Lead a large, technically complex product area: define success, prioritize problems and set strategy with the wider company in view - Identify the most significant near- and long-term opportunities in your area, and build consensus on how to sequence them against engineering capacity, risk and business priorities - Treat shared capabilities as first-class internal products, with clear documentation and a path teams can adopt instead of building their own - Set adoption and reliability expectations, and track how consistently teams build on shared capabilities - Bring tradeoffs such as build versus buy, technical debt and sequencing into architecture discussions with engineering leadership - Research and benchmark industry practices and new technology, including AI, and turn the findings into strategy - Build and maintain feedback channels with stakeholders inside and outside R&D, and use that input to prioritize - Define success metrics, track KPIs, and adjust strategy as you learn and as conditions change - Lead by influence: inspire other teams with your technical vision, earn their trust and drive adoption QUALIFICATIONS - 8+ years of experience as a product manager or in a similar role, with at least 5 years on technical platform, data or infrastructure products - Demonstrated experience owning horizontal shared capabilities used by multiple teams, with a focus on driving adoption - Demonstrated experience working on technically complex solutions, finding clean and enduring designs for these problems that scale - Exceptional oral and written communication skills, and comfort explaining complex technical concepts to a wide range of stakeholders within and outside the R&D organization - Track record of operating with high autonomy in ambiguous scope Preferred Qualifications - Prior experience as an engineer - Concrete examples of using LLM-based agents to automate real-world workflows COMPENSATION Compensation for this position includes a base salary, equity and a variety of benefits. The U.S. base salary range for this role is $200,000 - $230,000 USD. Actual base salaries will be based on candidate-specific factors, including experience, skillset, and location, and local minimum pay requirements as applicable. Benefits include: - Health, dental, and vision care for you and your family - Life insurance - Mental wellness coverage - Fertility and growing family support - Flex Time Off in addition to company-paid holidays - Paid family leave, medical leave, and bereavement leave policies - Retirement saving plans - Allowance to customize your work and technology setup at home - Annual professional development stipend Your recruiter can provide additional details about compensation and benefits.

jobs.description: WHO WE ARE Welcome to TELUS Digital https://www.telusdigital.com/— where innovation drives impact at a global scale. As an award-winning digital product consultancy and the digital division of TELUS https://www.telus.com/en/, one of Canada’s largest telecommunications providers, we design and deliver transformative customer experiences through cutting-edge technology, agile thinking, and a people-first culture. With a global team across North America, South America, Central America, Europe, and APAC, we offer end-to-end expertise across eight core service areas: Digital Product Consulting, Digital Marketing Services, Data & AI, Strategy Consulting, Business Operations Modernization, Enterprise Applications, Cloud Engineering, and QA & Test Engineering. From mobile apps and websites to voice UI, chatbots, AI, customer service, and in-store solutions, TELUS Digital enables seamless, trusted, and digitally powered experiences that meet customers wherever they are — all backed by the secure infrastructure and scale of our multi-billion-dollar parent company. THE OPPORTUNITY We believe the best ideas come from shared creativity. What sets us apart from other agencies is that our engineers sit right beside researchers and creatives, so perspectives from multiple disciplines shape our products. Our summer internship program gives current students the chance to make an impact by contributing ideas and adding a fresh perspective to real client projects, all while receiving one-on-one mentoring from our full-time team members. Not only that, but you’ll have snacks galore, and plenty of chances to socialize with your fellow interns — including fun outings during work hours. YOUR IMPACT - Your day-to-day contributions will support real client work, helping TELUS Digital deliver technical excellence for the stakeholders who depend on us - You’ll have the opportunity to learn every day from engineering leadership - You’ll build amazing products people love - You’ll participate in the delivery of large and complex software projects in a team-based environment YOUR BACKGROUND - You plan to graduate in December 2027 or later - Have experience with mobile or web development (Swift, Java, Kotlin, TypeScript, Javascript, etc.) - You’ve done a mobile or web project in school, at a previous internship, or in your spare time - You have experience integrating AI technology into your development process - You're a self-starter who embraces new technologies - You're intellectually curious and enjoy digging into what makes each platform unique - You are committed to delivering quality code for best-in-class digital experiences - You appreciate good design and have an eye for details P.S. We will only use the information you provide to process your application and to produce tracking statistics. Since we do not request personal data deemed sensitive, we ask you to abstain from sharing that information with us. For more information on how we use your information, see our Privacy Policy https://www.telusdigital.com/privacy-policy.

jobs.description: BUILDING THE FUTURE OF OPEN FINANCE Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system. THE TEAM Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients. We're looking for a Sr. Data Analyst, Compliance to join our team remotely! The primary goal of this role is to elevate decision-making by uncovering emerging trends and root causes, and by driving insights and actions that provide full visibility into business performance and operational efficiency. Beyond technical expertise, success in this role depends on being a true business partner who combines data-driven insights with strategic thinking to deliver actionable recommendations, guide decision-making, and drive measurable impact across the organization. In this role, you'll own end-to-end data management, from building and maintaining datasets and pipelines to designing dashboards and delivering insights for the Compliance team. A core part of this role is owning the logic and rule-setting behind transaction monitoring across deposits and withdrawals. You'll also contribute to experimentation infrastructure, laying the groundwork for future ML and intelligence initiatives. THE OPPORTUNITY - Own the logic and rule-setting behind transaction monitoring across deposits and withdrawals, partnering closely with Compliance to study patterns and refine detection logic - Translate compliance requirements into production detection logic, preserving correctness across alert eligibility, thresholds, customer segmentation, date windows, and deduplication - Develop and maintain Python and SQL pipelines for transaction data preparation, feature engineering, and detection workflows - Evaluate detection rules and analytical models across coverage, alert quality, threshold sensitivity, and the impact of proposed changes - Design reproducible evaluations on historical data that account for limited labels, class imbalance, and shifts in customer behaviour over time - Own testing, deployment, scheduling, monitoring, and operational support for detection workflows, including investigating data quality issues, pipeline failures, and unexpected changes in detection results - Execute historical backfills with clear validation and traceability, and maintain reliable downstream alert delivery and integrations with compliance systems - Be at the forefront of data innovation by experimenting, testing hypotheses, and translating insights into action, while incorporating software engineering best practices into pipelines and dashboards. WHAT YOU BRING - 7+ years of experience in data analysis, data science, and data management within the fintech, crypto, financial services, or gambling industry, gained in a fast-paced, high-growth environment - Experience working with compliance, fraud, funding, finance, and customer support teams and analyzing large datasets, engineering features, and applying statistical methods to practical business problems - Strong Python and SQL skills, with experience building and supporting production data or analytical systems - Hands-on experience using dbt or similar tooling to model and organize high-fidelity data for reporting and decision-making - Experience setting up and managing data pipelines with a strong understanding of workflow orchestration, plus strong software engineering practices including version control, automated testing, code review, and CI/CD - Solid statistical foundation; ML exposure is a strong plus - Proficiency with BI and data visualization tools (e.g., Hex, Tableau, Power BI, or similar) to build executive-facing dashboards - Ability to investigate production issues independently and communicate technical findings and uncertainty to non-technical stakeholders - You believe wholeheartedly in the values outlined in Kraken's Tentaclements document - A degree in a field emphasizing analytical rigor, such as analytics, software engineering, statistics, or economics - Based in Canada, the US, or Brazil, and fluent in English NICE TO HAVES - Fraud detection, AML, anomaly detection, or other risk applications - Experience with Athena, Trino, Kafka, and Kubernetes alongside the core Airflow/dbt/S3 stack - Transaction pattern analysis, customer segmentation, and detection threshold tuning - Developing or productionising machine learning models, including experiment tracking and performance monitoring - Working with sparse or delayed feedback from investigations to evaluate and improve detection - Explainability, auditability, and change control in regulated environments Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution. We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. OUR COMMITMENT Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto. We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision. As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. jobs.description: MaintainX is a leading mobile-first work execution platform for industrial and frontline teams. More than 15,000 customers, including McDonalds, Michaels, Cintas, Redimix, and U.S. LBM, use MaintainX to cut unplanned downtime and run better operations, across 16 million managed assets and 92 million completed work orders. In August 2026 MaintainX became part of Autodesk, joining Autodesk Operations Solutions https://adsknews.autodesk.com/en/views/inside-autodesk-operations-solutions/, the organization unifying Autodesk's operations platform alongside Tandem, FlexSim and Fusion Operations. Autodesk's strategy is to converge design, make and operate into one continuous lifecycle: design an asset, build it, run it, then feed what you learn running it back into the next design. Autodesk had design and make. Operate is the phase that tells you what actually happened, and it is ours. THE ROLE We're looking for multiple Software Development Managers to lead one of several engineering teams. As a Dev Manager at MaintainX, you're the person who turns a roadmap into shipped, reliable software. You'll manage 5 to 6 developers, own delivery and quality for your team's area, and make the calls that keep a group of builders moving without losing the craft. This is a single hiring pipeline across our product and platform teams. Teams currently looking for new leadership include: - Reporting: Own the product surface where customers measure the value of MaintainX, turning millions of work orders and asset events into the dashboards and insights that maintenance leaders bring to their execs. It's a high-visibility team with a direct line from what you ship to why customers renew. - Identity & Access Management: Build the systems that power secure and seamless access across the MaintainX platform. You'd design and operate authentication, authorization, and governance services that scale with our enterprise customers and keep user experience frictionless and trusted. - Search: Design and build MaintainX’s end-to-end search and retrieval platform. Work across indexing, ranking, and semantic retrieval so technicians and managers find the right asset, procedure, or work order in seconds. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Manage a team of 5 to 6 developers: own their delivery, quality, and day-to-day priorities. - Partner with Product Managers and Designers to scope, plan, and deliver against a high bar for reliability. - Coach and grow your developers: help them build skills, navigate hard problems, and plan their next career step. - Shape who joins next. All these teams are hiring and need a leader who will interview and raise our talent bar. - Set clear expectations and give ongoing feedback, so your team always knows where it stands. - Champion CI/CD, code quality, and observability practices across your team's systems. - Give senior leadership visibility into your team's impact, progress, and risk. WHERE WE WORK We don't have a minimum in-office mandate, but we prefer our teams to be located around our office hubs. In Canada this includes: Montreal and Toronto. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - 2-3 years of people leadership experience, with a track record of leading teams that ship. - A strong technical foundation. You should be comfortable performing at a senior level with system design, computer science fundamentals, and modern web technologies. - Experience with technical design, problem-solving, and project management (Jira experience preferred). - A genuine interest in hiring, coaching, and developing engineers, not just directing them. - Comfort partnering with Recruiting and other managers to hire and scale the org. - Excellent communication: you can carry a tradeoff conversation with an engineer and a non-technical stakeholder equally well. Our mission is to keep the physical world running. Factories, fleets, hospitals and campuses stay up because the people who maintain them have tools worth using. That is what we build. Compensation and benefits. Base pay is one part of the package. Depending on the role, compensation may also include commission, an annual bonus and equity. Benefits differ by country. For roles in the United States, Autodesk’s benefits are described at benefits.autodesk.com http://benefits.autodesk.com. For roles in Canada and other countries, the plan differs on health coverage, retirement and leave, and your recruiter will walk you through it. Belonging. We take pride in a culture where everyone can thrive. More at autodesk.com/company/global-belonging http://autodesk.com/company/global-belonging. More on where this is going: Autodesk CEO Andrew Anagnost on building the future of connected operations https://adsknews.autodesk.com/en/news/building-the-future-of-connected-operations/, and AOS SVP Stephen Hooper on welcoming MaintainX to Autodesk https://adsknews.autodesk.com/en/views/inside-autodesk-operations-solutions/.

jobs.description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.</p></div><h4><strong>About the Product Team</strong></h4> <p>The Product team listens to our customers’ needs and translates those insights into a clear product vision. The team works closely with design, engineering, and analytics to build scalable financial products that empower people to manage their money with confidence. We rely on empathy, curiosity, and business sense to prioritize features and improve experiences. Our role is to lead with clarity, support cross-functional execution, and champion the user in every decision.</p> <h4><strong>About the Role</strong></h4> <p>The ZT1 Labs group is a small, senior team of product and engineering experts working directly with the CEO on the company’s most important new bets. This team takes on highly ambiguous, cross-functional problems where the upside is company-defining.</p> <p>We are looking for a Group Product Manager to lead a portfolio of ZT1 initiatives in a hands-on builder role, with direct product ownership and with no direct people management responsibilities. You will own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for new products and platforms, partnering closely with engineers, analysts, and designers to build and launch, and with revenue and business teams to bring new products to market and scale.</p> <p>You’ll work closely with the CEO and executive team to turn high-level ideas into durable, scalable businesses.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What You Will Do</strong></p> <p>Understand Customers &amp; Strategic Context:&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li> <p>Build a deep understanding of Affirm’s global network of users, merchants, and partners.</p> </li> <li> <p>Connect customer insights and market trends to long-term company strategy to identify where zero-to-one innovation can drive outsized impact.</p> </li> <li> <p>Track relevant product, technology, and industry shifts and use them to inform product direction.</p> </li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;Set Vision, Strategy, and Roadmap</p> <ul> <li> <p>Partner with the CEO and senior leaders to define problem spaces and opportunity areas that matter most for Affirm’s future.</p> </li> <li> <p>Craft a clear product vision and strategic narrative for the innovation portfolio, translating that into a focused and prioritized roadmap.</p> </li> <li> <p>Define crisp outcomes and success metrics tied directly to business impact (GMV, profitability, conversion, retention, long-term moat).&nbsp;</p> </li> </ul> <p>Lead Zero-to-One Product Development</p> <ul> <li> <p>Drive the full lifecycle for new products and platforms: discovery, validation, MVP definition, launch, and iteration.</p> </li> <li> <p>Own the full UI/UX, using AI tools to build and iterate on working prototypes that make product ideas tangible and testable.</p> </li> <li> <p>Write and refine customer-facing copy across the product experience, from onboarding to in-product guidance.</p> </li> <li> <p>Independently analyze customer behavior, build funnels, and use data to identify opportunities and guide product decisions.</p> </li> <li> <p>Own experimentation end to end, including hypotheses, test design, success metrics, results analysis, and iteration.</p> </li> <li> <p>Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to sync ZT1 roadmaps with core product roadmaps, ensuring high product quality, an aligned user experience, and cohesive business results.</p> </li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;Cross-Functional &amp; Executive Leadership</p> <ul> <li> <p>Lead a cross-functional group (engineering, design, data, risk, capital, operations, revenue, legal and compliance) through ambiguous and complex work.</p> </li> <li> <p>Serve as a thought partner to the CEO and executive team on new product bets, tradeoffs, and prioritization.</p> </li> <li> <p>Communicate clearly and often - framing decisions, risks, and tradeoffs; writing high-quality docs; and maintaining alignment across teams.</p> </li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;Raise the Bar for Product Craft</p> <ul> <li> <p>Establish product patterns, decision frameworks, and execution standards that make zero-to-one work repeatable and scalable.</p> </li> <li> <p>Model strong product thinking, rigor, and judgment for senior peers without managing them directly.</p> </li> <li> <p>Help shape the culture and operating model of the ZT1 function.<br>&nbsp;</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>What We Look For</strong></p> <p>Experience</p> <ul> <li> <p>~8–10+ years of product management experience with a strong track record shipping and scaling consumer-facing or platform products.</p> </li> <li> <p>Previous ownership of technical software products end-to-end and ability to clearly articulate the business impact.</p> </li> <li> <p>Direct experience leading zero-to-one or highly ambiguous product areas with meaningful outcomes.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience working closely with engineering, data, design, and other teams without direct authority.</p> </li> <li> <p>Skilled at operating in complex environments where success depends on coordinating cross-functional work across multiple groups.&nbsp;</p> </li> <li> <p>Founder or early-stage startup experience is a plus. Ability to spot opportunities, build from scratch, test quickly, and take ownership of outcomes.<br><br></p> </li> </ul> <p>Skills</p> <ul> <li> <p>Hands-on fluency with AI tools for prototyping, design, content, and analysis, with the judgment to evaluate and refine the output.</p> </li> <li> <p>Comfortable doing the work directly without dedicated design, analytics, or content partners.</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong communicator capable of securing alignment and decisions from broad groups of senior stakeholders with differing priorities.</p> </li> <li> <p>Adept at influencing engineering teams outside your reporting line - able to guide them toward building what the product needs.</p> </li> <li> <p>High judgment in ambiguous spaces - able to take incomplete or conflicting information and turn it into a clear, actionable plan.</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong commercial instincts - able to contribute to pitches, negotiations, and contract evaluations when product work intersects with business strategy.</p> </li> </ul> <p>Behaviors &amp; Traits</p> <ul> <li> <p>Bias toward action; cares about unblocking teams and driving meaningful progress quickly.</p> </li> <li> <p>Comfortable moving between strategy and execution - from long-term roadmap thinking to writing specs or digging into edge cases.</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong organizational discipline and interpersonal skills, able to navigate complex dynamics while maintaining momentum.</p> </li> <li>

jobs.description: ABOUT THE ROLE Hi, I'm Vivek, and I lead Product Growth at Jane. I've spent the last decade building and scaling growth engines at high-growth companies, and I joined Jane this year to build our first dedicated Growth group. I care about teams that stay close to the customer, ship often, and learn from every release so we can build things clinics couldn't have asked for yet. Our mission is Activation. Most clinics set up Jane on their own, and those first weeks shape everything that follows. When a clinic gets up and running early, it tends to stay with us for years, and when that early experience is right, Jane grows. It's one of the most important problems in the company, and we're giving it a dedicated team with one clear outcome. The work spans improving the onboarding clinics use today and building a brand new agentic onboarding experience alongside it, for tens of thousands of clinics that each run a little differently. That's where you come in. I'm looking for an AI-first Development Manager to lead the developers on this team, with product, design, and data right beside you. You build with AI, you stay close to the architecture and the code, and the people around you get better at building with AI because you're there. You have opinions about what an agentic world could do for practitioners, and you want to test them with real clinics. If leading a team that ships every week and watches clinics get going because of it sounds like fun, I'd love to meet you. WHAT IMPACT WE’RE LOOKING FOR YOU TO MAKE - Lead and grow a team of developers, coaching each person on their technical and professional skills so they keep building their craft and their career. - Build alongside the team by reviewing architecture, pairing, and shipping, so technical depth stays one of the group's real strengths. - Own Activation as an outcome with your partners in product, design, and data, and change course when something ships but doesn't help clinics get going. - Bring a point of view to our direction on AI-driven onboarding, from how to frame the problem to what to build first and where we need better infrastructure. - Shape how the team ships, with small weekly releases, instrumentation that shows what actually happened, and experiments designed to teach us something either way. - Champion pragmatic, responsible AI adoption by trying every tool, pushing on it, learning how the team uses it, and bringing the same care to the AI experiences we build for clinics. - Partner closely with the teams around us, including Jane AI, our AI assistant teams, and other core product teams, so clinics get one connected experience. WHAT EXPERIENCE WE NEED - You started out as a hands-on software developer and have since grown into leading a development team as a people manager. - You still write and review code and want to keep doing it, and you're comfortable weighing architectural tradeoffs and guiding technical direction alongside senior and staff developers. - You've worked on a growth or product-led growth team and owned an outcome like activation or conversion, including at least one stretch where the work shipped and the number didn't move. - You've taken an AI product from idea to customers and on to revenue, owning it end to end, and you have a clear view of where AI earned its place and where it didn't. - You know what good instrumentation looks like and have run experiments properly, including calling it when the result isn't there yet. - You love coaching and can share a couple of good examples of helping people on your team grow. - You open conversations rather than wait for them, and you're comfortable offering a view and being wrong about it in the room. - Experience in healthcare or other vertical SaaS is a nice bonus, though it isn't required. If you don’t meet every single qualification but are excited about this role, we’d still love to hear from you. MORE ABOUT JANE Jane is a founder-led, high-growth SaaS company with a remote-first team working across Canada, the US, and the UK, united by our mission to help the helpers. We build the products and tools that thousands of clinics rely on every day to run their businesses, care for their patients, and grow their communities. That level of impact means every person at Jane plays an important role in how we show up for our customers. We're all responsible for being deeply connected to their needs, obsessed with improving their experience, and proud of the difference our work makes in their day-to-day lives. Jane is growing fast, and that growth brings exciting challenges that call for adaptability, resilience, learning agility, and humility. We're proud of what we've built and quick to admit what we don't know yet. We listen, learn, and adjust as we go. More than 70,000 businesses run on Jane which has 250,000+ practitioners interacting with our product on a daily basis and growth is continuing to accelerate. Our goal isn't just delivery - it's delight. We move quickly, communicate openly, and solve real problems together. If you're energized by ambiguity, motivated by impact, and eager to learn with others, you'll thrive at Jane. COMPENSATION & BENEFITS At Jane, we believe in paying fairly, clearly, and for growth. Our salary bands are intentionally wide, reflecting the full journey someone takes in a role, with real room to grow as your impact deepens over time. Most new hires join at the accomplished stage, with salaries above that typically reflecting existing team members who've made significant impact and built deep Jane-specific knowledge. For this role, accomplished looks like: - 🇨🇦 Canada: $158,400 to $247,500 CAD (accomplished: ~$188,100 CAD) - 🇺🇸 United States: $168,000 to $262,500 USD (accomplished: ~$199,500 USD) This role also includes equity through our JSOP (Jane Stock Option Plan). Our stock has grown 11x over the past six years, with three opportunities to exercise options along the way. Jane was valued at $1.8B in May 2025, and with the backing of TCV https://betakit.com/jane-software-to-be-reportedly-valued-at-1-8-billion-in-upcoming-secondary-financing/, we have ambitious plans ahead. You can explore our benefits package here: Canadian Benefits https://jane.app/documents/hiring/jane_benefits_overview.pdf · US Benefits https://www.notion.so/janeapp/US-Benefits-Candidate-Facing-319378ecd68380838032d1cd0224351d We look forward to hearing from you. Jane takes job scams and candidate fraud seriously. Jane will only contact you from an @jane.app http://jane.app email address. We'll never contact you from a personal email, ask for payment, or request purchases during the hiring process. If something doesn't seem right, please reach out to us at hiring@jane.app before sharing any personal information.

jobs.description: WHO ARE WE? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems. We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! WHY THIS ROLE? We’re building the foundational infrastructure that will define how the world thinks about and deploys AI, and we want the sharpest, most driven, and most curious people to help us do it. As the head of the Data Foundation pillar of our Analytics and Data Insights team, you’ll lead the team that makes Cohere’s data trustworthy, governed, and available: the warehouse every analytics surface runs on, the pipelines that keep it fresh, the access model that keeps it secure, and the agentic analytics layer that lets anyone at Cohere (and their agents) ask questions of governed data directly. Your team owns the full data lifecycle. You’ll run ingestion into BigQuery from internal and external data sources, orchestrate it in Airflow and Cloud Run, model the data warehouse in dbt, and serve the results through Looker, export APIs, and customer-facing analytics surfaces. Everything is provisioned as code in Terraform, and governance is part of the design: VPC service controls, IAM patterns, and documented access paths that let people and agents move fast without putting data at risk. This role is both highly visible and highly impactful, and you’ll inherit a solid structure on which to build the rest of the stack: a Terraform-provisioned warehouse framework, dbt modeling conventions, an alerting and incident-response practice, and documentation patterns to keep everything discoverable. The roadmap is set with big bets in flight: scaling that framework across the company, standing up an internal analytics agent with a real eval harness, and consolidating institutional knowledge into a self-correcting and self-maintaining system that keeps context centralized, current, and documented, rather than dispersed and in people’s heads. Responsibilities As the head of the Data Foundation pillar, you will: - Build and lead the team. Hire and grow a team of data and infrastructure engineers; set the technical bar; develop strong talent and raise team performance, building leadership capability beneath you. - Set the roadmap from company strategy. Own and sequence the Data Foundation roadmap: the warehouse buildout, the agentic analytics program, data governance, and the platform work that unblocks our other pillars. You’ll make the trade-offs and carry the cross-functional impact that comes with them. - Own the data platform end to end. Ingestion (managed connectors and an open-source connector framework), orchestration on Airflow and Cloud Run, warehouse modeling in BigQuery with dbt (raw, core, mart layers), and serving through Looker, export APIs, and semantic layers. All of it provisioned as code in Terraform. - Own data governance. Define how humans, service accounts, and agents get access to governed data: VPC service controls, IAM patterns, documented onboarding paths, audit logs, and sensitive requests (including legal holds) handled to deadline. - Operate for reliability. Run the alerting and anomaly-detection framework, own data freshness SLAs, lead incident response and postmortems, and turn every incident into a durable standard so the same class of failure doesn’t recur. - Lead the agentic analytics program. Wire the semantic layer into an internal analytics agent, build the eval harness that measures its accuracy, and make the eval-driven call on where AI earns its way into production. Apply the same discipline to automating data engineering work itself. - Set the standard for analytics across the company. The medallion framework, naming conventions, and testing patterns your team maintains become the way other teams ship analytics data. You’ll onboard new domains onto it and keep the docs accurate to how the systems actually work. - Partner across the org. Work with the North product and engineering teams on the analytics surfaces that ship in the product (including a customer-facing analytics export), with Business Insights on marts for the business, with Security on data governance, and with Legal on compliance-critical data requests. QUALIFICATIONS You may be a good fit, if you have: - 10+ years of experience across data engineering, data infrastructure, or analytics platform work, with a strong management track record leading data platform or infrastructure teams - Serious hands-on history in data engineering or infrastructure before management. You can still read a Terraform plan, a dbt DAG, or an Airflow scheduler log and ask the question that matters - Production experience with cloud data warehouses (BigQuery, Snowflake, or similar), workflow orchestration (Airflow or similar), and infrastructure as code (Terraform or similar) - Depth in data modeling: you think in fact and dimension tables, raw/core/mart separation, and semantic layers, and you have opinions on where tests and contracts belong - A record of setting a team’s roadmap from company or function strategy and delivering outcomes that span teams, with the cross-functional partnerships to match - Operational excellence you can point to: alerting you trust, SLAs you meet, incidents you run to ground and write up so they teach - Exposure to data security and governance: IAM, access management, VPC service controls or equivalent, audit and compliance workflows - Genuine excitement about AI: you follow the research, have opinions, and are energized by building the data foundation an AI company (and its AI agents) runs on - Comfort operating in ambiguity, leading a multi-workstream roadmap, and working directly with executives on priorities If some of the above doesn’t line up perfectly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply! FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS: - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch. - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health. - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme. - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent. - Annual enrichment benefits: Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit. Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching. - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!) - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite. HOW AND WHERE WE WORK: - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon. - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events. - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city. - Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly. If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12a6IrLdF3k

jobs.description: Waabi, founded by AI visionary Raquel Urtasun, is the leader in Physical AI. With a world-class team, we're unlocking the next era of autonomous transportation with technology that's powering commercial autonomous trucks and robotaxis. Waabi is backed by and partners with world leaders in AI, automotive, logistics, and deep tech. With offices in Toronto, San Francisco, Dallas, and Pittsburgh, Waabi is growing quickly and looking for diverse, innovative and collaborative candidates who want to impact the world in a positive way. To learn more visit: www.waabi.ai The Senior Technical Program Manager, Platform Software owns program-level execution for software across Waabi's hardware platforms, with a focus on cross-functional integration between physical infrastructure, onboard software, embedded systems, hardware platform and systems engineering teams. You are the connective tissue between teams that operate on fundamentally different cadences: embedded software with kanban-based delivery, onboard software releases, and hardware build and bring-up. You will surface where those cadences collide, identify gaps in requirements and execution, map the critical path accurately, and ensure risks are visible and owned so that all platform software for the trucks is created and ready on time. You will work closely with the Hardware Platform Managers and coordinate work across teams to help bring up different platforms. You will… Define and maintain integrated platform software program plans covering key milestones, cross-team dependencies, and ensure on-time delivery. Partner with Hardware Platform Managers to coordinate physical infrastructure, onboard software, and embedded systems work needed to bring up different platforms. Ensure all stakeholder inputs are captured and integrated into program plans before design commitments lock in. Build and enforce dependency maps across Physical Infrastructure, Onboard Software, Embedded Systems, Hardware and Operations, identify the critical path, and ensure every dependency has an owner and an ETA. Own reporting into executive forums. Surface risks early with data-backed Path to Green options. Track platform software releases, bring-up and test campaigns, ensuring test coverage, sign-off readiness, and milestone alignment across teams. Build cross-functional roadmaps that give physical infrastructure, onboard software, and embedded systems a shared line of sight on interdependencies and sequencing. Champion tools to capture the single source of truth for program work, ensuring consistency across programs. Build scalable tracking mechanisms and systematic processes that work at fleet scale. Technical breadth. Ask the right questions, spot unrealistic assumptions in a plan, and know when a dependency is a real blocker versus a process gap. You can engage with engineers across physical infrastructure, onboard software, hardware, vehicle reliability, systems engineering and embedded systems without needing to be a domain expert in any one area. Self-starter who builds processes from scratch. Build processes and iterate based on what actually works and impose structure without creating overhead. Cross-functional influencer. Work on highly cross functional programs spanning physical infrastructure, onboard software, embedded systems, and hardware. Risk-first mindset. Surface problems early, escalate without hesitation, and always arrive with options. You can dive deep and bring clarity to status updates and a Path to Green. Comfort with ambiguity. Thrive in bringing clarity and structure to ambiguity and convert ambitious goals into programs with hard success criteria, DRIs, and trackable milestones. Qualifications 5+ years of technical program management experience, with a strong focus on cross-functional software integration programs for hardware platforms. Demonstrated experience working across teams with meaningfully different development cadences (e.g., robotics, autonomous vehicles, industrial automation, IoT, or defense systems). Possess a deep understanding of software development lifecycles. Proven ability to build cross-functional program structure from scratch: dependency maps, risk registries, executive reporting, and milestone tracking. Strong written and verbal communication. You can write a crisp one-pager for an executive audience and facilitate a working-level dependency review with engineers in the same week. Experience in autonomous vehicles or robotics. Familiarity with embedded systems and software development and the constraints that come with it. Hands-on experience with program tracking tools like Jira, Asana and Microsoft Project. Preferred Qualifications Experience with onboard compute bring-up, physical infrastructure, or hardware-in-the-loop testing. Familiarity with hardware development and systems and safety processes, and how they affect software delivery timelines. Working understanding of automotive development process (eg ASPICE) and how to adapt it to a nimble environment Experience establishing or scaling a triage process for field issues across engineering teams. Background in systems engineering, computer engineering, electrical engineering, or a related technical discipline.

jobs.description: ABOUT BASETEN Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma, and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F https://www.baseten.co/blog/announcing-our-series-f/, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to ship AI products. THE ROLE The largest, most demanding enterprises run on Baseten, and they bring exacting requirements for how people, services, and agents access the platform. This is the founding role for our identity and authorization team within enterprise engineering. You'll own the identity and access layer of the Baseten platform: the authorization model, credential systems, and admin experiences that enterprise IT teams use to govern access for organizations like Harvey, HubSpot, and Notion. You'll design and build Baseten's fine-grained authorization system from the ground up to support the workflows customers depend on today while giving them cleaner, more precise ways to manage access as the platform grows. Authorization at Baseten requires low-latency permission checks at high request volume, consistent contracts and behaviors across the product suite, and strong security guarantees for mission-critical, highly regulated workloads. EXAMPLE INITIATIVES Recent and upcoming work in this area: - Fine-grained authorization for users, service accounts, and agentic workloads: per-resource permissions at the organization, team, and workload scope to support both common workflows and complex enterprise access policies - Programmatic authentication allowing high-compliance customers to connect service principles securely via short-lived, workload-based credentials - Agent credentials that grant an agent exactly the access it needs for the given task and nothing more - Enterprise identity lifecycle including single sign-on, SCIM provisioning, and per-organization session expiry policies - Admin controls for centralized visibility, auditability, and governance over credentials, roles, and access RESPONSIBILITIES - Lead identity and authorization projects from problem definition and technical design through implementation, launch, and iteration. - Design authorization and credential models that support critical user workflows today and can be safely extended as the platform evolves. - Partner with product, design, and customer-facing teams to turn enterprise security requirements into durable technical solutions. - Establish engineering practices for quality, security, observability, and operational ownership. - Provide technical leadership and mentorship as the team grows. REQUIREMENTS - 4-5+ years of experience building production backend systems, including hands-on design and implementation of a product authorization system: per-resource or per-object permissions, relationship-based access control, a policy engine, or a fine-grained authorization system in the style of Zanzibar, OpenFGA, SpiceDB, or Cedar. - Demonstrated end-to-end ownership: you've taken a system from first design through implementation, production rollout, and iteration with users. - Experience developing and operating multi-tenant systems at scale, where authorization checks sit in the request path and latency and consistency matter. - Comfort working across the full stack, from product and application code to cloud and Kubernetes infrastructure. NICE TO HAVE - Experience with Python and Go. - Experience running an OpenFGA, SpiceDB, or similar deployment in production, beyond a proof of concept. - Working knowledge of OAuth, OIDC, and SCIM at the protocol level. BENEFITS - Competitive compensation, including meaningful equity - (U.S. only) 100% coverage of medical, dental, and vision insurance for employee and dependents - Flexible PTO policy - Paid parental leave - Fertility and family-building stipend through Carrot - (U.S. only) Company-facilitated 401(k) - Exposure to a variety of ML startups, offering unparalleled learning and networking opportunities. Apply now to embark on a rewarding journey in shaping the future of AI! If you are a motivated individual with a passion for machine learning and a desire to be part of a collaborative and forward-thinking team, we would love to hear from you. At Baseten, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable law (by example, the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, where applicable).

jobs.position: Senior Principal Software Developer, Mobile Platform
jobs.description: MaintainX is a leading mobile-first work execution platform for industrial and frontline teams. More than 15,000 customers, including McDonalds, Michaels, Cintas, Redimix, and U.S. LBM, use MaintainX to cut unplanned downtime and run better operations, across 16 million managed assets and 92 million completed work orders. In August 2026 MaintainX became part of Autodesk, joining Autodesk Operations Solutions https://adsknews.autodesk.com/en/views/inside-autodesk-operations-solutions/, the organization unifying Autodesk's operations platform alongside Tandem, FlexSim and Fusion Operations. Autodesk's strategy is to converge design, make and operate into one continuous lifecycle: design an asset, build it, run it, then feed what you learn running it back into the next design. Autodesk had design and make. Operate is the phase that tells you what actually happened, and it is ours. You'd be joining our Mobile Platform team within the Platform Engineering division. We're building an AI-native platform for our internal developers, over 150 of them, guided by a single question: does this shorten the time from idea to value, for the teams building on our platform and for the customers they ultimately serve? The smooth path is the safe, fast path, because the platform makes it the default. We build the route that maximizes AI acceleration. You'll shape the technical direction for how Mobile features get built, shipped, and operated across the engineering org, not just for one team. What you’ll do - Define and drive the multi-year technical strategy, governance and architecture for our mobile platform, balancing near-term developer pain with long-term scalability. - Design and build critical foundations and tooling that power our Mobile app, and set the bar for quality through hands-on contributions to the hardest problems. - Lead the consolidation and evolution of platform primitives: SDKs, CI pipelines, build tooling, release trains, observability, and agentic development golden paths. - Champion AI-native ways of working, embedding AI workflows into your own practice, into the platform, and into how our feature teams build and ship. - Raise engineering excellence standards across the organization through architectural reviews, RFCs, and technical mentorship of senior engineers and tech leads. - Partner with Platform Engineering managers across multiple teams to set priorities, shape roadmaps, and align on cross-team technical direction. - Define success metrics for the platform (adoption, build times, release velocity, developer satisfaction) and use them to guide investment and communicate impact. - Present technical priorities, trade-offs, and results to executive stakeholders, and collaborate daily with engineering leaders across the company. About you - 10+ years of software engineering experience, including significant experience in mobile engineering, with a track record of technical leadership at the staff, principal, or equivalent level. - A strong AI-native mindset. You've brought AI-assisted workflows into a platform or org, not just your own workflow. - Deep expertise in React Native, including its architecture, performance, and native integration (iOS and Android). - Proven success designing and driving adoption of shared modules, SDKs, and reusable components used across many teams. - Strong expertise in Mobile foundations: CI/CD, build systems, release management, code signing and distribution, and mobile observability. - A history of influencing technical direction across teams and organizations without relying on formal authority, including leading cross-team initiatives from proposal to adoption. - A product mindset toward internal platforms: you understand your customers, measure adoption, and make pragmatic build-vs-buy decisions. - Excellent mentorship and communication skills, with the ability to coach senior engineers and translate complex technical topics for executive audiences. - Expert-level English, spoken and written, as you’ll lead platform engineering managers across multiple teams, present technical priorities to executive stakeholders, and align daily with engineering leaders outside Québec. Our mission is to keep the physical world running. Factories, fleets, hospitals and campuses stay up because the people who maintain them have tools worth using. That is what we build.
