jobs.description: WHAT WE ARE BUILDING Mimica https://www.mimica.ai/careers is an AI-powered process intelligence platform enabling enterprises and individuals to reclaim their most precious resource: time. We've all seen repetitive tasks and redundant processes quietly drain productivity and creativity. Not because companies don’t want to become more efficient, but because they don’t know where to start. Mimica automatically analyzes your team’s work, then generates the AI agents to execute it. Our software turns everyday work into data-backed decisions, helping companies remove process bottlenecks, automate the right tasks, and upskill teams with precision and confidence. We’ve raised $26 million in Series B financing and are scaling fast. Backed by investors including Khosla Ventures and Paladin Capital, our proprietary AI technology is trusted by Fortune 500 companies to accelerate transformation. Mimica is recognized as a Top 100 AI Start-up by Accel and an industry Leader by the Everest Group. Our team Behind our platform is a team of exceptionally talented people, remote-first and globally distributed across 16+ countries. We're looking for curious, collaborative people excited to solve complex problems. You'll join a fast-paced environment built on high ownership, bottom-up thinking, and transparent, open communication – helping some of the world's leading organizations transform the way work gets done with AI. OUR APPROACH TO ENGINEERING - We prioritize customer needs first - We work in small, project-based teams - We have flexibility in terms of the problems we work on - We own the full lifecycle of our projects - We avoid silos and encourage taking up tasks in new areas - We balance quality and velocity - We have a shared responsibility for our production code - We each set our own routine to maximize our productivity YOUR MISSION You’ll join us as a Machine Learning Engineer/ Data Scientist for Mimica’s Data Intelligence team, whose goal is to transform raw recorded data into clean, structured, anonymized data that powers the work of other teams. You’ll own key parts of our ML pipelines end to end, making them more accurate, cost-efficient, and trustworthy. Along the way, you’ll build evaluations and LLM judges, run experiments, and transform promising results into validated production improvements. Your work will be applied and LLM-heavy, with opportunities to evaluate and fine-tune open-source models and build smaller, task-specific models. If you enjoy taking ML beyond experiments, this is your chance to shape the systems at the heart of Mimica’s products and see your work deliver value to real users at scale. PART OF YOUR DAY-TO-DAY - Own, debug, and improve production pipelines for accuracy and efficiency. - Design, build, and iterate on LLM evals and LLM-as-a-judge systems, including the datasets, metrics, and benchmarks to monitor quality. - Run rigorous experiments on prompts, pipeline design, model choice, and inputs (e.g., OCR text vs. image + OCR), and turn the results into clear recommendations. - Drive LLM efficiency improvements across our pipelines by comparing models, restructuring steps, and replacing LLM calls with smaller, purpose-built models where it makes sense. - Expand our anonymization pipeline, including evaluating and adapting existing models. - Work with Python and quality engineers to take experiments into production, and share responsibility for the code you ship. - Document findings in writing (eg. experiment reports, design docs) WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR Primarily, we’re looking for an individual with an experiment- and data-driven researcher mindset with good coding habits. This includes: - Solid machine learning/data science background: you understand experimental design, data splits, metrics, bias, and statistical significance, and you know when a result is real. - Hands-on experience applying LLMs in production or near-production settings, especially evaluating them: building eval sets, LLM judges and benchmarks, and iterating on prompts and pipelines against them. - Comfortable getting deep into messy data: exploring it, troubleshooting issues, and transforming insights into measurable improvements. - Strong Python and good engineering skills. You write clear, readable, tested code that others can take to production, even if you’re not the one owning the infrastructure. - Able to work independently on ambiguous problems: framing the question, choosing the approach, and deciding on the acceptance criteria to ship. - Use AI coding tools effectively and stay accountable for the output: understand, explain, and defend everything you ship. - Communicate clearly in spoken and written English, including explaining technical trade-offs to both technical and non-technical audiences BONUS / NICE TO HAVE - Experience with classical ML or deep learning model development. - Experience with image/OCR pipelines or face-related anonymization - Experience shipping end-to-end ML features in a startup or scale-up environment. LOCATION This is a fully remote position. To make sure we work well together, we’re only considering candidates based in the UK or Europe, in time zones compatible with London (typically UTC-1 to UTC+3). HIRING PROCESS - Stage 1. Talent Partner (30-45 min) - Stage 2. Take-home challenge (flexible) + Technical Discussion with the team (1h) - Stage 3. Technical design exercise and situational questions in session w/ two ML Engineers (1h) - Stage 4. Behavioral interview w/ Engineering leadership (1h) - Offer - Identity Verification WHAT WE OFFER 💰 Generous compensation + stock options - aligned with our internal framework, market data, and individual skills. 🏢 Distributed work: Work from anywhere - fully remote, in our hubs, or a mix. 💻 Company-issued laptop, remote setup stipend, and co-working budget 📍 Flexible schedules and location ☀️ Ample paid time off, in addition to local public holidays 🍼 Enhanced parental leave 🧘‍♀️ Health & retirement benefits 📖 Annual learning & development budget 🌴 Annual workaways and regular virtual & in-person socials 🌍 Opportunity to contribute to groundbreaking projects that shape the future of work Note: Some benefits may vary depending on location and role ⚠️ Mimica will only contact candidates from an @mimica.ai email address. We do not request banking or sensitive personal information during the recruiting process.

You will write production code, mentor rising talent, and actively shape how our team leverages AI-assisted development to accelerate our shipping velocity. jobs.description: WHO ARE WE? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems. We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! ABOUT THE ROLE. We’re building the next generation of agentic AI infrastructure at Cohere. This team sits at the intersection of ML systems, distributed infrastructure, and developer experience, creating the platform that powers autonomous AI agents at scale. You’ll work on hard, forward-looking problems with few established patterns, including secure code execution, agent state management, model routing, identity and authentication, and resource management for long-running agent workflows. This role is a strong fit for someone who combines systems depth with ML intuition. You should be comfortable building reliable infrastructure, thinking through distributed systems tradeoffs, and understanding how emerging agentic capabilities shape platform design. WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON. - Secure execution environments for agent-generated code - Identity, authentication, and trust boundaries for agents - Model routing and orchestration across different model types and environments - Rate limiting, quotas, and resource management for agent workflows - State management, memory, and filesystem abstractions for agents. IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL: - Turn emerging ML research ideas into production-ready infrastructure - Build core platform capabilities for execution, storage, and state management - Prototype and evaluate new technologies, then help decide what should move into production - Partner with research teams to shape infrastructure based on what future agent systems will need YOU MAY BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU HAVE: - Experience building production ML infrastructure with strong systems fundamentals - Hands-on work with agentic systems, multi-agent workflows, or agent development frameworks - Familiarity with model routing and LLM provider frameworks across different model types and environments - Experience with scalable, fault-tolerant distributed systems and Kubernetes - A track record of moving quickly on prototypes and making good decisions about productionization. BONUS - Experience across on-prem, private cloud, and public cloud environments - Familiarity with storage systems, embedded databases, or filesystem abstractions - Experience with code execution sandboxes such as gVisor, Firecracker, Kata, or WASM runtimes - Interest in emerging ML infrastructure, edge inference, or browser-native models - Open-source contributions to LLM or agent infrastructure projects - Experience with identity, workload auth, or capability-based security systems. FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS: - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch. - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health. - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme. - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent. - Annual enrichment benefits: Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit. Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching. - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!) - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite. HOW AND WHERE WE WORK: - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon. - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events. - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city. - Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly. If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12a6IrLdF3kI2nonKSr4tiFuz18rLQbaeYV-JM9L4o9Q/edit, and we will work together to meet your needs. We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider. Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers https://cohere.com/careers page.

jobs.description: About us You'll be joining a small, highly collaborative engineering team at Hybrid Financial http://www.hybridfinancial.com, a distribution and outreach firm that works with public companies and asset managers. We build full-stack applications, including the internal execution platforms our agents rely on every day to do their work in financial services. Engineers here work closely with each other and with the people who use what we build, so you'll see how your work affects the business directly. We're a close team with a very long tenure. We work in person, we talk to each other a lot and we genuinely like working together. We take chances on people and invest in helping them grow. About the role We’re looking for a talented Junior Database Administrator to join our team and work alongside our senior DBA. You’ll help write and optimize SQL queries, monitor database performance, and support the day-to-day work that keeps our databases secure and reliable, including backups, restores, and access management. This role is perfect for someone with strong SQL fundamentals who wants to deepen their database expertise in a hands-on environment. You’ll receive mentorship from an experienced DBA, work closely with our engineering team, and have opportunities to take on more ownership as you grow. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Database Administration & Performance - Write, review, and optimize SQL queries and stored procedures for performance and scalability - Monitor database performance and troubleshoot slow queries and other issues - Design and maintain database schemas and indexes - Support backups, restores, security, and access management - Implement best practices for data integrity and reliability - Provide day-to-day database coverage when our senior DBA is away Collaboration & Development - Work closely with developers on how our applications use the database - Contribute to technical discussions and decisions with the team - Document database structures, processes, and changes clearly QUALIFICATIONS - Ideally 2 - 5 yrs of hands-on database experience. Strong recent grads with real experience will be considered. - Strong SQL knowledge, including complex queries, indexing, and query optimization - Experience with MySQL - Understanding of DBA fundamentals, including backups, recovery, security, and performance monitoring - Experience with relational database design principles - Ability to talk through problems and explain your thinking clearly NICE TO HAVE - Experience in finance or financial services - Some application coding experience, ideally C# or .NET - Exposure to cloud platforms, ideally Azure - Experience with replication, high availability, or disaster recovery setups - Scripting for automation (PowerShell, Python, or Bash) What we offer - Competitive compensation and benefits - Mentorship from experienced senior developers - Opportunities to lead projects and grow into mid-level roles - Inclusive, supportive team environment

jobs.position: Senior Staff Technical Go-to-Market (GTM) Product Marketing Manager, Access Security
jobs.description: 1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $500M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing. About 1Password At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work. If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future. Product Marketing and Enablement connects 1Password’s product strategy to the customer conversations that drive growth. In this Senior Staff individual contributor role, you’ll own the product-to-field motion for Enterprise Password Manager (EPM), Agentic Access—including Developer Tools—and Privileged Access, helping Account Executives (AEs), Sales Engineers (SEs), and Customer Success Managers (CSMs) connect the needs of Information Technology (IT), security, and engineering teams to the right solutions. Through clear technical storytelling, credible sales guidance, and close partnership with Product and Sales, you’ll help 1Password advance its mission to unleash employee productivity without compromising security. Reporting to the Director, Product Marketing and Enablement, this role is remote across the United States and Canada. How we’re using AI today Our Engineering, Product, and Design teams are thoughtfully integrating AI across the full software and product development lifecycle to move faster without sacrificing quality or security. In practice, that looks like engineers using AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate reviews and catch bugs earlier, product managers synthesizing user research at scale, and designers rapidly prototyping and iterating with AI-generated mockups. We approach AI the same way we approach security: with clear principles, human accountability at every consequential decision point, and rigorous evaluation before anything ships to customers. This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US. What we're looking for: • Experience bringing complex technical Business-to-Business (B2B) products, new use cases, or emerging categories to market. • Experience working in a sales-led organization with enterprise sellers, Sales Engineers, technical buyers, and complex buying cycles. • Experience building a product motion across discovery, evaluation, technical validation, purchase, and expansion. • Experience partnering across Product, Engineering, Product Marketing, Sales, and GTM Enablement, with the ability to build credibility with technical and executive audiences. • Deep fluency in identity security, Privileged Access Management (PAM), secrets management, or agentic access, along with working knowledge of developer tools and the ability to translate technical product behavior into clear customer-facing guidance. • Strong written and verbal communication skills, strategic judgment, and the ability to influence senior stakeholders while making thoughtful decisions in ambiguous environments. • Experience launching a new product, category, or sales motion in identity security, access management, developer tools, or a related technical market; using field insights, win-loss feedback, or seller research to prioritize work; or holding security certifications or equivalent technical training. What you can expect: • Own the product enablement plan for Enterprise Password Manager, Agentic Access—including Developer Tools—and Privileged Access, prioritizing readiness work based on business impact, customer needs, launches, and field evidence. • Translate Product Marketing strategy into sales motions that help IT, security, and engineering buyers secure access for developers, artificial intelligence (AI) agents, and privileged users. • Create the pitch decks, talk tracks, qualification questions, discovery guides, product training, and other field assets needed to support customer conversations from discovery through expansion. • Define how the portfolio fits into annual sales plays, including the personas to engage at each stage of the buying journey and the role of strategic technology and AI partnerships. • Act as an escalation point for strategic opportunities, join live customer conversations, support discovery and demos, and coach sellers through complex technical questions and objections. • Partner with Technical Marketing and Demo Engineering to map demos to sales plays and provide the customer, use-case, and product context needed to build credible launch and sales demonstrations. • Measure field readiness, lead win-loss analysis, identify recurring objections and adoption barriers, and bring clear recommendations to Product, Product Marketing, Sales Enablement, and senior leadership. USA-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $180,000 USD and $261,000 USD, plus immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs. Canada-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $152,000 CAD and $220,000 CAD, plus immediate participation in 1Password’s generous benefits program (health, dental, RRSP and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs. At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set. This posting is for an existing vacancy. Our culture At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first. You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone https://blog.1password.com/inside-the-culture-powering-1passwords-next-chapter/. Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results. How we work with AI We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. jobs.description: Hi, I’m Geo, Ashby’s VP of Product. I joined Ashby August ‘26; read more about why I joined here. https://www.ashbyhq.com/blog/all/a-letter-from-chris-geoghegan-on-joining-ashby I’m hiring for multiple Product Managers who will report directly to me. More on the specific product areas below. At Ashby, we have a unique approach to building products https://www.ashbyhq.com/blog/culture/ashbys-operating-principles. As a PM, your primary goal is to eliminate frustration and bring delight to our customers. You’ll work with engineers who deeply understand the customer and business problem and own the solution end-to-end. This means that you spend less time writing detailed specs and more time with customers and doing deep product thinking. Our unique approach is working. We’re growing >100% year over year and have notable customers such as Notion, Linear, OpenAI, Shopify, and Snowflake. Our growth and retention metrics are best in class among our peers. We’re backed by amazing investors like Y Combinator, Elad Gil, Lachy Groom, and many more! PRODUCT AREAS From day one, we have aimed to build "all-in-one and best-in-class" software for Talent teams. In addition to building a multi-product foundation from day one, we have also focused on enabling customizability and power-user features while keeping Ashby easy to get started with. Doing both is an ambitious undertaking! We want to continue down this ambitious path in future and add multiple new products, which means we: - Are not just building a product, we’re building a platform - Need to find a balance between re-usable building blocks and feature-specific behaviour - Blend enterprise customizability and ease of use We also want to continuously delight users. We hear "I never thought one could fall in love with an ATS" quite often, and we want to keep that true for all future products we build. We are looking for Product Managers who can own the roadmap and strategy for the following areas: 1. Product Platform: Ashby was designed from the beginning as a multi-product platform. We’re looking for a PM to establish this team and own the shared building blocks, foundational capabilities, and APIs that let product teams move quickly. - Great fit if you: - Bring strong technical product judgment and enjoy working on APIs, shared systems, and foundational capabilities - Know how to balance reusable building blocks with polished, customer-facing product experiences - Like creating leverage by helping teams ship quickly and consistently while improving what customers directly see and use 2. AI Platform: You’ll own the Ashby Assistant, Ashby MCP, and the AI platform used across many product surfaces. You’ll help drive shared primitives, such as AI memory and context. - Great fit if you: - Have experience building AI-powered products, especially agents, copilots, or workflow automation - Enjoy shaping shared AI primitives like memory, context, orchestration, and evaluation - Can translate fast-moving AI capabilities into products that feel useful, reliable, and delightful During the interview process, we’ll determine which role you're best suited for. We’re also advertising this opening as Staff Product Manager. Both titles describe the same position; please apply once using the title that best reflects your experience. YOUR ROLE - Drive Impact: Deeply understand our customers and ship impactful product improvements and investments to maintain our strong velocity. - Quality: Apply your strong product taste and sound judgement to deliver solutions that are both powerful and a joy to use. jobs.description: What the Role Does: Lead software developers, shape technical direction, and turn business goals into reliable software delivery. LawDepot is looking to recruit a Software Development Manager to lead the teams responsible for our contract platform and internal content management system (CMS) editor experience. This role combines technical leadership with people management. You will guide development decisions, strengthen engineering practices, and build teams that consistently deliver meaningful product and platform improvements. You will coach and support developers, set clear expectations, and create the conditions for strong execution. Working closely with Product, UX, QA, Architecture, and other Information Systems leaders, you will align priorities, manage delivery, improve quality, and ensure the team’s work supports long-term business goals. You will also advance practical AI adoption by using AI tools in your own work, helping developers build effective AI-assisted workflows, and measuring how these practices improve delivery, software quality, and customer outcomes. This is a full-time, permanent position working 37.5 hours per week, with the option to work hybrid from our Edmonton, Alberta office or fully remote across Canada. What You’ll Do: - Manage Software Developers and Scrum Masters to create technical solutions that deliver an exceptional experience for our millions of website users and our internal CMS platform team members - Set clear expectations, coach team members, guide performance and career development, and build shared ownership of delivery and production quality - Partner with Product Owners and stakeholders to develop high level strategy and deliver technical roadmaps - Remove delivery obstacles and keep teams focused on high-impact, value-driven work - Translate technical context, risks, dependencies, and trade-offs into clear business language for stakeholders and leaders - Make architecture and technology selection decisions that align with business goals and long-term scalability - Manage project schedules, scope, work estimates, dependencies, risks, and delivery commitments - Identify and apply practical uses of AI across technical investigation, prototyping, code review, test case development, documentation, and delivery analysis to improve team efficiency, software quality, customer outcomes, and product capabilities - Coach developers on effective AI-assisted engineering practices, including task decomposition, context preparation, output validation, and appropriate human review - Strengthen development practices related to web applications, APIs, data models, automated testing, CI/CD, security, and production troubleshooting - Manage releases, rollout readiness, rollback planning, incident response, technical quality, and the removal of temporary feature flags or obsolete code - Enable website experimentation setup with Product and Analytics teams, ensuring clear success measures and operational readiness - Support hiring, onboarding, day-to-day operations, and people management activities to foster a high-performing team What You Bring: The Essentials - Post-secondary education in Computing Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field - 2+ years of demonstrated experience leading software development teams and supporting developer performance, growth, and delivery - 7+ years of experience in software development, architecture, or technical delivery - Experience managing projects, processes, priorities, and technical delivery in a software development environment - Strong technical judgment across web applications, APIs, data models, automated testing, CI/CD, security, and production troubleshooting - Hands-on experience using AI platforms, agents, or related tools in real software engineering work - Ability to validate AI-generated output, identify risks, and coach others on where human judgment is required - Strong business acumen and the ability to connect technical decisions to company priorities and operational outcomes - Ability to collaborate with cross-functional business stakeholders - Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain trade-offs, negotiate scope, and align stakeholders - Experience introducing reusable AI workflows, engineering playbooks, or developer enablement practices, including measuring their impact on delivery, quality, rework, or cost - Familiarity with Model Context Protocol or similar approaches for connecting AI tools to engineering or product workflows - jobs.description: MaintainX is a leading mobile-first work execution platform for industrial and frontline teams. More than 15,000 customers, including McDonalds, Michaels, Cintas, Redimix, and U.S. LBM, use MaintainX to cut unplanned downtime and run better operations, across 16 million managed assets and 92 million completed work orders. In August 2026 MaintainX became part of Autodesk, joining Autodesk Operations Solutions https://adsknews.autodesk.com/en/views/inside-autodesk-operations-solutions/, the organization unifying Autodesk's operations platform alongside Tandem, FlexSim and Fusion Operations. Autodesk's strategy is to converge design, make and operate into one continuous lifecycle: design an asset, build it, run it, then feed what you learn running it back into the next design. Autodesk had design and make. Operate is the phase that tells you what actually happened, and it is ours. À PROPOS DE L’ÉQUIPE L'équipe Plateforme et infrastructure veille à ce que tout le reste soit rapide, fiable et facile à développer. Nous sommes responsables des services partagés sur lesquels s'appuient toutes les équipes produit (identité, recherche, communication et notre système de design Pantry), des outils qui rendent nos développeurs productifs, ainsi que des fondations de livraison et d'exécution qui nous permettent de déployer en toute confiance. On le bâtit une fois, et toutes les équipes en profiten ÉQUIPES QUE VOUS POURRIEZ JOINDRE - Fondations produit : identité, communication, recherche et Pantry, y compris l'Integrations Marketplace, Global Search et le système de design Pantry. - Productivité des développeurs : outils internes et extensions d'IDE qui accélèrent le travail de chaque développeur. - Livraison, exécution et tests : CI/CD, fiabilité des sites (SRE), conformité FedRAMP et assurance qualité. Cette équipe est davantage orientée infrastructure et fiabilité. SUR QUOI VOUS TRAVAILLEREZ - Définir l’orientation technique des services et des composants partagés dont dépendent les autres équipes. - Concevoir des API, des outils et des composants de système de design que les autres ingénieurs ont envie d’utiliser, et favoriser leur adoption entre les équipes. - Améliorer la vitesse, la sécurité et la fiabilité de notre façon de concevoir, de tester et de livrer les logiciels. - Considérer les ingénieurs internes comme vos clients : recueillir leurs commentaires, mesurer l’adoption et itérer. LE POSTE - Diriger la conception et la livraison de projets vastes et ambigus, de bout en bout, de la planification à la mise en production. - Collaborer directement avec les gestionnaires de produit, les designers, la direction de l’ingénierie et les ingénieurs qui bâtissent à partir de votre travail pour façonner la feuille de route de votre équipe et influencer celles des équipes voisines. - Assumer la santé technique à long terme d’un domaine de plateforme : fiabilité, performance et les parties du code que personne ne remarque tant qu’elles ne tombent pas en panne. - Piloter les décisions d’architecture et rédiger les propositions techniques sur lesquelles les autres s’appuient. - Encadrer des ingénieur·e·s seniors et de niveau staff, et établir la norme en matière de revue de code dans votre équipe. - Rehausser la barre en matière d’outils, de tests et de pratiques de livraison dans plusieurs équipes, et pas seulement la vôtre. Notre pile technologique de base comprend TypeScript, React, Node.js et MySQL. Certaines équipes utilisent C# ou Python. Vous n’avez pas besoin de maîtriser chacun de ces éléments pour postuler. Vous intégrerez une équipe de 5 à 10 personnes et participerez à la rotation de garde, qui fait partie du rôle. Au cours de vos 6 premiers mois, vous assumerez pleinement l’orientation technique d’un domaine ou d’un système de plateforme. OÙ NOUS TRAVAILLONS Nous n’imposons pas de présence minimale au bureau, mais nous préférons que nos équipes soient situées à proximité de nos centres d’affaires. Au Canada, cela comprend : Montréal et Toronto. NOUS RECHERCHONS - 10 ans et plus d’expérience professionnelle dans la conception de produits web ou mobiles full-stack, avec une feuille de route démontrée de leadership technique dont la portée dépasse celle d’une seule équipe. - Une solide expérience pratique de TypeScript, de React et de Node.js. - De l’expérience dans la conception de systèmes partagés qui ont tenu la charge à grande échelle, et le jugement nécessaire pour savoir quand il ne faut pas construire quelque chose. - De l’expérience en développement itératif, adaptatif et axé sur le mobile d’abord. - Un parcours démontré dans l’écriture de code maintenable et testable, que vous êtes à l’aise de confier à quelqu’un d’autre. - D’excellentes compétences de communication écrite et orale : vous savez expliquer un compromis technique à un designer, à un responsable du soutien ou à un dirigeant aussi aisément qu’à un autre développeur. - L’aisance à faire progresser un problème avant que les spécifications soient entièrement arrêtées, en vous ajustant au fil de votre compréhension. - L’utilisation quotidienne d’outils d’IA dans votre processus de développement, et pas seulement une expérimentation occasionnelle. - Atouts : expérience de GraphQL, de React Native ou des bases de données SQL. Pour ce secteur, nous valorisons aussi l’expérience des technologies de recherche, de l’authentification et de l’identité, des systèmes de design ou des bibliothèques de composants, des outils pour développeurs ou des extensions d’IDE, du CI/CD, de l’observabilité, ou des programmes de conformité comme FedRAMP ou SOC 2. Our mission is to keep the physical world running. Factories, fleets, hospitals and campuses stay up because the people who maintain them have tools worth using. That is what we build. Compensation and benefits. Base pay is one part of the package. Depending on the role, compensation may also include commission, an annual bonus and equity. Benefits differ by country. For roles in the United States, Autodesk’s benefits are described at benefits.autodesk.com http://benefits.autodesk.com. For roles in Canada and other countries, the plan differs on health coverage, retirement and leave, and your recruiter will walk you through it. Belonging. We take pride in a culture where everyone can thrive. More at autodesk.com/company/global-belonging http://autodesk.com/company/global-belonging. More on where this is going: Autodesk CEO Andrew Anagnost on building the future of connected operations https://adsknews.autodesk.com/en/news/building-the-future-of-connected-operations/, and AOS SVP Stephen Hooper on welcoming MaintainX to Autodesk https://adsknews.autodesk.com/en/views/inside-autodesk-operations-solutions/.

jobs.description: Cerebras Systems builds the world's largest AI chip, 56 times larger than GPUs. This architecture allows Cerebras to deliver industry-leading training and inference speeds; over 10 times faster than GPU-based hyperscale cloud inference services. This order of magnitude increase in speed is transforming the user experience of AI applications, unlocking real-time iteration and increasing intelligence via additional agentic computation. Cerebras works with the leading model labs, global enterprises, and cutting-edge AI-native startups. OpenAI recently announced a multi-year partnership https://openai.com/index/cerebras-partnership/ with Cerebras, to deploy 750 megawatts of scale, transforming key workloads with ultra high-speed inference. We are hiring a Software Engineer to productionize and optimize our GPU serving stack, working across our custom inference APIs, the vLLM serving runtime, the AMD ROCm software stack, and rack-scale AMD GPU infrastructure, to make this new serving path reliable, numerically correct, observable, and exceptionally performant. You will write production code, establish operational practices for a new accelerator fleet, and drive improvements in time to first token, throughput, tail latency, and capacity efficiency. This is a hands-on role requiring deep debugging and optimization across application, runtime, distributed systems, and hardware layers. RESPONSIBILITIES - Productionize the GPU inference stack. Design, build, deploy, and maintain the complete GPU prefill path, spanning API services, model-serving workers, vLLM, PyTorch, ROCm, GPU nodes, networking, and rack-scale infrastructure. - Own GPU operational readiness. Establish deployment, upgrade, rollback, health-checking, capacity-management, and failure-recovery practices for the AMD GPU fleet. Build automation that makes driver, firmware, runtime, model, and container compatibility explicit and reproducible. - Drive reliability in production. Define service-level indicators and objectives for GPU-backed inference. Improve fault isolation, graceful degradation, automated recovery, incident response, and post-incident remediation across the serving stack. - Improve inference performance. Profile and optimize time to first token, request throughput, tokens per second per GPU, tail latency, GPU utilization, memory efficiency, and rack-level capacity under representative production workloads. - Optimize model-serving behavior. Tune and improve scheduling, continuous batching, prefix caching, KV-cache management, tensor and expert parallelism, request admission, quantization, graph execution, and distributed communication. - Debug across system layers. Diagnose complex failures and performance regressions across application code, vLLM, PyTorch, ROCm/HIP, collective communication libraries, kernels, drivers, firmware, networking, and hardware. - Ensure numerical correctness. Build validation and regression infrastructure for model quality, numerical accuracy, precision changes, quantization, determinism, and compatibility across software and hardware releases. - Build performance and correctness infrastructure. Develop representative benchmarks, workload replay tools, profiling automation, release qualification, dashboards, and regression gates. Turn one-off investigations into repeatable engineering systems. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS - Experience with AMD Instinct accelerators and the ROCm ecosystem, including HIP, RCCL, rocprofiler, AMD SMI, AITER, hipBLASLt, Composable Kernel, or related libraries and tools. - Deep CUDA experience that demonstrates an ability to transfer GPU systems knowledge across accelerator platforms. - Experience modifying or contributing to vLLM, SGLang, PyTorch, Triton, TensorRT-LLM, or another open-source ML systems project. - Experience optimizing prefill-heavy or disaggregated prefill/decode inference architectures. - Understanding of KV-cache transfer, prefix caching, continuous batching, chunked prefill, request scheduling, and memory-aware admission control. - Experience with multi-GPU and multi-node inference, including tensor parallelism, pipeline parallelism, expert parallelism, RDMA, collective communication, and failure handling. - Experience optimizing Mixture-of-Experts or multimodal models. - Knowledge of GPU kernel optimization, operator fusion, graph capture, attention kernels, GEMM tuning, and communication/computation overlap. - Experience with reduced-precision inference and quantization formats such as BF16, FP8, FP4, INT8, or INT4, including validation of their numerical and model-quality effects. - Experience building numerical-comparison, determinism, model-validation, or performance-regression test systems. - Experience collaborating directly with accelerator vendors, framework maintainers, or open-source communities. Why Join Cerebras People who are serious about software make their own hardware. At Cerebras, we have built a breakthrough architecture that is unlocking new opportunities for the AI industry. With dozens of model releases and rapid growth, we’ve reached an inflection point in our business. Members of our team tell us there are five main reasons they joined Cerebras: 1. Build a breakthrough AI platform beyond the constraints of the GPU. 2. Publish and open source their cutting-edge AI research. 3. Work on one of the fastest AI supercomputers in the world. 4. Enjoy job stability with startup vitality. 5. Our simple, non-corporate work culture that respects individual beliefs. Find out more about what it's like to work at Cerebras here https://www.cerebras.ai/join-us! Apply today and become part of the forefront of groundbreaking advancements in AI! Cerebras Systems is committed to creating an equal and diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate different backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. ÉQUIPES QUE VOUS POURRIEZ JOINDRE - Planification : Flux de travail de planification et d’ordonnancement, ainsi que les heures d’exploitation. - Gestion des stocks / Pièces : Pièces de rechange, bons de commande, prévisions et fournisseurs. - Accueil / Rapports : Écran Vue d’ensemble, ainsi que les rapports partagés et planifiés. - Plateforme d’exécution des travaux : Fonctionnalités de base des bons de travail sur lesquelles repose le produit : récurrence, assignation, calendrier, procédures, automatisations et permis. - Expérience des techniciens : Enregistrement de la présence par GPS, expérience utilisateur sur le terrain et fonctionnement hors ligne pour les techniciens. - Gestion des données d’entreprise : Fonctionnalités globales et multi sites de la plateforme, modèles, hiérarchie et emplacement des actifs, ainsi que les formulaires dynamiques pour les actifs. SUR QUOI VOUS TRAVAILLEREZ - Définir l’orientation technique des flux de travail que les clients utilisent chaque jour, de la planification à la gestion des pièces en passant par les rapports. - Résoudre des problèmes de produit complexes : interfaces denses riches en données, grands volumes de données, comportement hors ligne et échelle multisite. - Dans nos équipes nouvellement formées, définir l’architecture et les pratiques d’ingénierie dès le départ. - Rendre simples des flux de travail complexes, sur ordinateur comme sur mobile. LE POSTE - Diriger la conception et la livraison de projets vastes et ambigus, de bout en bout, de la planification à la mise en production. - Collaborer directement avec les gestionnaires de produit, les designers et la direction de l’ingénierie pour façonner la feuille de route de votre équipe et influencer celles des équipes voisines. - Assumer la santé technique à long terme d’un domaine : fiabilité, performance et les parties du code que personne ne remarque tant qu’elles ne tombent pas en panne. - Piloter les décisions d’architecture et rédiger les propositions techniques sur lesquelles les autres s’appuient. - Encadrer des ingénieur·e·s seniors et de niveau staff, et établir la norme en matière de revue de code dans votre équipe. - Rehausser la barre en matière d’outils, de tests et de pratiques de livraison dans plusieurs équipes, et pas seulement la vôtre. Notre pile technologique de base comprend TypeScript, React, Node.js et MySQL. Certaines équipes utilisent C# ou Python. Vous n’avez pas besoin de maîtriser chacun de ces éléments pour postuler. Vous intégrerez une équipe de 5 à 10 personnes et participerez à la rotation de garde, qui fait partie du rôle. Au cours de vos 6 premiers mois, vous assumerez pleinement l’orientation technique d’un domaine ou d’un système. OÙ NOUS TRAVAILLONS Nous n’imposons pas de présence minimale au bureau, mais nous préférons que nos équipes soient situées à proximité de nos centres d’affaires. Au Canada, cela comprend : Montréal et Toronto. NOUS RECHERCHONS - 10 ans et plus d’expérience professionnelle dans la conception de produits web ou mobiles full-stack, avec une feuille de route démontrée de leadership technique dont la portée dépasse celle d’une seule équipe. - Une solide expérience pratique de TypeScript, de React et de Node.js. - De l’expérience dans la conception de systèmes qui ont tenu la charge à grande échelle, et le jugement nécessaire pour savoir quand il ne faut pas construire quelque chose. - De l’expérience en développement itératif, adaptatif et axé sur le mobile d’abord. - Un parcours démontré dans l’écriture de code maintenable et testable, que vous êtes à l’aise de confier à quelqu’un d’autre. - D’excellentes compétences de communication écrite et orale : vous savez expliquer un compromis technique à un designer, à un responsable du soutien ou à un dirigeant aussi aisément qu’à un autre développeur. - L’aisance à faire progresser un problème avant que les spécifications soient entièrement arrêtées, en vous ajustant au fil de votre compréhension. - L’utilisation quotidienne d’outils d’IA dans votre processus de développement, et pas seulement une expérimentation occasionnelle. - Atouts: expérience de GraphQL, de React Native ou des bases de données SQL. Pour ce secteur, nous valorisons aussi l’expérience des interfaces de planification ou de calendrier, des interfaces riches en données, des architectures hors ligne d’abord ou de synchronisation, des plateformes multilocataires ou d’entreprise, des moteurs de flux de travail, et des systèmes de stocks et transactionnels. Our mission is to keep the physical world running. Factories, fleets, hospitals and campuses stay up because the people who maintain them have tools worth using. That is what we build. jobs.description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.</p></div><p>Affirm is reinventing credit to make it more honest and friendly, giving consumers the flexibility to buy now and pay later without any hidden fees or compounding interest.<br><br><br><span style="color: #262626;">The Capacity Modeling team ensures Affirm can safely handle forecasted traffic—especially during peak sales events—by translating demand forecasts into concrete, testable capacity plans. They build and maintain statistical capacity models that map traffic inputs (e.g., checkout volume, app opens, batch/job activity) to resource outputs (CPU, memory, connections) and then convert those forecasts into recommended capacity settings such as pod counts, HPA ranges, and/or infrastructure sizing changes across regions and environments.</span><br><br><br><strong>What You'll Do</strong><br><br><br>· You will be responsible for owning and delivering quarterly goals for your team, leading engineers on your team through ambiguity to solve open-ended problems, and ensuring that everyone is supported throughout delivery.<br>· You will support your peers and stakeholders in the product development lifecycle by collaborating with product management, design &amp; analytics by participating in ideation, articulating technical constraints, and partnering on decisions that properly consider risks and trade-offs.<br>· You will proactively identify project, process, technology or business issues, advocate for them, and lead in solving them.<br>· You will support the operations and availability of your team’s artifacts by creating and monitoring metrics, escalating when needed, and supporting “keep the lights on” &amp; on-call efforts.<br>· You will foster a culture of quality and ownership on your team by setting or improving code review and design standards for your team, and advocating for them beyond your team through your writing and tech talks.<br>· You will help develop talent on your team by providing feedback and guidance, and leading by example.<br><br><br><strong>What We Look For</strong><br><br>· You have 4+ years of experience designing, developing and launching backend systems at scale using languages like Python or Kotlin.<br>· You have a track record of developing highly available distributed systems using technologies like AWS, MySQL and Kubernetes.<br>· <span style="color: #262626;">You have experience supporting scale up and down of large scale sales event such as Prime Day, Black Friday Cyber Monday, or other sales holidays</span></p> <p>· <span style="color: #262626;">You have tuned autoscaling, CPU/Memory, and multi-threading for compute type workloads.</span><br>· You have experience defining a technical plan for the delivery of a significant feature or system component with an elegant, simple and extensible design. You write high quality code that is easily understood and used by others.<br>· You are proficient at making significant changes in a large code base, and have developed a suite of tools and practices that enable you and your team to do so safely.<br>· Your experience demonstrates that you take ownership of your growth, proactively seeking feedback from your team, your manager, and your stakeholders.<br>· You have strong verbal and written communication skills that support effective collaboration with our global engineering team.<br>· This position requires either equivalent practical experience or a Bachelor’s degree in a related field.<br><br></p> <p><strong>Base Pay Grade</strong> - N</p> <p><strong>Equity Grade</strong> - 6</p> <p>Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.</p> <p><strong>Benefits designed for you</strong><strong><br></strong>Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. jobs.position: Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET), QA - AI Systems
jobs.description: ABOUT NEXXA Nexxa is building the best AI systems for heavy industries, enabling machines, systems and operations to think, decide and act autonomously across manufacturing, large-scale infrastructure, logistics and legacy environments. Our mission is to translate deep technical breakthroughs into operational reality, solving some of the hardest systems-level problems in industry. ROLE OVERVIEW We’re looking for a Senior / Staff SDET to own quality for Nexxa’s AI agent systems, combining deep test automation with hands-on manual and exploratory testing. Our agents plan, call tools, and take multi-step actions autonomously in industrial environments. You’ll write production-grade code to build evaluation harnesses, simulation environments, and CI/CD quality gates, and you’ll also get hands-on with the agents yourself: probing behavior, reviewing traces, and validating releases where automation alone can’t judge whether the agent did the right thing. You’ll work closely with ML engineers, backend engineers, and Forward Deployed Engineers to define what “good” looks like for an agent operating in high-stakes industrial settings, then build and run the systems and processes that measure it continuously. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Automation and Infrastructure - Design, build, and maintain test frameworks, evaluation harnesses, and regression suites for LLM-based agents, covering reasoning quality, tool-call correctness, task completion, and multi-turn coherence. - Build automated pipelines that run evals and test suites on every model, prompt, or tool-integration change, and integrate them into CI/CD as enforceable quality gates. - Develop simulators, mocks, and sandbox environments for industrial systems and tool APIs so agents can be tested safely, repeatably, and at scale. - Implement API, contract, integration, and end-to-end tests for the services, tools, and orchestration layers that agents depend on. - Develop performance, load, and reliability tests for agent workflows, including failure injection and resilience testing. Manual and Exploratory Testing - Perform hands-on exploratory testing of agent behavior, including new capabilities, ambiguous or underspecified requests, long multi-turn sessions, and unusual operational scenarios that scripted tests don’t anticipate. - Manually review agent traces and outputs to judge reasoning quality, appropriateness of actions, and safety, and use those findings to improve automated checks. - Execute manual regression and release verification passes in staging and customer-like environments before new agent capabilities ship. - Conduct manual red-teaming sessions (prompt injection, jailbreaks, tool misuse, unsafe actions) in partnership with security teams, then convert successful attacks into automated test cases. - Support user acceptance testing and pilot rollouts with Forward Deployed Engineers, capturing real-world failures and feeding them back into test suites. - Write clear test plans, test charters, and bug reports, and maintain manual test documentation where automation isn’t yet practical or cost-effective. Datasets, Metrics, and Quality Strategy - Create and manage golden datasets and labeled test sets, including edge cases, ambiguous inputs, and adversarial prompts specific to industrial and operational contexts, with tooling for versioning and drift detection. - Design rubrics and run human-in-the-loop evaluations where automated scoring isn’t reliable enough. - Define and instrument quality metrics beyond simple accuracy (groundedness, hallucination rate, task success rate, latency/cost tradeoffs, and safety violations) and build dashboards to track them over time. - Test agent behavior across the full action loop (planning, tool selection, tool execution, error recovery, and final output), not just the final response. - Investigate and triage failures where the root cause could be the model, the prompt, the tool/API, or the orchestration logic, and turn them into reproducible, actionable bug reports. - Establish quality bars, release criteria, and sign-off processes for new agent capabilities, blending automated gates with manual verification. - Decide what to automate and what to keep manual, and continually shift repeatable manual work into automation. - Mentor engineers on testing strategies and test-driven practices for probabilistic, LLM-driven systems. - Advocate for testability, observability, and tracing in agent architecture from day one. QUALIFICATIONS - 5+ years as an SDET, QA engineer, or software engineer with a strong testing focus, with demonstrated ownership of test strategy and automation for complex distributed systems. - Proven experience in both manual and automated testing, including exploratory testing, test planning, and writing high-quality bug reports. - Strong programming skills (Python preferred) with a software engineering mindset: clean, maintainable, well-reviewed code for frameworks, data pipelines, and tooling. - Experience building test frameworks and infrastructure from the ground up, not just writing test cases within an existing framework. - Hands-on experience with CI/CD systems (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins) and containerized test environments (Docker, Kubernetes). - Experience testing APIs and microservices, including contract, integration, and end-to-end testing. - Hands-on experience testing LLM-based products, chatbots, or AI agents, and an understanding of why traditional deterministic assertions break down for generative systems. - Practical experience with eval frameworks or tooling (e.g., promptfoo, DeepEval, RAGAS, LangSmith) or a track record of building your own. - Understanding of how LLM agents work: prompting, tool/function calling, context management, RAG, memory, and orchestration frameworks. - Experience designing test data and labeled datasets, including sourcing, sampling, and managing dataset drift over time. - Familiarity with LLM-specific failure modes: hallucination, prompt injection, context poisoning, tool misuse, goal drift, and non-determinism. - Comfort operating in ambiguity, defining what “correct” means for a task when there’s no single right answer. - Strong written communication skills for turning fuzzy quality signals into clear, actionable findings for engineering and product stakeholders. PREFERRED - Experience with human-in-the-loop evaluation workflows (labeling pipelines, inter-rater reliability, rubric design). - Experience with performance and load testing tools (e.g., k6, Locust) and chaos or fault-injection testing. - Background in ML/data science sufficient to read model evals and statistical significance. - Experience red-teaming or doing adversarial/security testing on ML systems. - Familiarity with observability and tracing tools for LLM applications (e.g., LangSmith, Arize, Langfuse, Weights & Biases) and general observability stacks (OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Datadog). - Experience testing systems in industrial, IoT, or operational technology (OT) environments, including industrial protocols (OPC UA, MQTT, Modbus) or simulation and hardware-in-the-loop setups. - Experience supporting UAT, pilots, or customer-facing validation of complex products. - Experience setting up test and eval infrastructure from scratch at a startup or fast-moving team. WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR - An engineer who is equally comfortable writing a test framework and sitting down to break an agent by hand. - Someone who can build rigorous evaluation systems for problems that don’t have a single right answer, and who knows when human judgment is the right tool. - A systems thinker who enjoys turning ambiguous agent behavior into measurable, trustworthy signals. - A strong collaborator who partners well with ML engineers, backend engineers, and Forward Deployed teams. WHY JOIN NEXXA.AI http://Nexxa.AI? - Innovative Environment: Play a critical role in transforming heavy industries through groundbreaking AI and automation technologies.

THE IMPACT YOU’LL HAVE - Design, develop, and maintain server-side applications and services using languages like Java and Python - Implement robust and scalable APIs, web services, and microservices that support various front-end applications and user interactions - Use hands-on experience with AWS (preferred) or other cloud infrastructure to build cloud native applications that scale and perform for the end users - Optimize code and databases for performance, scalability, and maintainability - Identify and resolve technical challenges and bottlenecks in the backend systems - Design and maintain data pipelines, ELT processes, and data integration solutions to support data analytics and reporting needs - Work with large datasets, both structured and unstructured, and implement data storage and retrieval mechanisms - Collaborate with data scientists and analysts to ensure data quality, accuracy, and availability for business insights - Implement data security and privacy best practices to protect sensitive information - Implement CI/CD pipelines in conformance with the existing frameworks and automate deployment processes to ensure smooth releases - Monitor and troubleshoot production systems to ensure high availability and performance - Participate in on-call rotations and incident response when necessary - Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for code, architecture, and data processes - Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including product managers and domain experts to deliver high-quality software solutions - Mentor junior engineers in their short and long term growth and help the organization by improving it’s engineering efficiency WHO YOU ARE - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. Master's degree is a plus - Proven experience as a Software Engineer, with a minimum of 8 years working on software engineering, data pipelines, data integration, and database management - Strong expertise in AWS services, including but not limited to S3, Glue, Athena, DynamoDB, Kinesis etc. - Hands-on experience working with data integration tools such as Fivetran - Hands-on experience working with orchestration services such as Airflow - Proficiency in various modern databases - relational, non-relational and data warehouses such as Amazon Aurora, Cassandra, DynamoDB and Snowflake - Solid programming skills in modern languages like Python, Java, or Scala - Knowledge of data modeling, ELT processes, and data warehousing concepts - Hands-on experience in building and operating containerized workloads and services such as Kubernetes on cloud - Familiarity with data quality and data governance principles - Strong problem-solving skills and an ability to work independently and as part of a team - Ability to take an abstract problem and lead the team through the design, build, deployment and operations stage - Excellent communication skills to collaborate with cross-functional teams and articulate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders - Experience working with distributed teams - be a self starter and proactive in communication - Be a mentor to junior engineers and be a champion of software engineering principles and best practices for the organization - Experience using AI tools effectively and responsibly to accelerate design, development and operations, including reviewing and validating AI-generated output, protecting sensitive data and customer information, and following company security, privacy and compliance guidelines - AWS or other relevant certifications are a plus Compensation and Benefits Marqeta calibrates pay to a competitive value according to working location. jobs.description: WHAT WE ARE BUILDING Mimica https://www.mimica.ai/careers is an AI-powered process intelligence platform enabling enterprises and individuals to reclaim their most precious resource: time. We've all seen repetitive tasks and redundant processes quietly drain productivity and creativity. Not because companies don’t want to become more efficient, but because they don’t know where to start. Mimica automatically analyzes your team’s work, then generates the AI agents to execute it. Our software turns everyday work into data-backed decisions, helping companies remove process bottlenecks, automate the right tasks, and upskill teams with precision and confidence. We’ve raised $26 million in Series B financing and are scaling fast. Backed by investors including Khosla Ventures and Paladin Capital, our proprietary AI technology is trusted by Fortune 500 companies to accelerate transformation. Mimica is recognized as a Top 100 AI Start-up by Accel and an industry Leader by the Everest Group. Our team Behind our platform is a team of exceptionally talented people, remote-first and globally distributed across 16+ countries. We're looking for curious, collaborative people excited to solve complex problems. You'll join a fast-paced environment built on high ownership, bottom-up thinking, and transparent, open communication – helping some of the world's leading organizations transform the way work gets done with AI. YOUR MISSION Mimica is growing fast, and so is the demand on our Platform Team. As Head of Platform, you will lead a lean but highly capable team that is the backbone of every engineering squad in the company, and you will own the infrastructure strategy, including all AI infrastructure, as we scale. The Platform team services the entire engineering organisation: keeping environments healthy, unblocking teams, building the infrastructure that lets everyone else move faster, and working with teams regarding SRE topics and developer experience too. As you work with us, the role will develop into designing Mimica’s infrastructure strategy at scale. The team has 4 engineers today, around 6 by the end of the year, and 10+ in 2027, so the role has the potential to grow into a “manager of managers” level as the company grows. This is a role with real scope: expanding to multi-region and physically separated database environments, supporting Mimica’s first installable infrastructure component for enterprise, and owning FinOps. One day you are defining the standard menu of deployment options for enterprise customers, the next you are in a security review or an architecture decision on AI infrastructure. We are looking for leaders with either an application development or a systems/infrastructure background. What matters more than your origin story is your hands-on credibility with Kubernetes, IaC, and cloud platforms, your ability to lead engineers and other leaders, and your ability to collaborate closely with Product, ML, Security, Sales and Customer Success. If you want to work in a place where your contributions are visible, your scope is broad, and the problems are real, this is the role for you. PART OF YOUR DAY-TO-DAY - Own Mimica's infrastructure strategy and the platform roadmap across all products, with the final call on cloud architecture, deployment models, infra vendors and platform standards. - Lead and grow the Platform team: Manage existing Platform and SREs, plan headcount, set goals and metrics, and design the sub-team split (Cloud & Developer Platform, Reliability & SRE, AI Infrastructure) as the team grows. - Own all AI infrastructure, including training and serving infra, MLOps tooling, Vertex and model access. - Maintain Mimica’s DevEx culture - improve agency for product teams without compromising on compliance, create paved roads for deployments, and identify pain points as they arise. - Own the infra and LLM budget, forecast and unit economics, including cost attribution by product and customer and the GCP relationship. - Own reliability across engineering: SLOs, on-call model, incident process, postmortems, DR testing and capacity planning. - Own the CI/CD and developer platform, infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, ArgoCD, Crossplane) and observability standards (Honeycomb, Grafana, Loki). - Work with the Platform PM, your peer, to define client needs and turn them into the platform roadmap. - Act as the named technical owner for infrastructure in enterprise deals and security reviews, joining high-stakes sales and client calls and coaching your team to take the rest. - Guide the craft mentors for infrastructure, MLOps and Python engineering, and set engineering-wide standards for reliability, on-call, CI/CD and craft. - Report monthly platform health and costs to leadership, and lead the infrastructure part of technical due diligence. REQUIREMENTS - Proven experience leading engineers, ideally including managing a team lead or other managers, and growing a team through hiring and sub-team design. - Solid hands-on experience with Kubernetes, whether on GKE (preferred), EKS, OnPrem, or another managed Kubernetes service, across multiple regions. - Proven experience with infrastructure-as-code as a core part of your platform, such as Terraform, and with ArgoCD or a comparable GitOps tool. - A track record in owning reliability: setting SLOs and SLAs, running on-call, leading incident response and postmortems, and testing disaster recovery. - Observability experience with at least one major platform: Honeycomb, Datadog, Grafana, or New Relic. - Comfortable with code, and able to review architecture and prototypes hands-on. - Experience owning an infrastructure budget, including cloud cost attribution, forecasting and cloud-provider relationships. - Experience designing deployment models for enterprise customers (single tenant, regional, data residency) and supporting security reviews and contracted SLAs. - Background in startups or scale-ups: you are used to ambiguity, moving fast, and wearing multiple hats. - Strong communication and collaboration skills: you can translate infrastructure complexity into clear language for engineers, executives and clients, and you know when to say no to bespoke requests. BONUS / NICE TO HAVE - Familiarity with Crossplane, or a similar product like Config Connector. - Experience with Temporal for workflow orchestration. - Security and compliance experience, particularly supporting SOC 2. - Experience supporting a funding round, including technical due diligence. WHAT WE OFFER 💰 Generous compensation + stock options - aligned with our internal framework, market data, and individual skills. 🏢 Distributed work: Work from anywhere - fully remote, in our hubs, or a mix. 💻 Company-issued laptop, remote setup stipend, and co-working budget 📍 Flexible schedules and location ☀️ Ample paid time off, in addition to local public holidays 🍼 Enhanced parental leave 🧘‍♀️ Health & retirement benefits 📖 Annual learning & development budget 🌴 Annual workaways and regular virtual & in-person socials 🌍 Opportunity to contribute to groundbreaking projects that shape the future of work Note: Some benefits may vary depending on location and role ⚠️ Mimica will only contact candidates from an @mimica.ai email address. We do not request banking or sensitive personal information during the recruiting process.

jobs.description: MaintainX is a leading mobile-first work execution platform for industrial and frontline teams. More than 15,000 customers, including McDonalds, Michaels, Cintas, Redimix, and U.S. LBM, use MaintainX to cut unplanned downtime and run better operations, across 16 million managed assets and 92 million completed work orders. In August 2026 MaintainX became part of Autodesk, joining Autodesk Operations Solutions https://adsknews.autodesk.com/en/views/inside-autodesk-operations-solutions/, the organization unifying Autodesk's operations platform alongside Tandem, FlexSim and Fusion Operations. Autodesk's strategy is to converge design, make and operate into one continuous lifecycle: design an asset, build it, run it, then feed what you learn running it back into the next design. Autodesk had design and make. Operate is the phase that tells you what actually happened, and it is ours. ABOUT THE TEAM Platform & Infrastructure keeps everything else fast, reliable and easy to build on. We own the shared services every product team builds on top of (identity, search, communication and our Pantry design system), the tooling that makes our engineers productive, and the release and runtime foundations that let us ship with confidence. Build it once, and every team benefits. TEAMS YOU MIGHT JOIN - Product Foundation: Identity, communication, search and Pantry, including the Integrations Marketplace, Global Search and the Pantry Design System. - Developer Productivity: Internal tooling and IDE plugins that make every engineer faster. - Release + Runtime and Testing: CI/CD, SRE, FedRAMP compliance and QA. This team leans more toward infrastructure and reliability. WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON - Set the technical direction for the shared services and components that other teams depend on. - Design APIs, tools and design system components that other engineers want to use, and drive adoption across teams. - Improve the speed, safety and reliability of how we build, test and ship software. - Treat internal engineers as your customers: gather feedback, measure adoption and iterate. THE ROLE - Lead the design and delivery of large, ambiguous projects end to end, from planning through production. - Partner directly with Product Managers, Designers, Engineering leadership, and the engineers who build on your work to shape your team’s roadmap and influence the roadmaps of adjacent teams. - Own the long-term technical health of a platform domain: reliability, performance, and the parts of the codebase nobody notices until they break. - Drive architecture decisions and write the technical proposals others build against. - Mentor senior and staff engineers, and set the standard for code review on your team. - Raise the bar on tooling, testing, and delivery practices across teams, not just your own. Our core stack is TypeScript, React, Node.js, and MySQL. Some teams use C# or Python. You don't need to already know every piece of it to apply. You'll land on a team of 5 to 10 people and take on-call rotation as part of the role. Within your first 6 months, you’ll own the technical direction of a platform domain or system outright. WHERE WE WORK We don't have a minimum in-office mandate, but we prefer our teams to be located around our office hubs. In Canada this includes: Montreal and Toronto. WE'RE LOOKING FOR - 10+ years of professional experience building full-stack web or mobile products, including a track record of leading technical work at a scope beyond a single team. - Deep hands-on experience with TypeScript, React, and Node.js. - Experience designing shared systems that held up at scale, and the judgment to know when not to build something. - Experience with mobile-first, responsive, iterative development. - A track record of writing maintainable, testable code you’re comfortable handing off to someone else. - Strong written and verbal communication: you can explain a technical tradeoff to a designer, a support lead, or an executive as easily as to another developer. - Comfort making progress on a problem before the spec is fully settled, adjusting as you learn more. - Day-to-day use of AI tools in your development workflow, not just occasional experimentation. - Nice to have: GraphQL, React Native, or SQL database experience. For this area, we also value: Experience with search technology, authentication and identity, design systems or component libraries, developer tooling or IDE extensions, CI/CD, observability, or compliance programs such as FedRAMP or SOC 2. Our mission is to keep the physical world running. Factories, fleets, hospitals and campuses stay up because the people who maintain them have tools worth using. That is what we build. Compensation and benefits. Base pay is one part of the package. Depending on the role, compensation may also include commission, an annual bonus and equity. Benefits differ by country. For roles in the United States, Autodesk’s benefits are described at benefits.autodesk.com http://benefits.autodesk.com. For roles in Canada and other countries, the plan differs on health coverage, retirement and leave, and your recruiter will walk you through it. Belonging. We take pride in a culture where everyone can thrive. More at autodesk.com/company/global-belonging http://autodesk.com/company/global-belonging. More on where this is going: Autodesk CEO Andrew Anagnost on building the future of connected operations https://adsknews.autodesk.com/en/news/building-the-future-of-connected-operations/, and AOS SVP Stephen Hooper on welcoming MaintainX to Autodesk https://adsknews.autodesk.com/en/views/inside-autodesk-operations-solutions/.

With over 100 ML models in production, engineers have opportunities to take ownership of meaningful projects, work closely with experienced teammates, and quickly see the impact of their work. We're building the next generation of AI-powered systems to improve content quality and safety across Quora. By leveraging LLMs and agentic workflows, we're transforming how we detect harmful content, automate complex decisions, and respond to evolving challenges at scale. As a Machine Learning Engineer (New Grad), you'll work alongside experienced engineers to design, evaluate, and deploy these systems in production. No previous trust and safety experience is required. You'll learn from the engineers who built these systems. jobs.description: MaintainX is a leading mobile-first work execution platform for industrial and frontline teams. More than 15,000 customers, including McDonalds, Michaels, Cintas, Redimix, and U.S. LBM, use MaintainX to cut unplanned downtime and run better operations, across 16 million managed assets and 92 million completed work orders.
