Autodesk's strategy is to converge design, make and operate into one continuous lifecycle: design an asset, build it, run it, then feed what you learn running it back into the next design. Autodesk had design and make. Operate is the phase that tells you what actually happened, and it is ours. ABOUT THE TEAM Core is the heart of the MaintainX CMMS: the work orders, planning and scheduling, inventory and parts, reporting, and asset hierarchy that frontline teams touch every day. It is also where some of our newest investment is happening, including two newly formed teams building a Work Execution Platform and a rebuilt Technician Experience from scratch. If you want to work close to what customers use daily, and have a chance at green-field ownership, this is the place. TEAMS YOU MIGHT JOIN - Planners: Planner and scheduler workflows, plus Operating Hours. - Inventory Management / Parts: Spare parts, purchase orders, forecasting and vendors. - Home / Reporting: The Overview screen, plus shared and scheduled reports. - Work Execution Platform: The work order primitives the product runs on: recurrence, assignment, calendar, procedures, automations and permits. - Technician Experience: GPS check-in, field UX and offline state for technicians in the field. - Enterprise Data Management: Global, multi-site platform capabilities, templates, asset hierarchy and location, and dynamic asset forms. WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON - Set the technical direction for the workflows customers use every day, from scheduling and parts management to reporting. - Solve hard product problems: dense, data-heavy interfaces, large datasets, offline behaviour and multi-site scale. - On our newly formed teams, define architecture and engineering practices from the ground up. - Make complex workflows feel simple on desktop and mobile. Our core stack is TypeScript, React, Node.js, and MySQL. Some teams use C# or Python. You don't need to already know every piece of it to apply. You'll land on a team of 5 to 10 people and take on-call rotation as part of the role. Within your first 6 months, you’ll own the technical direction of a domain or system outright. WHERE WE WORK We don't have a minimum in-office mandate, but we prefer our teams to be located around our office hubs. In Canada this includes: Montreal and Toronto. WE'RE LOOKING FOR - 10+ years of professional experience building full-stack web or mobile products, including a track record of leading technical work at a scope beyond a single team. - Deep hands-on experience with TypeScript, React, and Node.js. - Experience designing systems that held up at scale, and the judgment to know when not to build something. - Experience with mobile-first, responsive, iterative development. - A track record of writing maintainable, testable code you’re comfortable handing off to someone else. - Strong written and verbal communication: you can explain a technical tradeoff to a designer, a support lead, or an executive as easily as to another developer. - Comfort making progress on a problem before the spec is fully settled, adjusting as you learn more. - Day-to-day use of AI tools in your development workflow, not just occasional experimentation. - Nice to have: GraphQL, React Native, or SQL database experience. For this area, we also value: Experience with scheduling or calendar UIs, data-heavy front ends, offline-first or sync architectures, multi-tenant or enterprise platforms, workflow engines, or inventory and transactional systems. Our mission is to keep the physical world running. Factories, fleets, hospitals and campuses stay up because the people who maintain them have tools worth using. That is what we build. Compensation and benefits. Base pay is one part of the package. Depending on the role, compensation may also include commission, an annual bonus and equity. Benefits differ by country. For roles in Canada and other countries, the plan differs on health coverage, retirement and leave, and your recruiter will walk you through it. Belonging. We take pride in a culture where everyone can thrive. More at autodesk.com/company/global-belonging http://autodesk.com/company/global-belonging. jobs.description: WHO ARE WE? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems. We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! WHY THIS ROLE? This role is for a highly experienced Back-End Software Engineer who wants to work on core systems that shape how the platform (Model Vault) operates. You will help define the architecture of the platform where reliability, security, performance, and simplicity all matter, and where many of the problems do not have off-the-shelf solutions. Model Vault is Cohere’s inference platform for deploying and operating models securely at enterprise scale. The team owns the systems between a customer and the underlying AI infrastructure, including identity, deployments, metering, billing, security, privacy, and confidential computing. We are strengthening these systems as Model Vault grows, with the goal of scaling to millions of users and supporting some of the world’s most demanding enterprise workloads. AS A SENIOR/STAFF SOFTWARE ENGINEER, YOU WILL: - Evolve and scale the backend systems that power Model Vault, including authentication and authorization, deployment management, billing, metering, and customer lifecycle. - Lead major architectural initiatives across identity, payments, usage systems, platform scalability, and other core product foundations. - Build highly reliable control-plane services for provisioning, configuring, scaling, and operating model deployments across clouds and hardware platforms. - Design APIs and distributed systems with strong guarantees around correctness, consistency, isolation, failure recovery, idempotency, and observability. - Build security and privacy into the platform architecture, including tenant isolation, least-privilege access, auditability, secrets management, encryption, and confidential computing boundaries. - Solve complex problems that span backend systems, cloud infrastructure, security, and AI inference, where conventional SaaS patterns are often not enough. - Drive projects end-to-end, from architecture and threat modeling through implementation, rollout, production operations, and iteration based on real customer workloads. YOU MAY BE A GOOD FIT IF: - You are a strong backend engineer with excellent fundamentals in distributed systems, databases, networking, operating systems, and security. - You have strong programming fundamentals and experience building production systems in languages such as Go, Python, Java, C++, Rust, or similar. You write clean, maintainable, well-tested code and make thoughtful tradeoffs between simplicity, performance, and correctness. - You have designed and operated production systems where correctness, availability, security, and performance mattered at significant scale. - You can take ambiguous, high-impact technical problems, define the right architecture, and drive them through to reliable production systems. - You have strong systems-design instincts and understand concepts such as concurrency, consistency, caching, queues, rate limiting, backpressure, failure domains, idempotency, and graceful degradation. - You think deeply about security boundaries and understand authentication, authorization, identity, cryptography, secrets, tenant isolation, and how small implementation choices can create significant security risks. - You are comfortable reasoning across backend services, APIs, databases, distributed systems, and the cloud infrastructure they run on. - You are comfortable diving into unfamiliar codebases and debugging complex problems that cross service or system boundaries. - You care about the details of production engineering, including instrumentation, capacity planning, migrations, backwards compatibility, incident response, and safe rollouts. - You are comfortable challenging existing architecture and evolving foundational components when the system’s needs change. - You have a track record of taking technically difficult projects from an unclear starting point to systems that other engineers and customers depend on. FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS: - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch. - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health. - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme. - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent. - Annual enrichment benefits: Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit. Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching. - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!) - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite. HOW AND WHERE WE WORK: - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon. - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events. - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city. - Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly. If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12a6IrLdF3kI2nonKSr4tiFuz18rLQbaeYV-JM9L4o9Q/edit, and we will work together to meet your needs. We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider. Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers https://cohere.com/careers page.

jobs.description: WHO IS LITMUS Litmus is building the data foundation that powers industrial AI. AI doesn’t work without real-world, contextualized data - Litmus makes that data usable. As AI adoption accelerates, most industrial environments still can’t access or use their operational data. We solve that gap. We’re a growth-stage software company helping manufacturers access, structure, and use real-time data from machines, systems, and sensors at the edge. Our platform sits at the intersection of edge computing, AI, and industrial operations, enabling some of the world’s largest companies to run operations in real time, reduce downtime, and optimize production. Backed by leading investors and trusted by global manufacturers and partners like Google, Microsoft, Dell, Oracle, and Mitsubishi, Litmus is powering the shift toward software-defined manufacturing. WHY JOIN LITMUS BUILD THE INFRASTRUCTURE THAT MAKES INDUSTRIAL AI POSSIBLE AI is moving beyond the cloud and into the physical world. At Litmus, you’ll build the infrastructure that enables real-time data to power AI and machine learning systems in production environments. WORK ON PROBLEMS WHERE SOFTWARE MEETS THE REAL WORLD Most AI systems fail without access to real-world data. You’ll build the layer that makes them viable in production. We solve challenges at the intersection of distributed systems, real-time data, and industrial constraints — where reliability, scale, and performance are non-negotiable. HAVE REAL IMPACT, FAST You’ll work on systems used by real customers in production, with direct impact on product and company trajectory. As a scaling company, we move quickly. You’ll have ownership, visibility, and the ability to shape both product and company as we scale. JOIN A HIGH-PERFORMANCE TEAM We’re building a team that holds a high bar and pushes each other to improve. You’ll work alongside experienced operators, engineers, and leaders who have done this before and are building again at scale. We hire people who take ownership, move quickly, and care about outcomes. No passengers. OUR CULTURE At Litmus, the team is collaborative, curious, and low ego. People are scrappy, take ownership, and look for ways to make an impact. We value empathy just as much as execution, whether that’s in how we build, how we communicate, or how we support each other. We’re a growing company, so things move quickly and not everything is perfectly defined. If you enjoy figuring things out, working closely with others, and making steady progress, you’ll do well here. ABOUT THE ROLE You’ll lead the team that builds the face of an industrial platform running on factory floors around the world. Litmus Edge is how engineers see and shape what’s happening in their plants, and the UI your team owns covers it all: configuring and operating the edge itself, the marketplace of applications that run on it, and the data, models and analytics engineers build from what their devices produce. You’ll set the architecture for a single codebase that ships as a dozen differently branded products and keep it coherent as features come in from multiple engineering teams. This is a high-impact role with significant ownership of the technical direction of Litmus Edge, while leading and growing a small, senior front-end team. WHAT YOU’LL DO - Own the front-end architecture of the Litmus Edge UI, including the Angular/TypeScript applications, shared component library, state and theming patterns, and configuration that allows a single codebase to ship as multiple OEM-branded products - Build and maintain complex, data-heavy interfaces across configuration, marketplace and analytics workflows, keeping them performant and maintainable as they grow - Mentor the engineers on your team, help them resolve complex issues, and make key architectural and design decisions alongside other lead engineers - Review your team’s code and front-end contributions from across Engineering, while remaining hands-on in development yourself - Work closely with Product, QA and Backend Engineering to meet requirements, align the UI with its APIs, and protect the test hooks that QA automation depends on - Own how UI changes reach customers, including tagging components for builds and following the team’s branching conventions. Uphold code quality through unit testing, accessibility and cross-browser standards, and security vulnerability management WHAT YOU’LL BRING Have To Have: - Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a similar field - 8+ years of experience in frontend development, including 5+ years building production applications with Angular (v2+) and TypeScript - 3+ years of experience as a technical team lead - Strong command of modern front-end architecture, including component design, reactive state management (RxJS) and shared component libraries - Experience building and debugging complex, data-heavy interfaces, such as real-time data applications, visualisations or large editable grids - Solid understanding of cross-browser compatibility, accessibility standards and design principles - Proficiency with Git, CI/CD pipelines and collaborative development workflows NICE TO HAVE - Experience shipping white-labelled or OEM-branded products from a single codebase - Familiarity with OIDC/Keycloak authentication and role-based access control in the browser - Exposure to industrial automation, IIoT or other operational technology (OT) domains Litmus Automation is an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. We believe diverse perspectives lead to innovation.

jobs.description: Fellow is the AI meeting assistant that helps teams turn conversations into decisions and action, built from the ground up with privacy and security in mind. We are looking for a full-stack Software Engineer to join our Engineering team and help build the core Fellow experience. You will work across the stack, from APIs and data models to polished product experiences, owning features from early idea through production and iteration. This is a role for someone who likes shipping. You will work closely with Product and Design, move quickly from ambiguous problems to working software, and stay close to how people actually use what you build. We care about good judgment, thoughtful execution, and finding the highest-leverage path to a great outcome. It is also an AI-native role. We use tools like Claude Code and Cursor throughout the development process, and we are looking for an engineer who thrives with this way of working. You should be excited to push beyond default workflows, experiment with new ways of building software, and use AI with the judgment required to ship high-quality production code. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Build and ship product features end to end across React, TypeScript, Django, Python, GraphQL, and the systems around them. - Take ownership of meaningful product areas, from understanding the problem and shaping the technical approach through implementation, rollout, monitoring, and iteration. - Partner closely with Product and Design to turn broad ideas into simple, polished experiences that people genuinely enjoy using. - Move quickly without losing sight of quality, writing thoughtful tests, reviewing code carefully, and keeping performance, reliability, and maintainability in mind. - Dig into real-world problems and user feedback, trace issues to their root cause, and turn what you learn into durable improvements. - Write and refine technical plans, break ambiguous work into practical pieces, and make good trade-offs when there is no perfect answer. - Use AI coding agents deeply in your daily workflow, and help develop new tools, prompts, workflows, and practices that materially improve how the team builds software. - Contribute to technical discussions, code reviews, and shared engineering practices while learning from the people around you and helping others do their best work. - Help shape what we build next as Fellow continues evolving. Success means shipping useful things quickly, making the product noticeably better, and leaving the codebase and the way we work stronger than you found them. WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR - Professional software engineering experience building and shipping production software. - Experience with modern web technologies. Our stack includes React, TypeScript, Django, Python, GraphQL, and Relay, but we care more about strong engineering fundamentals than exact stack matching. - A track record of owning features or projects beyond implementation, including technical design, rollout, monitoring, and iteration. - Strong product judgment and an instinct for finding practical solutions that create meaningful user impact. - Excellence in working through ambiguity, asking good questions, and taking initiative without waiting for every detail to be defined. - Deep, practical use of AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or similar tools, paired with strong judgment and a track record of developing new agentic workflows, tools, or practices that materially improve how software gets built. - Clear communication and the ability to collaborate closely with engineers, Product, Design, QA, and other partners. - A desire to learn quickly, and contribute to a team that moves fast and cares about the quality of what it ships. HOW WE WORK Fellow is a remote-first company, working in Eastern time. This role is open to candidates located in Canada. Optional office space is available in Ottawa and Montreal. We move quickly, share work early, and help one another get unstuck. We like ambitious goals, practical solutions, and people who bring energy to solving problems. Engineers at Fellow have meaningful ownership. You will not be handed a stream of perfectly scoped tickets. We expect you to understand the problem, form a point of view, work with the right people, and help drive the solution through to something real. We believe speed and craftsmanship reinforce each other. Good judgment, clear ownership, strong tooling, and thoughtful engineering let us ship quickly while continuing to raise the quality bar. We use AI tools throughout the software-development lifecycle, not only to generate code. We experiment constantly with new workflows and expect engineers to help shape what AI-native product development should look like. And we believe work should be fun. The work matters, but we do our best work when the team is curious, collaborative, direct, and genuinely excited to build together. jobs.description: <div class="content-intro"><p><img style="display: none; max-width: 100%;" src="https://click.appcast.io/greenhouse-te8/a31.png?ent=34&amp;e=22630&amp;t=1701374353806" width="1px"> <img style="display: none; max-width: 100%;" src="https://track.jobadx.com/v1/i.gif?utm_pixel=224e990b-8ff4-4287-8d5d-2ff09647f181&amp;utm_ptz=EST&amp;utm_rqt=track" alt="" width="1"></p></div><h2>About the Team</h2> <p>The Notification Hub and Experience team is a product-focused engineering team responsible for one of the company's most scalable growth levers. Our mission is to deliver intelligent, personalized notifications that reach the right user, in the right channel, at the right time. The Notification Hub is the home of comms personalized to you, where every notification a customer has ever gotten lives on, browsable and actionable, so a missed push never means a missed deal. We operate at a massive scale, and we are transitioning from a campaign-centric mode to a fully personalized experience that treats notifications as a sequential, over-time experience with continuously learning from user behavior.</p> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>We are looking for a Staff Backend Engineer to join our team. As a Staff Engineer, you are a technical leader and trusted advisor — you set the engineering excellence bar, own ambiguous cross-functional problems, and shape the roadmap for your domain. You will be the technical visionary leading our transition into high-level autonomy. jobs.description: About the Team The ClickPipes team builds the services that power data ingestion into ClickHouse Cloud. As a primary entry point for customers’ data, ClickPipes is critical to product adoption and the company’s growth. We work at petabyte scale, solving challenges in distributed systems, fault tolerance, and high-throughput ingestion. You’ll help make these pipelines performant, reliable, and easy to operate, with ownership of technical decisions and the platform as a whole. You can find some of the team’s recent work highlighted in our blog: - GCP Pub/Sub connector for ClickPipes is now in Private Preview https://clickhouse.com/blog/clickpipes-gcp-pub-sub-preview - Terraform & OpenAPI for ClickPipes is now Generally Available https://clickhouse.com/blog/terraform-ga - Unordered mode for GCS ClickPipes is now available https://clickhouse.com/blog/clickpipes-gcs-unordered-mode We’re looking for backend engineers with experience in data-intensive systems who enjoy working across technologies. You’ll collaborate with engineering and product partners and drive projects from design through production. jobs.description: MaintainX is a leading mobile-first work execution platform for industrial and frontline teams. More than 15,000 customers, including McDonalds, Michaels, Cintas, Redimix, and U.S. LBM, use MaintainX to cut unplanned downtime and run better operations, across 16 million managed assets and 92 million completed work orders. In August 2026 MaintainX became part of Autodesk, joining Autodesk Operations Solutions https://adsknews.autodesk.com/en/views/inside-autodesk-operations-solutions/, the organization unifying Autodesk's operations platform alongside Tandem, FlexSim and Fusion Operations. Autodesk's strategy is to converge design, make and operate into one continuous lifecycle: design an asset, build it, run it, then feed what you learn running it back into the next design. Autodesk had design and make. Operate is the phase that tells you what actually happened, and it is ours. We're looking for a Senior Technical Product Manager to own two foundational domains within our Product Foundations Group: Identity & Access Management (IAM) and Entitlements and Product Configuration. IAM controls how enterprise customers configure and govern access across their organizations, including a customer-facing admin console, delegated administration, and granular permissions. Entitlements and Product Configuration is a new domain we're standing up to bring a single, coherent framework to how MaintainX decides what a customer organization has access to — spanning monetization (subscription plans, paid add-ons), feature rollout and experimentation, and organization-level customization. Today that logic is scattered across several disconnected systems with no unified owner. This role is for a PM who can operate in two different modes: driving a mature team's expanded charter, and founding a new product domain where the charter is still being defined. You'll partner with engineering to build both, and with Sales, CS, and Finance to make sure the licensing and entitlements work reflects real business operations. What You'll Do - Own the product roadmap for IAM and Entitlements and Product Configuration teams - Define the initial charter, roadmap, and success metrics for Entitlements and Product Configuration, a new domain within Product Foundations - Partner with engineering to prioritize sequence delivery - Define a unified framework and engineering patterns for how features are flagged, gated, and rolled out across the product, replacing today's fragmented systems - Identify and prioritize the biggest gaps in how monetization, feature rollout, experimentation, and entitlements are managed today - Ensure entitlement and license-count data stays accurate as billing ownership transitions to Autodesk - Partner with Sales, Customer Success, and Finance to ensure licensing and entitlement work reflects real go-to-market and operational needs - Introduce consistent product practices across both domains About You - 6+ years of product management experience, including experience defining a roadmap or product charter with limited existing structure - Comfortable working across a mature, technically deep domain (IAM) and a nascent one (Entitlements and Product Configuration) at the same time - Technically fluent in identity concepts (authentication, authorization, SSO, SCIM, permission models) and comfortable engaging with entitlement and product-configuration concepts (feature flagging, paywalls, experimentation tooling, plan tiers) - Comfortable driving consolidation of fragmented legacy systems into a unified technical framework, partnering closely with engineering across multiple feature teams - Strong prioritization instincts — can take a loosely-scoped problem (a new domain, an expanded charter) and quickly establish what to build first and why - Experience building 0-to-1 product functions, or introducing product rigour where little existed - Comfortable partnering internally with Sales, CS, and Finance stakeholders, not just engineering Our mission is to keep the physical world running. Factories, fleets, hospitals and campuses stay up because the people who maintain them have tools worth using. That is what we build. Compensation and benefits. Base pay is one part of the package. Depending on the role, compensation may also include commission, an annual bonus and equity. Benefits differ by country. For roles in the United States, Autodesk’s benefits are described at benefits.autodesk.com http://benefits.autodesk.com. For roles in Canada and other countries, the plan differs on health coverage, retirement and leave, and your recruiter will walk you through it. Belonging. We take pride in a culture where everyone can thrive. More at autodesk.com/company/global-belonging http://autodesk.com/company/global-belonging. More on where this is going: Autodesk CEO Andrew Anagnost on building the future of connected operations https://adsknews.autodesk.com/en/news/building-the-future-of-connected-operations/, and AOS SVP Stephen Hooper on welcoming MaintainX to Autodesk https://adsknews.autodesk.com/en/views/inside-autodesk-operations-solutions/.

jobs.description: <div class="content-intro"><p><img style="display: none; max-width: 100%;" src="https://click.appcast.io/greenhouse-te8/a31.png?ent=34&amp;e=22630&amp;t=1701374353806" width="1px"> <img style="display: none; max-width: 100%;" src="https://track.jobadx.com/v1/i.gif?utm_pixel=224e990b-8ff4-4287-8d5d-2ff09647f181&amp;utm_ptz=EST&amp;utm_rqt=track" alt="" width="1"></p></div><h2><strong>About the Team</strong></h2> <p>DoorDash is building the world's most reliable on-demand, logistics engine for delivery! We're looking for experienced engineers to join our fast-growing engineering team to help us develop a 24x7, global infrastructure system that powers DoorDash’s three-sided marketplace of consumers, merchants, and dashers.</p> <h2><strong>About the Role</strong></h2> <p>We’re looking for product-focused iOS Engineers who love building reliable, intuitive, and beautiful experiences on mobile. We aren’t just developing an app; we’re building a mobile ecosystem from the ground up that integrates the consumers, merchants and drivers. This is a full-stack role where you’ll not only build complex apps but will also make impactful decisions on the product.&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>You're excited about this opportunity because you will...</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Work within our product teams to build exciting features</li> <li>Improve our code base through continuous refactoring</li> <li>Solve challenging real-time data transfer and synchronization problems</li> <li>Extend and implement our APIs</li> <li>Implement unit tests</li> <li>Keep up-to-date with the industry standards of iOS development</li> </ul> <h2><strong>We're excited about you because you have...</strong></h2> <ul> <li>B.S., M.S., or PhD. in Computer Science or equivalent</li> <li>5+ years of industry experience</li> <li>Expert at Swift, and iOS SDK</li> <li>Familiarity with networking, storage, and Cocoapods</li> <li>Systems and OOP knowledge</li> <li>Experience building, launching, and iterating on mobile apps</li> </ul><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><h1><strong>Compensation</strong></h1> <p>Actual compensation within the pay range listed below will be decided based on factors including, but not limited to, skills, prior relevant experience, and specific work location. Base salary is localized according to employee work location.&nbsp;</p> <p>In addition to base salary, the compensation for this role includes opportunities for equity grants. Talk to your recruiter for more information.</p> <p>DoorDash cares about you and your overall well-being. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package for all regular employees, that includes paid time off, paid parental leave, wellness benefit and several paid holidays.</p> <p>Additionally, for full-time employees, DoorDash offers medical, dental, and vision benefits, disability and basic life insurance, an RRSP including an employer match, and a mental health program, among others.</p> <p>To learn more about our benefits, visit our careers page <a href="https://careers.doordash.com/">here</a>.</p></div><div class="title">The base pay for this position ranges from our lowest geographical market up to our highest geographical market within British Columbia.</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$149,500</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>$187,000 CAD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><h1><strong>About DoorDash</strong></h1> <p>At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.</p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees’ happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more.</span></p> <h1><strong>Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion</strong></h1> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">If you need any accommodations, please inform your recruiting contact upon initial connection.<br><br><em>Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at <span class="_80om1qgj _1e0c1nu9" data-testid="smart-link-draggable-inline"><span class="loader-wrapper"><span class="hover-card-trigger-wrapper" data-testid="hover-card-trigger-wrapper"><a class="_1yt4x7n9 _2rko1ssi _v56415x0 _1e0c1nu9 _16d9qvcn _syaz13af _1rkwglyw _4cvx1w55 _19itia51 _bfhkhp5a _1a3b18uv _4fprglyw _5goinqa1 _9oik18uv _1bnxglyw _jf4cnqa1 _1nrm18uv _c2waglyw _1iohnqa1 _uizt1kdv _nt751r31 _49pcglyw _1hvw1o36 _1372tlke _7ehiw5lj _1j5pglyw _1di615s3" href="https://careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness" data-testid="inline-card-resolved-view"><span class="_19itglyw _vchhusvi _r06hglyw _o5721jtm _1nmz9jpi _16d9qvcn _ca0qv77o _u5f31b66 _n3tdv77o _19bv1b66" data-testid="inline-card-icon-and-title"><span class="_19itglyw _vchhusvi _r06hglyw">Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash</span></span></a></span></span></span> .</em><br></span></p></div>

jobs.description: WHO ARE WE? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems. We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! WHY THIS ROLE? The Cohere Dashboard is the control center for Cohere users and the starting point for many on their journey with Cohere. Here, they can access our models, manage API keys, manage teams, audit billing and explore our docs. In this role, you'll collaborate with internal partners to craft a delightful, intuitive, and unified experience across everything the Cohere Dashboard offers. Join our team of builders who are shaping the future of large language models! AS A FULL-STACK SOFTWARE ENGINEER ON THE COHERE DASHBOARD TEAM, YOU WILL: - Work with a small talented and enthusiastic team of software engineers - Contribute to delightful experiences for our user-facing products, meticulously crafting code for browsers and servers - Collaborate and grow with your engineering colleagues of all levels through direct pairing sessions, architectural designs, documentation and talks - Identify and remove roadblocks to enable your team to increase its engineering velocity - Build resilient systems that are mission-critical - Keep up with the cutting edge and adopt new technologies to improve performance and reliability YOU MAY BE A GOOD FIT IF: - You have experience shipping products with a large number of stakeholders - You’re comfortable with the front and back end of the stack, and have previously worked with Next.js, TypeScript, React, and Python - You have hands-on experience with complex SQL queries - You have excellent communication skills and believe that documentation is a great way to get feedback and discuss technical implementations and designs - You’re excited to add new technologies to your toolbox and use them where it makes sense - You have the ability to take complex needs and goals and develop easy to understand explanations for all audiences - You’re excited about AI and have the motivation to scale a company FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS: - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch. - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health. - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme. - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent. - Annual enrichment benefits: Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit. Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching. - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!) - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite. HOW AND WHERE WE WORK: - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon. - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events. - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city. - Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly. If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12a6IrLdF3kI2nonKSr4tiFuz18rLQbaeYV-JM9L4o9Q/edit, and we will work together to meet your needs. We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider. Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers https://cohere.com/careers page.

jobs.description: <p>In the 1840s, Charles Babbage and Ada Lovelace worked on an early version of the computer known as the “Analytics Engine”. In the words of computing historian Doron Swade, “What Lovelace saw...was that numbers could represent entities other than quantity” and together they laid the foundation for general-purpose computing.</p> <p>While much has changed since then, the importance of numbers in building great technology remains. We’re looking for Data Scientists who can help us build our analytics engine by making meaning from data and identifying opportunities for improvement.</p> <p>As a Growth Data Scientist at Mercury, you will partner with Growth product, design, engineering and marketing leaders to shape how Mercury acquires, activates and retains customers across business and personal banking*. This is a strategic, product-facing role: you’ll frame the “why” behind what we build, size opportunities, and turn the growth funnel into clear, prioritized recommendations. You will work as a full-stack Data Scientist on projects end to end and build deep domain expertise at the intersection of Data Science, Product and Growth. You will help set the direction for how Growth measures success and decides where to invest, in line with Mercury’s broader product and company goals.</p> <p><strong>Here are some things you’ll do on the job:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Partner with Growth product, design, engineering and marketing leaders to identify the highest-impact business questions, and influence what gets built and why.</li> <li>Own the growth funnel end to end, from first visit through signup, approval, activation and retention, building the metrics, driver trees and narratives that show where we’re winning and where we’re not.</li> <li>Size opportunities and help prioritize the Growth roadmap and annual planning, making clear recommendations even when data is incomplete.</li> <li>Design, analyze and communicate experiments (A/B tests and quasi-experimental methods) that tell teams whether a change worked and what to do next.</li> <li>Right-size your work to the decision: fast and directional when that’s what’s needed, rigorous when the stakes call for it.</li> <li>Collaborate with other Data Scientists, Data Engineers and Analytics Engineers to build trusted, self-serve growth metrics.</li> <li>Communicate findings and recommendations to audiences at all levels, including executives, with a clear point of view that improves entrepreneurs’ lives and generates revenue for Mercury.</li> </ul> <p><strong>You should:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Have 6+ years of experience in data science, product analytics or growth analytics, including 3+ years partnering closely with product growth teams.</li> <li>Have strong product sense and a track record of shaping product direction, not just measuring it, including times your work changed what a team built.</li> <li>Have deep experience with experiment design and analysis, as well as funnel, cohort and retention analysis.</li> <li>Have fluency in SQL and a statistical programming language (e.g. Python, R).</li> <li>Have experience with product analytics and BI tools such as Amplitude, Hex, Omni or similar; familiarity with Snowflake and dbt is a plus.</li> <li>Be comfortable with ambiguity and with respectfully disagreeing with senior stakeholders, backed by evidence.</li> <li>Be a clear, concise communicator who leads with the point and tailors the message to technical and non-technical audiences.</li> <li>Nice to have: experience in consumer or SMB fintech, or with mobile product analytics.</li> </ul> <p>* Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.</p> <p>Mercury values diversity &amp; belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All individuals seeking employment at Mercury are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities or special needs. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.</p> <p><span data-sheets-root="1">#LI-RA1</span></p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><strong>Total Rewards</strong><br>The total rewards package at Mercury includes base salary, equity (stock options/RSUs), and benefits.</p> <p>Our salary and equity ranges are highly competitive within the SaaS and fintech industry and are updated regularly using the most reliable compensation survey data for our industry. New hire offers are made based on a candidate’s experience, expertise, geographic location, and internal pay equity relative to peers.</p> <p>Our target new hire base salary ranges for this role are the following<strong>:</strong></p></div><div class="title">US employees (any location):</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$200,700</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>$250,900 USD</span></div></div><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">Canadian employees (any location):</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$189,700</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>$237,100 CAD</span></div></div></div>

jobs.description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.</p></div><p>The Marketplace and App Experience domain is the main pillar of our core consumer strategy, driving the user journey across all of our frontend surfaces: Mobile and Web. This role will be at the forefront of our front-end facing cross-team projects, working closely with other teams and engineers across our mobile and web technologies, while also evolving and collaborating with every product experience team at Affirm.<br><br><strong>What You'll Do</strong></p> <ul> <li>With the support of your team’s tech lead and manager, you will break down larger projects into individual tasks, deliver them in multiple phases, and collaborate with others to ensure timely delivery of your work.</li> <li>You will support your peers and stakeholders in the product development lifecycle by collaborating with product management, design &amp; analytics by participating in ideation, articulating technical constraints, and partnering on decisions that properly consider risks and trade-offs.</li> <li>You will support the operations and availability of your team’s artifacts by creating and monitoring metrics, escalating when needed, and supporting “keep the lights on” &amp; on-call efforts.</li> <li>You will contribute to a sense of community on your team by engaging in growth and development activities such as participation in the interview process.</li> </ul> <p><br><strong>What We Look For</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have a total of 4+ years of experience as a software engineer.</li> <li>You have experience shipping web apps using declarative UI frameworks like React or Vue</li> <li>You have experience shipping mobile apps using native or cross-platform languages like React Native</li> <li>You have experience designing, developing and launching APIs at scale using languages like Kotlin or Python.</li> <li>You have mastered taking a simple problem or business scenario into a solution that interacts with multiple software components, and executing on it by writing clear, easily understood, well tested and extensible code.</li> <li>You are comfortable navigating a large code base, debugging others' code, and providing feedback to other engineers through code reviews.</li> <li>Your experience demonstrates that you take ownership of your growth, proactively seeking feedback from your team, your manager, and your stakeholders.</li> <li>You have strong verbal and written communication skills that support effective collaboration with our global engineering team.</li> <li>This position requires either equivalent practical experience or a Bachelor’s degree in a related field.<br><br></li> </ul> <div> <p><strong>Base Pay Grade</strong> - N</p> <p><strong>Equity Grade</strong> - 6</p> <p>Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. (parent company).<br><br><strong>CAN base pay range per year: </strong>CAD $153,000 - $213,000</p> </div> <div> <div> <p><strong>Location - Remote Canada<br></strong>This remote role is open only to candidates residing in Alberta, British Columbia, Manitoba, New Brunswick, Newfoundland and Labrador, Nova Scotia, Ontario, Prince Edward Island, or Saskatchewan.</p> </div> </div> <div> <div><strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">#LI-Remote</span></strong></div> </div><div class="content-conclusion"><div> <p><strong>Remote-first with flexibility built in</strong><strong><br></strong>Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. If you need support, we’re happy to help.</p> <p>For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.</p> </div> <div> <p>By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's&nbsp;<a href="https://www.affirm.com/global-candidate-privacy-notice" target="_blank">Global Candidate Privacy Notice</a> and consent to the use of your personal information as described.</p> </div></div>

Waabi is backed by and partners with world leaders in AI, automotive, logistics, and deep tech. With offices in Toronto, San Francisco, Dallas, and Pittsburgh, Waabi is growing quickly and looking for diverse, innovative and collaborative candidates who want to impact the world in a positive way. To learn more visit: www.waabi.ai We are seeking a Product Manager to lead product definition for the hardware platform that carries the Waabi Driver, across autonomous trucks and robotaxi. This is our first dedicated hardware product role, and it requires someone who is grounded in hardware: a product leader who can turn the needs of autonomy, safety, operations, riders, and the public into clear requirements, and who knows enough about hardware to tell an ambitious idea from an impossible one. You will sit at the line between requirements and implementation, laying out scenarios, testing ideas in mock-ups and vehicles, partnering with hardware engineering on high-level solutions, and representing product with our OEM and supplier partners until the product is right end-to-end. You will... Own product requirements for Waabi's hardware platform across trucks and robotaxi, turning field and integration feedback into requirements for future revisions and new vehicle platforms. Define how our vehicles interact with the people around them, including riders, law enforcement, first responders, and the public. This covers exterior communication and signaling, cabin monitoring and security, in-cabin safety, and resilience to tampering and vandalism. Lead product definition for new hardware programs before engineering kickoff, turning real-world scenarios into requirements with clear acceptance criteria and a plan to verify and validate each one. Bring an industrial design and human factors perspective to physical touchpoints like displays, lighting, reach, and controls, and validate them hands-on in mock-ups and real vehicles. Build trusted relationships with OEM and supplier partners, understanding their constraints and processes and keeping requirements aligned across organizations. Represent hardware credibly in cross-functional product decisions about what's possible, what's costly, and what's out of scope. Qualifications: A hardware background, through an engineering degree (mechanical, electrical, systems, or similar) or equivalent hands-on experience, deep enough to earn engineering teams' trust while you work at the requirements level. 8+ years of experience in product management, hardware product, or systems engineering roles on physical products, ideally in automotive, autonomous vehicles, robotics, or complex consumer hardware. A track record of taking hardware from concept to production, with an understanding of how requirements evolve across prototype and sample stages. Industrial design experience, through formal training or close work with industrial designers on shipped products, and strong instincts for HMI and human factors. Strong requirements writing skills. You can turn a messy real-world scenario into a clear, testable requirement, with acceptance criteria and a verification method such as test, analysis, inspection, or demonstration. Experience building working relationships with OEMs and suppliers, and an understanding of how they develop, source, and deliver hardware. A commitment to trust, transparency, and honesty in a safety-critical environment. Willingness to be on site regularly for mock-ups, vehicle evaluations, and testing. Familiarity with automotive development processes such as APQP, PPAP, and A/B/C sample phases. Exposure to functional safety and AV safety standards such as ISO 26262, SOTIF (ISO 21448), or UL 4600, or to vehicle regulations.

jobs.description: Human Computer Lab is a research lab building character robots that feel alive and responsive. Our first robot, LeLamp, explores a new category of consumer robotics where everyday objects become interactive and help us reshape our attachment to technology. Our goal is to push the frontier of human-robot interaction by making technology more legible, emotionally intuitive, and human-centered. We are building the foundation for a new generation of robots designed for everyday environments. What to expect We're looking for an inventor who builds. Someone who gets an unlikely idea on a weekend, tries it, watches it fail, notices something surprising in the wreckage, and follows that instead - all the way to a model, a dataset, a working robot, and a write-up anyone can reproduce. Research is the inventing half: finding the question nobody has asked, trying the unexpected method first, and building the evaluation that tells you the truth. Engineering is the making half: turning the idea into something that runs on a real robot, in a real home, fast enough that a person never notices the machinery. Most people are strong at one. This role is for the person who can't stop doing both. It isn't bound to one discipline - the problem might be expressive motion this month, sensing or thermals next quarter, an inference stack or a new robot body after that. You'll work directly with the CEO and founding team, with real room to explore, on problems that ship to people's homes. In this role, you will: - Pick open problems across the system - motion, perception, sensing, actuation, thermals, inference, tooling - and take them from first idea to working artifact. - Try the unlikely approach before the obvious one, kill it honestly when it fails, and use what the failure taught you. - Build the evaluation before you trust the result: the metric, the probe, and the side-by-side that catch what averages hide. - Create data where none exists - bootstrap it, synthesize it, curate it with taste - and know when synthetic data is misleading you. - Ship end to end: the model, the dataset, the firmware, the demo, and the robot in the room. Make it fast and reliable enough for everyday life. - Work across abstraction layers when the problem demands it — from a circuit or motor driver up to a trained model and the interaction on top of it. - Write up what you tried, what failed, what the numbers say, and what you'd do next, so someone else can reproduce it. - Use AI as a research collaborator - to map a search space, run experiments, and pressure-test your own ideas - and share your judgment in how you use it for novel approaches. You may be a good fit if you: - Have a body of self-directed work - projects, repositories, write-ups, videos, robots - that you started because you were curious, not because it was assigned. This matters more to us than any credential. - Have taken at least one idea from “what if” to a working, measured artifact, end to end. - Are fluent in Python and comfortable further down the stack - C/C++, embedded, or electronics — or have a record of learning a new layer when a problem required it. - Have trained, evaluated, and deployed ML models, and can reason about latency and compute on edge devices. - Have built real hardware - a robot, a device, an instrument, a sensor rig - from parts, not from a kit. - Can explain your failures as clearly as your successes. - Have a degree in engineering, computer science, physics, or a related field, or equivalent proof of work. - Have published research, open-source projects people actually use, or a public body of technical writing. A plus, not a requirement. You will be a strong fit, if you: - Can't stop doing both halves — inventing the method and building the thing — and get restless doing only one. - Choose problems as carefully as you solve them, and can tell an interesting question from a merely difficult one. - Report what you found, not what you hoped. You'd rather say “it passed these checks” than “it's solved.” - Have taste. You care whether something feels alive and reads right to a person, not only whether the loss went down. - Move fast without being sloppy, and leave every result reproducible. - Care about what technology does to people - not just what it can do and want your inventions to change how people relate to the machines in their lives. The early team becomes the DNA of the company. We set ourselves and others to a high standard, and we respond with kindness when things get hard but keep everyone accountable. This requires us to be curious, creative, and diverse in our thinking and approach. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and consider all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. Even if you don’t meet every single requirement, we encourage you to apply. Studies show that women and underrepresented groups often hold back unless they meet 100% of the criteria - we don’t want that to be the reason we miss out on great talent.

These customers join an established base of AI innovators and global brands such as Meta, Cursor, Sony, and Tesla. We’re on a mission to transform how companies use data. Come be a part of our journey! ABOUT THE TEAM The AI/ML Engineering team builds and operates ClickHouse's AI and machine learning products end-to-end. This includes the Agentic Data Stack, AI Functions, chDB, the in-Console copilot, and the AI/ML partnerships that distribute them — together with the shared components and expertise that let every other ClickHouse team ship AI in the surfaces they own. Track the state of the art closely enough to apply what genuinely improves our products. We currently operate in over 25 countries. - Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare. - Equity in the company - Every new eligible team member who joins our company receives equity. - Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries. - A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee. - Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites. jobs.description: ABOUT THE TEAM The Canvas Core team builds and maintains the foundational platform that powers Mural’s visual thinking experience. This includes the infinite canvas, key editor components, document editing behaviors, asset management, real-time collaboration, and the systems that enable fast, reliable, and intuitive interaction on the canvas. We’re also responsible for the Mural UI, the real-time message protocol that enables seamless remote collaboration, and the developer-friendly APIs that internal teams use to build features like diagramming, workshops, presentations, integrations, and AI-enabled product capabilities. Our mission is to ensure the Mural editor is fast, reliable, intuitive, and easy to build on. We prioritize performance, simplicity, developer experience, and platform quality, enabling teams across the company to ship quickly and safely on top of Canvas Core. YOUR MISSION As a Senior Software Engineer, you’ll help design, build, and improve the Canvas platform so that the Mural editor remains reliable, high-performing, and intuitive for our users. You’ll work on the systems that power real-time collaboration, shared document editing, spatial interactions, rendering and interaction performance, asset management, developer APIs, and AI-enabled product capabilities across the Mural editor. Your role will be to reduce platform complexity, improve the quality and speed of Canvas development, and help teams ship high-quality editor experiences quickly and safely. You’ll partner closely with Product, Design, Engineering, and other stakeholders to turn ambiguous product and platform problems into clear, maintainable technical solutions. Senior Engineers at Mural lead by example through strong technical execution, thoughtful design, high-quality implementation, and collaborative problem-solving. They help raise the bar for their team through design discussions, code reviews, mentoring, documentation, and pragmatic improvements to engineering practices. WHAT YOU’LL DO - Own and deliver new Canvas platform capabilities and improvements from problem definition through implementation, release, measurement, and iteration - Partner with Product and Design to shape high-quality user experiences, balancing pragmatic technical delivery with long-term platform needs - Design and build maintainable Canvas platform systems, with accountability for quality, performance, reliability, and developer experience - Contribute to developer-friendly APIs, service boundaries, and platform contracts that internal teams can build on quickly and safely - Use AI-assisted tools and agentic workflows as part of your engineering practice to prototype, implement, test, document, and measure work effectively - Strengthen the team through technical design reviews, demos, code reviews, mentoring, and improvements to engineering practices - Build and evolve canvas systems with rich document and object models, including hierarchical scene or document structures, spatial indexing and querying, layout behavior, asset management, and selection mechanics - Work on large-scale concurrent and real-time collaboration systems that keep shared documents synchronized across users, contributing to design decisions around event ordering, latency, conflict handling, and failure-mode management - Help design, build, and integrate AI-enabled product capabilities where they intersect with the canvas, document model, real-time collaboration systems, or developer platform - Improve performance through profiling, bottleneck analysis, architectural simplification, targeted optimization, and moving expensive work out of critical interaction paths so systems remain responsive as document complexity and user activity scale WHAT YOU’LL BRING - Fluency in modern JavaScript/TypeScript, with familiarity in React, Node.js, or comparable modern frameworks - 6+ years building and shipping large-scale production software as part of an agile engineering team - Strong engineering judgment, with experience designing and delivering scalable, reliable, high-performance systems and developer-facing abstractions that balance simplicity, developer experience, and long-term maintainability - Experience designing clean API contracts and service boundaries, including thoughtful data models, versioning, validation, error handling, documentation, and long-term maintainability - Experience building distributed, concurrent, collaborative, or low-latency systems, such as collaboration tools, MMO games, shared-state systems, messaging protocols, or other low-latency user experiences, with familiarity across synchronization, consistency, event ordering, latency, failure modes, and performance trade-offs - Exposure to complex systems with rich object models, including hierarchical scene or document structures, spatial indexing and querying, layout behavior, asset management, selection mechanics, and performance-sensitive user interactions is a strong plus - Interest in AI-enabled product capabilities, or hands-on experience building or integrating them in production, such as intelligent editing, automation, recommendations, semantic document understanding, or collaboration features powered by AI - Performance optimization experience, including profiling, bottleneck analysis, memory and CPU efficiency, latency reduction, and responsiveness as document complexity and user activity scale - Familiarity with parallel processing, off-main-thread architectures, rendering pipelines, background computation, or other multithreaded systems is a plus - Practical experience using AI-assisted tools to prototype, implement, test, document, and measure engineering work - Communication and collaboration skills, with a low-ego approach to working with Product, Design, and Engineering, and the ability to contribute meaningfully to technical discussions, collaborate across teams, and help improve team engineering practices - Comfort operating in high-growth, fast-paced environments or scale-ups is a plus Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. jobs.description: <p>In Renaissance Florence, wealthy merchants faced a dilemma: where could they safely store their gold without it sitting idle. The Medici family offered a radical alternative. They invited individuals to deposit their gold and other assets with their institution, promising not only secure storage but also active deployment in trade and finance and accessible when needed. This groundbreaking approach allowed depositors to earn tangible returns on their wealth, offering a sophisticated alternative to traditional, static storage. The spirit of innovation and financial ingenuity that defined Renaissance Florence finds a powerful echo in the modern startup world.&nbsp;</p> <p>Mercury brings that same spirit to building an exceptional banking* experience for all. We’ve created an investment platform that helps startups put idle cash to work by combining safety and yield in one elegant package. Think of it as institutional-grade cash management reimagined for ambitious startups.</p> <p>Treasury is a team of full-stack engineers that are building the end to end onboarding, portfolio recommendation, dashboard, and tooling experiences that manage billions in customer funds. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities or special needs. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.</p> <p>#LI-ME1</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><strong>Total Rewards</strong><br>The total rewards package at Mercury includes base salary, equity (stock options/RSUs), and benefits.</p> <p>Our salary and equity ranges are highly competitive within the SaaS and fintech industry and are updated regularly using the most reliable compensation survey data for our industry. New hire offers are made based on a candidate’s experience, expertise, geographic location, and internal pay equity relative to peers.</p> <p>Our target new hire base salary ranges for this role are the following<strong>:</strong></p></div><div class="title">US employees (any location):</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$166,600</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>$250,900 USD</span></div></div><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">Canadian employees (any location):</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$157,400</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>$237,100 CAD</span></div></div></div>

jobs.description: Artificial Intelligence. Actual Impact. At Docebo, we’re using AI to change how people learn at work—and we mean actually change it. We’re an AI-powered learning platform that helps organizations create, deliver, and manage training all in one place. But our real mission goes deeper: we help teams move faster, work smarter, and focus on the work that truly matters. Our platform is built with intelligent, time-saving tools that personalize learning, eliminate busywork, and turn training from a checkbox into a superpower. The result? Better experiences for learners and real results for businesses. We’re shaping the future of learning with a team that isn’t afraid to challenge the status quo. If you're excited by the idea of using AI to make work-life better for real people–you’ll feel right at home here. And it’s not just what we build, it’s how we show up. At Docebo, our values aren’t just posters on the wall—they guide how we work every day. We call it the Docebo Heart: trust by default, assume positive intent, and create space for different perspectives to thrive. Want to get a better feel for what it's like to work at Docebo? Check out our Life https://www.linkedin.com/company/docebo/life/0e53ece6-0cc2-41ca-a183-84de0a8c245d/?viewAsMember=true page on our LinkedIn to get a glimpse into our culture, people, and the experiences that make Docebo a great place to grow your career. So… what are you waiting for? Join 900+ Docebians around the world and help us reinvent the way people learn, because learning never stops. THE ADVENTURE AHEAD 🚀 As a Senior Product Engineer II, you bring deep expertise in backend engineering alongside strong working competency across the broader stack. You own complex features and technical initiatives end to end, working across services, APIs, data layers, and integration boundaries to deliver complete solutions. Your primary strength is building reliable backend systems, designing scalable APIs, and shaping cloud native and event driven architectures. You understand how the broader system fits together and can confidently work across frontend and platform boundaries when needed. jobs.description: MaintainX is a leading mobile-first work execution platform for industrial and frontline teams. More than 15,000 customers, including McDonalds, Michaels, Cintas, Redimix, and U.S. LBM, use MaintainX to cut unplanned downtime and run better operations, across 16 million managed assets and 92 million completed work orders. Autodesk's strategy is to converge design, make and operate into one continuous lifecycle: design an asset, build it, run it, then feed what you learn running it back into the next design. Autodesk had design and make. Operate is the phase that tells you what actually happened, and it is ours. À PROPOS DE L’ÉQUIPE L'équipe > est le cœur du système de gestion de la maintenance MaintainX : les ordres de travail, la planification et l’ordonnancement, l’inventaire et les pièces, les rapports, ainsi que la hiérarchie des actifs que les équipes de première ligne utilisent quotidiennement. C’est également là que se concentrent certains de nos investissements les plus récents, notamment deux équipes nouvellement formées qui développent une plateforme d’exécution des travaux et repensent entièrement l’expérience des techniciens. Si vous souhaitez travailler au plus près de ce que les clients utilisent au quotidien et avoir la chance de prendre en charge un projet entièrement nouveau, vous êtes au bon endroit. ÉQUIPES QUE VOUS POURRIEZ JOINDRE - Planification : Flux de travail de planification et d’ordonnancement, ainsi que les heures d’exploitation. - Gestion des stocks / Pièces : Pièces de rechange, bons de commande, prévisions et fournisseurs. - Accueil / Rapports : Écran Vue d’ensemble, ainsi que les rapports partagés et planifiés. - Plateforme d’exécution des travaux : Fonctionnalités de base des bons de travail sur lesquelles repose le produit : récurrence, assignation, calendrier, procédures, automatisations et permis. - Expérience des techniciens : Enregistrement de la présence par GPS, expérience utilisateur sur le terrain et fonctionnement hors ligne pour les techniciens. - Gestion des données d’entreprise : Fonctionnalités globales et multi sites de la plateforme, modèles, hiérarchie et emplacement des actifs, ainsi que les formulaires dynamiques pour les actifs. SUR QUOI VOUS TRAVAILLEREZ - Concevoir et améliorer les flux de travail que les clients utilisent au quotidien, de la planification à la gestion des pièces en passant par la production de rapports. - Résoudre des problèmes techniques complexes liés au produit : interfaces denses et riches en données, grands ensembles de données, fonctionnement hors ligne et évolutivité multisite. - Au sein de nos équipes nouvellement formées, façonnez l’architecture et les pratiques d’ingénierie dès le départ. - Simplifiez les flux de travail complexes sur ordinateur et sur mobile. LE POSTE - Mettez en production des fonctionnalités de bout en bout, de la planification à la production. - Collaborez directement avec les gestionnaires de produit et les concepteurs pour définir la feuille de route de votre équipe, et non pas simplement pour l’exécuter. - Assumer la responsabilité de la santé à long terme d’un domaine fonctionnel ou d’un système : fiabilité, performance et les éléments du code que personne ne remarque tant qu’ils ne tombent pas en panne. - Réviser le code et encadrer les autres développeurs de votre équipe. - Rehausser la barre en matière d’outils, de tests et de pratiques de livraison. Notre pile technologique principale comprend TypeScript, React, Node.js et MySQL. Certaines équipes utilisent C# ou Python. Il n’est pas nécessaire de maîtriser tous ces éléments pour postuler. Vous intégrerez une équipe de 5 à 10 personnes et participerez à un système de quarts de garde dans le cadre de vos fonctions. Au cours de vos six premiers mois, vous assumerez l’entière responsabilité d’un domaine fonctionnel ou d’un système. OÙ NOUS TRAVAILLONS Nous n’imposons pas de présence minimale au bureau, mais nous préférons que nos équipes soient situées à proximité de nos centres d’affaires. Au Canada, cela comprend : Montréal et Toronto. Atouts : expérience avec GraphQL, React Native ou les bases de données SQL. Dans ce domaine, nous apprécions également : l’expérience avec les interfaces utilisateur de planification ou de calendrier, les interfaces utilisateur traitant de grandes quantités de données, les architectures « offline-first » ou de synchronisation, les plateformes multi-locataires ou d’entreprise, les moteurs de flux de travail, ou encore les systèmes de gestion des stocks et des transactions. Our mission is to keep the physical world running. Factories, fleets, hospitals and campuses stay up because the people who maintain them have tools worth using. That is what we build.
