jobs.description: About the team The Control Plane Platform team is building the shared foundation that every product in ClickHouse Cloud is built and shipped on. We give ClickHouse engineering teams one place to own and deploy their product, remove the overhead of rebuilding common plumbing, and keep the customer experience consistent as the number of integrating teams grows. The team owns API gateways and API standards, shared platform services, deployment and infrastructure patterns, testing and CI, local developer experience and Control Plane observability. About the role We’re looking for an Engineering Manager to lead our Platform team. This is a high-impact, high-trust role at the center of our Cloud product, combining people leadership, technical direction, product thinking, and operational ownership while maintaining the reliability customers expect. You’ll work hand-in-hand with Product, Infrastructure, Security, Support, and engineering teams across ClickHouse. This role goes beyond engineering leadership. Together with your team, you’ll help shape how new products and teams will integrate and deploy their applications in ClickHouse Cloud. What You’ll Do - Lead, coach, and grow a high-performing team - recruit to a high bar, set crisp expectations, give direct feedback and career development, and manage performance — while fostering a healthy, inclusive environment built on empathy, psychological safety, trust, and a high technical bar. - Own outcomes across the platform surface: API gateways and API standards, shared platform services (event bus, notifications, feature flags, websockets, audit records), deployment and infrastructure patterns, CI and testing, local developer experience, disaster recovery, and Control Plane observability. - Treat the integrating teams as your customers and measure success by their delivery velocity and adoption of the platform, not only by what your team ships. - Guide architecture and help senior engineers make explicit, sound tradeoffs. land cross-cutting migrations, deprecations, and contract changes across teams without stalling product delivery. - Jump into designs and code for complex areas - gateway routing and auth/RBAC enforcement, spec-driven code generation, event delivery semantics and idempotency, multi-region rollout safety. - Build the culture of operational excellence: Own SLOs, reliability, on-call quality, and cost-efficiency for k8s-hosted, multi-tenant services across cloud regions. - Systematize support, reduce toil, and build self-serve/auto-healing capabilities - golden-path templates and generators, auto-healing, and documentation that gets a new team integrated in days rather than weeks. - Shape the platform vision, turn it into a roadmap, sequence bets for business impact, and ship fast with tight feedback loops — including writing the RFCs that build cross-org consensus before big changes land What you bring - 8+ years in software engineering and 3+ years managing software engineers with a track record of hiring, developing, and retaining strong talent. - Experience leading a platform or infrastructure team whose customers are other engineering teams — you've driven adoption and cross-org migrations through influence and good tooling rather than mandate. - Experience leading distributed global teams, fostering an inclusive and autonomous culture, and creating clarity across time zones. - Experience building scalable, highly available, and secure cloud-based infrastructure in AWS (EKS, SQS, DocumentDB, Redis, PostgreSQL, Lambdas) with infrastructure as code (Terraform, Helm) and progressive delivery (Argo Rollouts or similar). - Experience with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes), including patterns for hosting many independently deployed applications in a shared cluster. - Familiarity with API platform work: OpenAPI-driven contracts, API gateways, and the shared concerns they centralize — authentication, RBAC, rate limiting, versioning, and deprecation. - A track record of decomposing a monolith into independently deployable services without stalling product delivery. - Technical credibility to engage deeply in architecture and incidents without owning daily implementation. - Hands-on: you still enjoy diving into code/designs for complex or critical areas, reviewing code, and guiding via feedback. - Strong execution judgment across ambiguity, parallel workstreams, risk, and long-term system health. Nice to have - Experience with large TypeScript/Node monorepos and the developer-experience problems that come with them: CI scale and flakiness, build and test times, local development environments, and code generation from specs. - Designed and implemented strategies for load balancing, auto-scaling, disaster recovery, and failover for cloud environments. - Experience building CI/CD at scale - Experience with internal developer platforms: service catalogs, golden-path templates, and self-service app scaffolding. - Proficiency with frontend frameworks (React). - Experience making APIs consumable by AI agents — MCP servers, CLIs, or skills generated from API specs. - Experience with ClickHouse - Previous experience in developing analytics or data-intensive applications. Why This Role - Shape how all feature teams in ClickHouse Cloud develop and integrate with each other - Operate with ownership, autonomy, and speed while keeping the company lean. - Lead a technical team where correctness, performance, reliability, and developer experience all matter. PERKS - Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries. - Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare. - Equity in the company - Every new eligible team member who joins our company receives equity. - Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries. - A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee. - Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites. CULTURE - WE ALL SHAPE IT As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture. Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here https://clickhouse.com/company/careers. Check out our blog posts https://clickhouse.com/blog or follow us on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/clickhouseinc/life/0c1ee7f4-2129-488d-b413-e7f6270659fd/?viewAsMember=true to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse. jobs.description: Artificial Intelligence. Actual Impact. At Docebo, we’re using AI to change how people learn at work—and we mean actually change it. We’re an AI-powered learning platform that helps organizations create, deliver, and manage training all in one place. But our real mission goes deeper: we help teams move faster, work smarter, and focus on the work that truly matters. Our platform is built with intelligent, time-saving tools that personalize learning, eliminate busywork, and turn training from a checkbox into a superpower. The result? Better experiences for learners and real results for businesses. We’re shaping the future of learning with a team that isn’t afraid to challenge the status quo. If you're excited by the idea of using AI to make work-life better for real people–you’ll feel right at home here. And it’s not just what we build, it’s how we show up. At Docebo, our values aren’t just posters on the wall—they guide how we work every day. We call it the Docebo Heart: trust by default, assume positive intent, and create space for different perspectives to thrive. Want to get a better feel for what it's like to work at Docebo? Check out our Life https://www.linkedin.com/company/docebo/life/0e53ece6-0cc2-41ca-a183-84de0a8c245d/?viewAsMember=true page on our LinkedIn to get a glimpse into our culture, people, and the experiences that make Docebo a great place to grow your career. So… what are you waiting for? Join 900+ Docebians around the world and help us reinvent the way people learn, because learning never stops. 🚀 THE ADVENTURE AHEAD As a Senior Cloud Engineer I, you are the backbone of the infrastructure that powers Docebo’s global learning platform! You will architect, scale, and secure our AWS-based environments using cutting-edge DevOps and Platform Engineering practices. By building resilient automation and optimizing systems like our FedRAMP-regulated environments, you will directly empower engineering teams to deploy faster and keep millions of learners seamlessly connected. Get ready to solve high-impact technical challenges, elevate our cloud strategy, and shape the future of AI-driven learning! ⚡ THE DAY-TO-DAY - Architect the Future: Own and evolve our AWS cloud infrastructure end-to-end, taking projects from initial blueprint through implementation and operations to guarantee ultra-high availability, performance, and scale. - Automate Everything: Design and implement self-service Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) templates and automation workflows that crush manual toil and give product teams superpowers. - Fortify the Platform: Elevate our cloud security posture by partnering with Security and Compliance teams to maintain audit-ready FedRAMP configurations, eliminate drift, and streamline patching. - Partner for Impact: Collaborate closely with Engineering to launch new services seamlessly, jump into high-priority incident responses, and turn post-mortem insights into platform upgrades. - Optimize and Observe: Master systems like Datadog to keep eyes on platform performance, driving decisions that optimize system resilience, speed, and cost-efficiency. - Level Up the Team: Inspire and mentor junior Cloud Engineers through code and design reviews, keeping Docebo at the forefront of modern cloud trends. 💪 YOUR SUPERPOWERS - Cloud Mastery: Proven expertise managing complex, production-grade AWS infrastructure with 4–8 years of experience in cloud systems or platform engineering. - Infrastructure as Code Ace: Intermediate to advanced mastery with IaC tooling like Terraform, CloudFormation, or CDK to provision and scale complex environments. - Containerization & Linux Powerhouse: Hands-on proficiency with Linux, Docker, and running microservices on Kubernetes/EKS. - Observability & CI/CD Champion: Strong experience using Datadog (or similar observability tools) alongside Git/GitLab for seamless code delivery and automation. - DevOps Mindset & Scripting Skills: Solid understanding of DevOps methodologies paired with fluent scripting skills in Python, Bash, or Go. - Problem-Solving Superhero: Exceptional analytical skills, sharp attention to detail, and a collaborative, team-first approach to solving complex engineering problems. NOTE: U.S. citizenship is required for this position because its duties require access to restricted federal customer environments that limit access to U.S. citizens. Preference will be given to candidates who live in, or are willing to work, Eastern Time hours. ⭐ BONUS POINTS - Compliance Ninja: Direct experience maintaining and patching FedRAMP-regulated or highly compliant cloud environments. - Academic Foundation: A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent real-world experience). 🗓️ OUR INTERVIEW PROCESS Step 1: We’ll kick things off with a 30-minute video call with a member of our Talent team. We’ll get to know you, share more about the role and team, and make sure we’re aligned. Step 2: A 45-60-minute video call with the hiring manager, where they’ll dig deeper into your experience, approach, and what excites you most about this opportunity. Step 3: A technical deep-dive and system design discussion with key members of our Cloud & Platform Engineering team. Step 4: A final wrap-up conversation with engineering leadership to discuss team culture, growth, and next steps. OUR TOTAL REWARDS PHILOSOPHY 🎉 Our Total Rewards Philosophy centers around three core areas to reward and care for our People: - Rewarding Impact: We lead with competitive pay to reward the impact, skills and traits that fuel our success. - Fostering Holistic Wellbeing: We care deeply about and invest in the whole person with programs that support our people’s physical, mental, and financial well-being. - Empowering Our Talent Culture: We build a culture of trust and empowerment by designing our rewards and benefits with transparency, equity, and flexibility, enabling our people to do their best work and stay for the long haul. OUR PROMISE TO YOU 😍 - Financial Wellness: Own a piece of Docebo through our Employee Share Purchase Plan (ESPP) at a 15% discount, plus a competitive compensation package. - Your Well-Being, Covered: You’ll get access to health benefits, so you can get the care you need when you need it. - Rest, Relax, Repeat: Rest and recharge with paid vacation days, two company-wide Docebo Days, floating holidays for cultural celebrations, and your birthday off! - Family First: We provide coverage offering you time with your little one(s) so you can soak up all those precious moments. Fun fact: we had 30 Docebian babies join the family in 2025! - Connections That Count: Connect with global communities through our Employee Resource Groups (including PRIDE, DWA, BIDOC, and Green Ambassadors) and company-wide events that keep the fun rolling all year long. ABOUT DOCEBO 💙 At Docebo, we create seamless, AI-powered learning experiences for over 3,000 customers worldwide. We have successfully achieved two IPOs (TSX: DCBO & NASDAQ: DCBO https://www.docebo.inc/home/default.aspx), been recognized as a top SaaS e-learning solution, and are growing exponentially in the process. We're a global company, with offices across North America, EMEA, APAC, and beyond. Our team is guided by five core values—Grow Together Win Together, Build with Our Customer, Clear is Kind, Own Outcomes, Progress Over Perfection—that shape everything we do. If this resonates with you, now is the perfect time to join one of the fastest-growing learning technology companies in the world. jobs.description: Most companies treat support as a cost center. We treat it as an engineering challenge and a product opportunity. Support Operations Engineering is an engineering function inside ClickHouse’s Support Services organization. We build the systems that decide how customers get help from the moment they describe their problem to the moment it’s resolved. This role will help shape how Support Services, RevOps, GTM, and core Engineering teams collaborate on customers. This is not a tools team. About a third of our work directly supports the support organization. The rest is building experiences and systems that change how ClickHouse works with its customers in more effective, streamlined ways. WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING You’ll design and build the systems that sit between ClickHouse’s customers and the teams who serve them. The work is varied by design, and you’ll move between problem types as priorities shift: - Intelligent routing and decision systems. Software that decides where work should go and who should handle it, weighing many signals at once, and is built to adapt as the business scales. - AI-powered customer experiences. Customer-facing and internal experiences that understand what someone needs, recommend the best next step, and know when to hand off to a human. - Internal platforms and tooling. Applications that give Support, RevOps, and GTM teams the leverage to work faster and more accurately, built to production standards. - Integrations and data flow. Connections across Salesforce, live chat, incident management, Slack, GitHub, and more, so workflows and data move cleanly between systems. - Automation and observability. Systems that remove repetitive work, surface what’s breaking, and give teams confidence in what they’re running. Across all of it, you’ll partner with core Engineering to ship to production, and own what you build: code review, testing, monitoring, and continuous improvement. WHAT YOU BRING ALONG: - 3–5 years building and shipping full-stack software in production, with tools like TypeScript/JavaScript, Node.js, and React (or comparable) - Experience developing with APIs, webhooks, and integrations between distributed systems - Hands-on experience close to support: as a support or technical support engineer, or by building tools or integrations for a support, CS, or RevOps team - Confidence with Git and safe, version-controlled deployment workflows - The ability to translate operational needs into solutions that non-engineers can follow - A shipper’s mindset: self-driven, curious, and comfortable owning a problem end-to-end in a remote, globally distributed team - Comfort using AI tools day to day in how you build, with a clear sense of where to trust them BONUS POINTS: - Experience building LLM-powered features in production (routing, retrieval, evaluation, or observability) - Salesforce platform experience (Apex, LWC, Flows, custom objects) or certifications; if you don’t have it, the appetite to get there quickly - Support and incident tooling: Pylon, incident.io http://incident.io, PagerDuty, Zendesk, Slack APIs, GitHub APIs - Experience with ClickHouse or other analytical databases - Experience in an early-stage or greenfield environment, or embedded in a support, RevOps, or business-systems function PERKS - Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. jobs.description: FORWARD DEPLOYED PRODUCT MANAGER Location: U.S. (Remote, but must be based in the United States) Travel: Depending on the assigned engagement, substantial travel to state government partner sites may be expected Clearance: Must be eligible and able to pass a government background check ABOUT SPRUCE Our mission is to let users control their data across the web. We build privacy-preserving, standards-based digital identity and credentialing systems that help governments and institutions increase access to important services and benefits programs while reducing fraud. We believe the right approach to product management is critical to combining high standards of usability, security, and privacy into a seamless user experience and driving broad adoption. THE ROLE We are seeking a Forward Deployed Product Manager to sit alongside our government customers during discovery, architecture, and design, sometimes while engineering is building, and help them work out what they actually need and why. You will support specific deployments, from statewide identity programs to large-scale education and workforce credentialing initiatives. Each must be localized to its own ecosystem: stakeholders, user demographics, regulations, and program objectives. Even as we sell a product to a customer, we treat the overall program as a product with its own governance, roadmap, and objectives. Much of this work is customer-driven today and requires hands-on engagement with individual implementations, even as we work to consolidate what we learn into reusable Spruce products. Holding both at once is the job. A credential is only useful if someone issues it, someone accepts it, and someone carries it. So beyond discovery, you own adoption for your program: getting issuers to issue, verifiers to verify, and end users to adopt, with startup-style resourcefulness and measurable KPIs. In some cases, you will source and build the first pilot group yourself. The surface area is broad, and you should be good at taming unknowns and complexity. One week you may be shaping the roadmap for a statewide digital identity wallet, the next a citizen-facing portal, the next the APIs and microservices underneath. You are responsible for the end-to-end product picture, how those pieces fit together, and ultimately outcomes for our customers’ customers. This is not a roadmap-and-quarterly-planning role. We move quickly, put work in front of small pilot groups, and let evidence change the plan. At the same time, this is identity infrastructure, where security, accessibility, and reliability matter. Knowing what can be iterated on quickly and what absolutely cannot is central to doing this job well. CORE RESPONSIBILITIES 1. CUSTOMER-EMBEDDED DISCOVERY - Work directly with state government partners through discovery, architecture, and design - Understand their users, policy environment, constraints, and workflows first-hand - Look past stated requirements to the underlying problem the customer is actually trying to solve - Navigate government relationships thoughtfully: introduce user evidence that may challenge stated priorities, and influence direction without damaging the relationship 2. END-TO-END PRODUCT OWNERSHIP - Hold the full product picture across user-facing experiences and the APIs and services beneath them, often across several interconnected initiatives at once - Help partners shape and sequence their roadmap, and make sure what gets built solves the real problem - Partner closely with engineering, design, and delivery leads from definition through deployment 3. HANDS-ON USER RESEARCH - Personally design and run research: talk to stakeholders and end users directly, run discovery, prototype where appropriate - Synthesize what you learn into product decisions and roadmap direction - Bring user evidence into conversations where requirements are often treated as fixed There is no research team or technical product manager counterpart behind this role. You do this work yourself, whether that means digging into agency rules, legislation, user interviews, or codebases. 4. ECOSYSTEM BUILDING AND ADOPTION - Drive adoption of digital credentials across your program’s ecosystem: onboard issuers, verifiers, and institutional partners with startup GTM resourcefulness - Find high-leverage partnerships (university research programs, workforce boards, employer networks) that multiply impact beyond your own direct effort - Own adoption KPIs and find creative, resourceful ways to move them 5. JUDGMENT ABOUT PACE VERSUS RISK - Put work in front of small pilot groups early and let findings redirect the roadmap - Draw clear lines around what cannot be iterated on loosely: security, accessibility, and reliability - Make and defend those calls with engineering and with customers Where this role ends. This is a forward-deployed role, not a core product role: you own outcomes for your engagements, not Spruce’s product-line roadmap. But you are the person closest to the field, so we expect you to notice when a problem extends beyond a single agency and flag what should become reusable Spruce capability. WHAT YOU BRING - 6–10+ years of product experience at startups or on new product initiatives. Former founder or founding-team operator is the ideal profile - Zero-to-one experience: you have taken a product from nothing to shipped, or identified and pursued entirely new opportunities - Meaningful experience in education, workforce development, or adjacent sectors - A real interest in workforce development and expanding opportunity through technology - Experience in government or another highly regulated environment - Customer-embedded experience: forward-deployed product, solutions PM, implementation, or founder-led delivery all count - Hands-on user research: you have designed and run discovery yourself and turned it into product decisions - Enough technical depth to read a codebase, hold your own with engineers on APIs, services, and system design, and make tradeoffs they respect. You do not need to be an engineer - Credible at the executive level: comfortable holding a room with agency directors, university chancellors, and institutional partners - Based in the U.S. and excited to engage directly with state government partners NICE TO HAVE - Background in digital identity, IAM/ICAM, credentialing, or authentication systems - Experience building or growing multi-sided ecosystems, marketplaces, or platform adoption - Background in education technology or learning and employment records - Familiarity with accessibility standards, FedRAMP, or NIST frameworks - Experience navigating public sector procurement and contracting - Prior engineering or deeply technical systems experience WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS - Shape identity and credentialing systems that millions of residents will actually use - Work directly with senior government stakeholders on mission-critical infrastructure - Operate at the intersection of policy, engineering, research, and real-world delivery - Help build the education and workforce credential ecosystems that connect people to opportunity - Help turn individual state deployments into durable product capability - Join a small, high-trust team where autonomy and judgment matter At SpruceID, we value diversity of perspectives and backgrounds. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or veteran status.

jobs.description: As a Group Product Manager on the Core Platform - Flexible Payments team, you will own the strategy and execution for our next-generation flex cards powered by Flexible credentials technologies, accelerating Marqeta’s business growth and extending our competitive lead in the space. You will set the multi-year vision, own the portfolio’s business outcomes, and shape how flexible credentials are built, priced, and taken to market with customers, card networks, and partners. We are looking for a product leader who excels in a fast-paced, high-growth environment and thrives on collaboration with customers and partners. This is an individual contributor role today, with the potential to build and lead a team of product managers as the business grows. The Flexible Payments team is revolutionizing global embedded finance, enabling seamless integration of financial products into business platforms. We provide instant card issuance, commercialization of flexible credentials technology, and incubate new solutions based on emerging technologies like: Stablecoin payments, making financial services more accessible and scalable. As builders and innovators, we thrive on making an impact and pushing fintech boundaries. We work Flexible First https://www.marqeta.com/blog/2022/05/10/flexible-first. This role can be performed remotely anywhere within the United States or our headquarters in Oakland, CA office. We’d love for you to join us! THE IMPACT YOU’LL HAVE - Own Strategy & Growth – Define the multi-year vision and roadmap for the next-gen flex cards, and own the portfolio’s business growth related goals - Drive Product Monetization – Collaborate with pricing, and commercialization teams and drive monetization strategy with a deep understanding of Card interchange, network fees, funding-source costs, and program economics - Lead Execution at Scale – Lead multiple engineering squads and complex, cross-functional programs from discovery to launch and adoption across the full card payments lifecycle - Partner with the Ecosystem – Build strategic relationships with card networks, banks, fintechs, and key customers, and co-develop new programs that influence industry direction - Anticipate the Market – Track global fintech innovation (stablecoins, embedded finance, agentic payments) and turn it into differentiated product bets and investment cases - Prioritize with Data – Use analytics, customer insight, and financial models to make tradeoffs across competing priorities and make the case for investment to executives - Influence cross-functional stakeholders – Align engineering, design, data, legal, compliance, risk, finance, and go-to-market teams, and mentor PMs across the organization WHO YOU ARE - 10+ years of product management experience, including 3+ years at a senior or group level owning a portfolio or multiple product lines with measurable business results - jobs.description: ABOUT LANCEDB AI advances at the speed of its research, and research moves at the speed of its data. LanceDB is the AI-native Multimodal Lakehouse: one system where a researcher curates petabytes of video, audio, and every signal derived from them with a few lines of Python, and the next training run starts as fast as the next idea. Customers like Runway, Midjourney, and Netflix build the future of AI on LanceDB, from frontier and world models to robots and autonomous vehicles. ABOUT THE ROLE We're looking for a Senior Technical Product Marketing Manager to own the technical content, demos, and competitive work behind our go-to-market. Our buyers are AI researchers and platform engineers and rely heavily on technical proof to back up Marketing claims. Your job is to make sure that material exists, arm our Sales team with it, and distribute it in the right places. You'll work alongside a product marketing counterpart who owns our positioning, messaging, and core pitch. Your domain is the technical layer underneath it: the demos, benchmarks, deep-dive content, and competitive work that make the story credible to people who will check. You'll do a combination of owning content development end to end and working with internal and external partners on content development. You won't personally produce every piece of technical material we ship, and you shouldn't. But you should be the person who knows what proof we're missing and gets it made. This role requires enough technical depth that our engineers want to work with you and our customers take you seriously. We're a small, fast-moving team where scope is still forming, so expect to partner closely with PMM, DevRel, Engineering, and Sales as we continue to evolve our go-to-market motion. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Own the technical proof surface for LanceDB, including benchmarks, reference architectures, technical deep dives, and comparisons. You'll decide what proof we need, produce a good share of it yourself, and scope and shepherd with other subject matter experts when needed. - Build hands-on. You'll stand up working demos on LanceDB and ship them as content, conference material, and sales assets without waiting on an Engineering queue. - Write, host, and ship our biweekly product update video: an on-camera walkthrough of what we shipped and what it unlocks, with live demos where they make the point better than slides. - Partner with Engineering on the deeper technical work by framing the question a benchmark or other technical proof point should answer, pushing for rigor, and translating the result into something the market actually understands. - Build customer- and partner-based proof points, including reference architectures drawn from real deployments, joint technical content, and material that shows how serious teams run on LanceDB. - Own competitive intelligence end to end. Maintain the competitive picture, run teardowns, and turn what you learn into battlecards, technical objection handling, and win themes. - Build the technical half of sales enablement: demo scripts, discovery questions, competitive training, and the proof points that back up our core pitch. - Ground everything in real practitioner input: customer and prospect conversations, user research, our open-source community, GitHub and Discord activity, and the questions that keep coming up in sales calls. - Partner with the broader Marketing team on launches, campaigns, and events, supplying the technical depth that makes those programs land with a skeptical audience. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - You thrive in a fast-paced, startup environment and enjoy working with high-caliber teams. - 5+ years marketing infrastructure or developer products to technical practitioners in product marketing, technical marketing, developer relations, solutions architecture, or an adjacent technical GTM role. - Hands-on technical ability. You write Python, work comfortably in notebooks, and can build a working demo on an unfamiliar system without help. We'll ask you to show us something you built. - Comfortable on camera and able to carry a recurring video series with minimal support. - Depth in AI/ML infrastructure, data infrastructure, databases, or developer tools. You should have enough context to understand what a training pipeline, an embedding workflow, or a petabyte-scale data curation problem actually looks like. - Demonstrated competitive marketing chops: you've built the competitive picture for a technical product and turned it into enablement. - A strong writer who can go deep without padding. - Proven ability to own work end to end without a team to support you. You have taste and strong pattern-matching for common problems, and you move quickly and with confidence. - Strong analytic instincts, with the ability to use data to draw conclusions and adjust as needed. - You use AI thoughtfully as a marketer, iterating on how it can improve and streamline your work. - Excellent communicator who can partner with founders, engineers, and GTM leadership and move fast in a small, high-ownership team. - Bonus points for: a background as an engineer, researcher, solutions architect, or developer advocate before moving into marketing.

jobs.description: ABOUT THE TEAM When the world's largest organizations bet on Mural, Govern & Trust is the team that earns that trust at scale. We build the experiences that help enterprises roll out Mural with confidence, keep it secure, and see the impact it has on how their people work. Data sits at the center of it all. Admins are Mural's most demanding data consumers: they need to prove ROI to their leadership, guide adoption across thousands of people, and account for every action. If data products can meet their bar, they'll work for everyone. Mural has a modern data platform, strong data engineering and analytics teams, and a wealth of data on how teams collaborate. The next step is treating that data as a product in its own right, with a dedicated owner for what it means and how it's used. YOUR MISSION As a Senior Product Manager you'll define the metrics that describe how Mural creates value, and make them the shared foundation for everything built on top. The same definitions will power internal product decisions, the Insights experience Admins use in the product, and the reporting API and MCP server that customers and AI agents query. This role starts upstream. You'll work from raw product events to decide what each metric should measure, how it's calculated, and what the data needs to look like for customers and internal teams to rely on it. Then you'll turn those metrics into experiences that help organizations understand and grow their use of Mural. WHAT YOU'LL DO - The evolution of data products. Shape how Mural's data products move from reporting on what happened to guiding what happens next. Work across the Govern & Trust portfolio to define how insights become part of how organizations run Mural. - The metric layer. Define Mural's shared, cross-product metrics, like activity, collaboration, and adoption. Set the standards that let product teams define and publish their own metrics consistently. Data Engineering builds and runs the layer; you shape what goes in it and how it evolves. - Internal product analytics. Be a thought partner to domain PMs as they set their north-star metrics, and make product data easy for them to explore on their own. Work with Business Analytics to keep product-facing and business-facing reporting working together. - Customer-facing data products. Own the strategy and roadmap for Insights: in-product reporting and dashboards, exports and APIs, audit logs, and the methodology behind every number customers see. - AI and agent access. Package and launch Mural's customer-facing reporting MCP server: which data it exposes, which plans get it, and what guardrails apply. Define how natural-language and agent-driven analysis extends Insights. - Instrumentation. R&D teams own emitting events. Your job is to raise the bar on what they emit. Set per-product requirements for granularity and retention, which differ for audit logs, activity data, and product analytics. Partner with Data Engineering on event standards so metrics start from good data. WHAT YOU'LL BRING - 5+ years of product management experience, including shipping at least one analytics or reporting product used by paying business customers. You defined the metrics behind it, not just the UI. - A track record of making messy or conflicting data trustworthy: reconciling competing definitions, writing metric specs engineers could build from, and getting instrumentation changed upstream. - Experience building both platform products, where your customers are internal teams or developers, and end-user-facing data products like analytics, reporting, or insights. You understand how the two have to work together. - Working knowledge of modern data stacks: event pipelines, warehouses and lakehouses, dbt-style modeling, and semantic layers. You can write SQL and pull data yourself. - The ability to get agreement on definitions across teams you don't manage, including PMs, data engineering, analytics, finance, and go-to-market. - Experience with enterprise admin or governance products (IAM, security, compliance, audit) - Hands-on experience with semantic layer tools (dbt Semantic Layer, Cube, LookML) - Experience designing APIs, MCP servers, or connectors for analytics EQUAL OPPORTUNITY We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

jobs.description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Stack:</strong></p> <p>Stack is developing revolutionary AI and advanced autonomous systems designed to enhance safety, reliability, and efficiency of modern operations. Stack's autonomous technology incorporates cutting-edge advancements in artificial intelligence, robotics, machine learning, and cloud technologies, empowering us to create innovative solutions that address the needs and challenges of the dynamic trucking transportation industry. With decades of experience creating and deploying real world systems for demanding environments, the Stack team is dedicated to developing an autonomous solution ecosystem tailored to the trucking industry's unique demands.</p> <p>If you are an Internal Candidate, please apply via our Internal Job Board.</p></div><p><strong>About the Team</strong></p> <p>The Constraint Generation team is responsible for translating perception and prediction inputs into actionable options for the planner. It is one of the core motion planning teams, whose work directly impacts how our autonomous trucks drive. The team interfaces with perception, mapping, prediction, trajectory generation, trajectory evaluation, and other planning teams in order to implement and improve onboard features. In addition, it works with a wide range of stakeholders throughout the company (systems, simulation, metrics) to deploy these features safely and monitor their performance. This team’s work addresses challenges specific to trucking (high speed highway operations, long stopping distances, complex turn geometries, and more), and is central to the performance of the AV system on the road.</p> <p><strong>About the Role:&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>We are looking for strong software engineers with motion planning experience to help develop and deploy motion planning components for autonomous trucks. In this role, you will work across all stages of the development lifecycle to design, implement, test, and evaluate new features and feature improvements that directly impact the self-driving system’s on-road performance.</p> <p>A core focus of this role is constraint generation, which defines the solution space for trajectory generation by establishing the boundaries, corridors, and high-level decisions for candidate trajectories. This covers critical real-world trucking maneuvers, including:</p> <ul> <li>Targeting gaps during merges and lane changes while reasoning about traffic congestion and proactive deceleration.</li> <li>Determining optimal locations to pull over safely to the shoulder during degraded or emergency states.</li> <li>Constructing dynamic driving corridors through active construction zones where valid HD maps do not exist and navigation relies purely on real-time perception.</li> <li>Pre-positioning the vehicle prior to tight, sharp turns to guarantee clean, safe completion.</li> </ul> <p>Our team is small, product-focused, and highly collaborative. You will work closely with perception, prediction, and mapping teams to ensure the planner receives the necessary upstream signals in an optimal format, while delivering high-performance modern C++ that operates reliably on compute-constrained vehicle platforms.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design &amp; Feature Architecture: Frame ambiguous vehicle behaviors and design new features or targeted behavior improvements (e.g., addressing late-braking behavior during merges in dense traffic, or architecting a robust shoulder pull-over pipeline).</li> <li>Onboard Implementation &amp; Testing: Write, integrate, and optimize clean modern C++ on the vehicle stack, validating behavior through rigorous simulation, log replays, and unit testing.</li> <li>On-Vehicle Debugging &amp; Diagnostics: Investigate and debug complex edge cases observed during on-track and on-road testing (e.g., diagnosing driver disengagements caused by unintended brake stabs).</li> <li>Interface &amp; Systems Collaboration: Negotiate clean architectural interfaces with upstream perception, world fusion, and prediction teams, as well as downstream trajectory generation and evaluation modules.</li> <li>Verification &amp; Validation: Partner with systems and verification teams to ensure safety-critical validation criteria are met before deploying code to the autonomous fleet.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Strong C++ &amp; Python skills, particularly in resource-constrained environments</li> <li>Exceptional written and verbal communications skills</li> <li>Experience developing code for real-world robotics/semi-autonomous platforms</li> <li>An eagerness to work across the decision making stack, even on components that may not perfectly align with past experience</li> </ul> <p><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">#LI-AW1</span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We believe that diverse teams produce the best ideas and outcomes. We are committed to building a culture of inclusion, entrepreneurship, and innovation across gender, race, age, sexual orientation, religion, disability, and identity.</em></p> <p><em><strong>Check out our <a href="https://stackav.com/join/policy">Privacy Policy</a>.</strong></em></p> <p><strong>Please Note:</strong> Pursuant to its business activities and use of technology, Stack AV complies with all applicable U.S. national security laws, regulations, and administrative requirements, which can restrict Stack AV’s ability to employ certain persons in certain positions pursuant to a range of national security-related requirements. As such, this position may be contingent upon Stack AV verifying a candidate’s residence, U.S. person status, and/or citizenship status. This position may also involve working with software and technologies subject to U.S. export control regulations. Under these regulations, it may be necessary for Stack AV to obtain a U.S. government export license prior to releasing its technologies to certain persons. If Stack AV determines that a candidate’s residence, U.S. person status, and/or citizenship status will require a license, prohibit the candidate from working in this position, or otherwise be subject to national security-related restrictions, Stack AV expressly reserves the right to either consider the candidate for a different position that is not subject to such restrictions, on whatever terms and conditions Stack AV shall establish in its sole discretion, or, in the alternative, decline to move forward with the candidate’s application.</p></div>

jobs.description: About Amplify Amplify helps teachers bring delight and rigor to students every day. We have become a leader in K–12 literacy, biliteracy, math, and science by building inspiring teaching and learning experiences based on research. The Amplify Classroom platform combines curriculum, assessment, and supplemental learning into one coherent high-quality instructional system. A pioneer in education since 2000, Amplify has developed deep relationships in states and districts by partnering with educators to drive implementation quality and improved outcomes. Today, Amplify serves more than 18 million students and teachers across all 50 states and on six continents. For more information, visit Amplify.com http://amplify.com. Job Description Summary Amplify is where engineers build software that lands in real classrooms with real students and teachers, every day. What we build has to work reliably at scale, in schools with inconsistent connectivity, for users who don’t have time for things to break. We’re looking for a Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer who’s pragmatic about how software gets built, cares about the people who use it, and is comfortable operating across the stack. You’ll write and review both code and tests, own what you ship in production, and help the engineers around you get better. We expect you’ll use AI thoughtfully and pragmatically, knowing where it can help you be more productive and that it will never replace your own good judgment. Note: "We are considering candidates for both the Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer level and the Staff Full-Stack Software Engineer level. You’ll be considered for the level that best aligns with your relevant experience, qualifications, and interview performance." Essential Responsibilities - Writing, testing, and shipping code. You’ll work across the stack, primarily in React and TypeScript on the front end, with Node.js and AWS underneath. What you build will be used in real classrooms every day, so you care about getting it right, not just getting it done. - Owning what you ship. You’re responsible for the code you put into production, including monitoring, debugging, and incident response. You understand that blamelessness and responsibility are part of the same spectrum of ownership. - Improving the codebase. You bring a sharp eye for clarity, maintainability, and pragmatic tradeoffs. You catch the things that will cause problems down the line, and you’re proud of how much code you refactor and delete. - Helping the engineers around you to get better. Whether through code review, pairing, or mentorship, you raise the team's level, not just the codebase. You’re generous with what you know and direct about what you see. - Building with AI. AI is changing how software gets developed, and you’re actively engaged with that shift. You use these tools to work with more confidence, not to replace your own knowledge and judgment. - Collaborating across disciplines. You work with product managers, designers, and education experts to turn complex requirements into software that makes sense to the people who use it. You push back when a requirement doesn’t hold up technically, and you listen when someone who’s been in a classroom tells you your design doesn’t work there. Required Qualifications - Education & Experience: BS/MS in Computer Science or equivalent degree or training, with 5+ years of professional full-stack software development experience. - Software Design & Engineering Practices: Strong understanding of good software design principles and modern engineering practices, with experience working in complex systems and large codebases. - Frontend Development: 5+ years of hands-on experience with modern frontend frameworks, including React, to build production-grade user experiences. - Backend & Systems: 5+ years of hands-on experience with modern backend web technologies, including Node.js, and the ability to reason about scalable, maintainable service design. - Communication & Collaboration: Ability to articulate technical concepts clearly, verbally and in writing, and to thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment through self-driven learning. - Mission Alignment: A genuine passion for education products and a commitment to building tools that are more equitable and accessible for all learners. Preferred Qualifications - Data Stores: Experience with modern data stores such as PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, Mongo, and Snowflake. - Cloud Infrastructure: Hands-on experience managing cloud-based infrastructure using tools like Serverless, Datadog, Terraform, and Docker. - Testing: Proficiency in automated testing techniques using frameworks like Jest and WebdriverIO. - Languages and Frameworks: Experience with Java - Ed-Tech Experience: Prior experience in education or ed-tech environments. Don't let a missing qualification stop you from applying. We hire for potential and curiosity as much as experience. If this role sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you. Amplify is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Amplify makes employment decisions based on qualifications and merit, and does not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability status, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic or status. Amplify is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities, including disabled veterans. If you have a disability and need an accommodation in connection with the application or hiring process, please email hiringaccommodations@amplify.com. If you are selected for employment, a background check will be required. As required by state and local laws and district policies, you may be required to provide additional documentation, such as proof of vaccination, or submit to enhanced background screening, such as fingerprinting. jobs.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. ABOUT THE ROLE We are looking for a Research Engineer to join the research team at ElevenLabs, focused on the data infrastructure that powers our frontier AI models. The quality of our models is bounded by the quality and scale of the data behind them, and you will own the systems that make world-class data possible. You will thrive in this role if you enjoy: - Building large-scale data pipelines for collecting, processing, filtering, and transforming datasets used to train state-of-the-art models. - Training models used in our data processing pipelines, such as classifiers, quality filters, and labeling models. - Designing data curation strategies such as deduplication, quality scoring, labeling, and augmentation that measurably improve model performance. - Creating tooling and infrastructure that lets researchers explore and train on massive datasets quickly and reliably. REQUIREMENTS We do not require any formal certifications or degrees. Instead, we are seeking enthusiastic engineers who can showcase solving impressively hard problems with artifacts such as past projects, designs, or GitHub contributions. Ideally, you bring: - Experience building data-intensive systems, ideally in support of machine learning training pipelines. - Strong engineering skills in distributed data processing at scale (e.g., Kubernetes, or custom pipelines over large datasets). - The capacity to autonomously evaluate how data quality, composition, and curation affect model outcomes, and to build the tooling to measure it. Bonus: Experience building or operating web crawlers. LOCATION This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, San Francisco, and Warsaw. #LI-Remote We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

WHAT YOU’LL DO HERE - Lead and grow a team within our Agentic Engineering organization. - Set technical direction across the agent harness, integrations, and workflows. - Stay close to the code and contribute to architecture and implementation decisions. - Evolve agent execution, tool use, context management, streaming, and long-running workflows. - Extend our provider-agnostic architecture as models and capabilities change. - Partner with Product and Design to turn agent capabilities into useful developer experiences. - Improve reliability, performance, and operability across agentic systems. - Coach engineers, raise the technical bar, and create clarity around priorities and tradeoffs. WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR - Experience managing and growing software engineering teams. - Strong hands-on engineering experience with Go. - Experience with React and TypeScript. - Hands-on experience building systems around LLMs and agentic workflows. - Experience with model APIs, tool calling, context management, or agent loops. - Strong distributed systems knowledge. - Working knowledge of AWS. - Strong technical judgment and comfort working through ambiguity. - A track record of helping engineers grow while maintaining a high execution bar. OUR TECH STACK - Backend: Go, Postgres - Frontend: TypeScript, React - Infrastructure: AWS, Kubernetes - Observability: Prometheus, Grafana - CI/CD: GitHub Actions BONUS TACOS IF YOU HAVE - (Tacos? Coder’s agentic architecture is provider-agnostic. The foundation is built; this team is focused on making it more capable, reliable, and extensible as the space evolves. ABOUT CODER Coder is the leading platform for AI development Infrastructure, enabling enterprises to securely run human and AI-driven development workflows in consistent, governed environments. Coder provides self-hosted, agent-ready workspaces that unify developer productivity and platform governance. With Coder, enterprises can confidently evolve from human-only development to AI-assisted and autonomous workflows, without sacrificing security, compliance, or performance. Learn more at coder.com http://coder.com. INTERVIEW PROCESS We believe that the interview process should be transparent, consistent, and enjoyable. We value your time and hope to complete the interview process in two to four weeks, if schedules allow. Through your interviews, you will meet a mix of individual contributors, managers, and senior leaders. AI USE DURING THE INTERVIEW PROCESS As an AI company, Coder embraces the use of AI tools, and we want to be transparent about our expectations as you navigate our interview process. Not permitted: Using AI assistance during conversational interviews. Permitted: Using AI tooling for take-home assessments. Please flag where and to what extent it was used in your take-home. Your submission will not be penalized for using AI as long as it is done honestly. OUR USE OF AI IN HIRING We use AI tools to help manage our recruitment process efficiently and fairly. This tool does not make hiring decisions; it helps our team prioritize which applications to review first. - Granola takes notes during our interview calls so our team can focus on the conversation with you. All hiring decisions are made by humans. Our team reviews applications, conducts interviews, and makes final selections. AI tools assist us but never replace human judgment, and these practices are conducted in compliance with applicable data protection, AI governance, and labor laws. Your data is not used to train AI models. jobs.description: ABOUT JUNIPER SQUARE Private markets are one of the largest, most complex, and most underserved corners of global finance. Our mission at Juniper Square is to unlock their full potential. We’re the Operations Partner trusted by 2,300+ GPs, unifying technology, data, and fund administration services into a single platform that helps GPs move faster, make better decisions, and scale with precision. With $300B+ under administration and 700,000+ LPs on platform, we’ve built the scale to match our ambition. And with JunieAI, our purpose-built AI platform, we’re reimagining how private markets operate, embedding intelligence across every workflow. Founder-led since 2014, backed by $350M+ in funding, and now 1,000+ employees strong, we’re building a company designed to shape the future of private markets for decades to come. Our culture is built for people who want to do ambitious, meaningful work alongside exceptionally talented teammates. We think like owners, move with urgency, and take pride in solving hard problems that truly matter to our customers and the future of private markets. We believe the best ideas come from open debate, deep collaboration, and diverse perspectives, which is why we believe transparency is the default and feedback makes us stronger. If you’re energized by high standards, rapid growth, and the opportunity to help define a category at a pivotal moment, come join us! Juniper Square offers employees a variety of ways to work, ranging from a fully remote experience to working full-time in one of our physical offices. We invest heavily in digital-first https://blog.junipersquare.com/juniper-square-ponders-future-of-office-with-digital-first-hybrid-workplace-strategy/ operations, allowing our teams to collaborate effectively across 27 U.S. states, 2 Canadian Provinces, India, Luxembourg, and England. We also have physical offices in San Francisco, New York City, Mumbai and Bangalore for employees who prefer to work in an office some or all of the time. ABOUT YOUR ROLE We are looking for an experienced and autonomous Senior Product Designer to join our team, embedded within a core product squad with broad scope across our platform. This is a high-impact individual contributor role where you will own the end-to-end user experience for your product area, drive meaningful contributions to our design system, and partner closely with product managers and engineers to ship work that makes a real difference for our customers. AI fluency is a baseline expectation. Designers at this level should be comfortable across the full range of modern design tools, including AI. That might mean starting in an LLM to frame a problem, building a quick prototype in Cursor or Claude Code to explore an interaction, or going to Figma to produce a polished developer reference. The expectation is sound judgment about what will get to the best outcome for the customer and the team. WHAT YOU'LL DO Own the Work End to End Produce work in whatever form best serves the team and engineering, whether that's annotated flows, coded prototypes, LLM-generated specs with design system context loaded, or Figma files when a polished developer reference is needed. When handing off to engineering, ensure files are complete, accurate, and consistent with our design system. The starting point matters less than the outcome: your output should reflect the kind of judgment and taste that distinguishes considered design from generated templates. Simplify Complexity Take on hard problems in your product domain and deliver solutions that feel simple. Our users work with sophisticated financial data and workflows. The complexity lives in the craft, not the interface. Design for AI-Driven Features Contribute to the UX of AI-powered capabilities across our product suite, including proactive recommendations, generative summaries, and predictive insights. Get the trust and transparency details right so these features feel reliable to enterprise customers, not like a black box. Generate and Apply Insights Conduct research and interpret product analytics to uncover real user needs and measure the impact of your designs. Talk directly with customers, run quick tests, and treat research as a velocity tool rather than a gate. Lead Cross-Functional Collaboration Partner with product managers, engineers, and stakeholders to align on strategy and ensure design execution serves both the business and the user. Own the design relationship with your product area end to end. Strengthen the Design System Continuously improve and expand our design system, advocating for consistency and pattern reuse across the product suite. Collaborate with peers on the design team to give and receive feedback, raising the collective craft of the organization. QUALIFICATIONS Required - 4+ years of professional experience as a Product Designer, with a meaningful portfolio of shipped work across the full development lifecycle. - Proven experience designing for a complex B2B or Enterprise SaaS product, ideally in a data-heavy domain. - Fluency with modern design and prototyping tools. Figma proficiency is expected, including experience with component libraries, auto-layout, and developer-ready handoff files. Comfort with AI-powered tools (LLMs, Cursor, Claude Code) is equally important, even if you are not writing production code. - Experience designing for AI/ML-driven features with strong attention to trust, explainability, and error states. - Demonstrated ability to operate autonomously and deliver high-quality work without requiring significant direction. - Strong communication skills, written, verbal, and visual, with the ability to clearly articulate design decisions to engineers, PMs, and executives alike. - A portfolio that showcases deep UX thinking, clear user journeys, and a high degree of visual polish. Preferred - Experience contributing to or maintaining a multi-platform design system, including pattern documentation and component creation. - Background in Financial Services, Investment Management, Real Estate, or adjacent industries. - A track record of designing complex tables, filters, and data visualization tools. - Experience planning and running customer interviews or usability tests. - Based in the SF Bay Area to facilitate in-person collaboration with local teams. COMPENSATION Compensation for this position includes a base salary, equity, and a variety of benefits. The U.S. base salary range for this role is $148,000 to $185,000 USD. Actual base salaries will be based on candidate-specific factors, including seniority, skillset, location, and local minimum pay requirements as applicable. Your recruiter can provide further details. Benefits include: - Health, dental, and vision care for you and your family - Life insurance - Mental wellness coverage - Fertility and growing family support - Flex Time Off in addition to company paid holidays - Paid family leave, medical leave, and bereavement leave policies - Retirement saving plans - Allowance to customize your work and technology setup at home - Annual professional development stipend Your recruiter can provide additional details about compensation and benefits. #LI-LH1

jobs.position: Infrastructure Systems Engineer – Linux, Storage & Automation
jobs.description: Cerebras Systems builds the world's largest AI chip, 56 times larger than GPUs. This architecture allows Cerebras to deliver industry-leading training and inference speeds; over 10 times faster than GPU-based hyperscale cloud inference services. This order of magnitude increase in speed is transforming the user experience of AI applications, unlocking real-time iteration and increasing intelligence via additional agentic computation. Cerebras works with the leading model labs, global enterprises, and cutting-edge AI-native startups. OpenAI recently announced a multi-year partnership https://openai.com/index/cerebras-partnership/ with Cerebras, to deploy 750 megawatts of scale, transforming key workloads with ultra high-speed inference. THE ROLE We are looking for a hands-on engineer to deploy, automate, troubleshoot, and maintain Linux-based compute and data storage infrastructure. The ideal candidate combines strong Linux fundamentals with Python, Ansible, shell scripting, virtualization, and storage experience. They enjoy investigating complex problems, identifying root causes, and building automation that improves reliability and reduces manual work. RESPONSIBILITIES - Deploy, configure, and maintain Linux servers across physical and virtual environments. - Deploy and support data storage systems, including block, file, and object storage. - Configure and troubleshoot storage connectivity, volumes, filesystems, permissions, and access from Linux hosts and virtual machines. - Monitor storage capacity, performance, and availability; investigate latency, throughput, and connectivity issues. - Develop Python and Bash scripts to automate provisioning, configuration, validation, and routine operational tasks. - Build and maintain Ansible playbooks and roles for consistent, repeatable infrastructure deployments. - Troubleshoot issues across operating systems, applications, networking, storage, and virtualization platforms. - Investigate logs, analyze system behavior, and resolve performance, availability, and configuration problems. - Manage virtual machines and troubleshoot hypervisor, virtual networking, and storage integration issues. - Support server provisioning, operating system installation, patching, upgrades, and configuration management. - Support data protection and recovery through snapshots, replication, backups, and restore validation. - Implement monitoring, health checks, and alerts to identify problems early. - Collaborate with engineering, networking, storage vendors, and data center operations teams to deploy and support infrastructure. - Document configurations, troubleshooting procedures, and operational runbooks. QUALIFICATIONS - Strong hands-on experience administering and troubleshooting Linux systems. - Proficiency in Python and shell scripting, particularly Bash. - Practical experience with Ansible for automation and configuration management. - Experience with virtualization platforms such as KVM, VMware, or Proxmox. - Hands-on experience administering enterprise or distributed storage systems. - Working knowledge of block, file, and object storage concepts, with practical experience in protocols such as NFS, SMB, iSCSI, or S3. - Familiarity with Linux storage management, including disk configuration, RAID, LVM, filesystems, and mount management. - Ability to troubleshoot storage performance using metrics such as IOPS, throughput, and latency. - Strong debugging skills and a methodical approach to root cause analysis. - Working knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing, VLANs, and network troubleshooting. - Familiarity with Linux services, permissions, processes, package management, and system logs. - Experience using Git for version control and collaborative development. - Ability to own technical problems through resolution and communicate findings clearly. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS - Experience with storage platforms such as VAST Data, NetApp, Dell PowerScale, Pure Storage, or Ceph. - Familiarity with high-performance storage networking, including RDMA, RoCE, or InfiniBand. - Experience with bare-metal provisioning, PXE boot, Kickstart, or cloud-init. - Familiarity with server management interfaces such as BMC, IPMI, or Redfish. - Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or other container technologies. - Familiarity with infrastructure monitoring and centralized logging tools. - Experience supporting data center, AI/ML, or high-performance computing environments. - Experience planning storage capacity, expanding storage systems, and supporting data migrations. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE Reliable compute and storage infrastructure, repeatable automation, faster problem resolution, effective capacity planning, and clear documentation that enables the team to operate and scale efficiently. Why Join Cerebras People who are serious about software make their own hardware. At Cerebras, we have built a breakthrough architecture that is unlocking new opportunities for the AI industry. With dozens of model releases and rapid growth, we’ve reached an inflection point in our business. Members of our team tell us there are five main reasons they joined Cerebras: 1. Build a breakthrough AI platform beyond the constraints of the GPU. 2. Publish and open source their cutting-edge AI research. 3. Work on one of the fastest AI supercomputers in the world. 4. Enjoy job stability with startup vitality. 5. Our simple, non-corporate work culture that respects individual beliefs. Find out more about what it's like to work at Cerebras here https://www.cerebras.ai/join-us! Apply today and become part of the forefront of groundbreaking advancements in AI! Cerebras Systems is committed to creating an equal and diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate different backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We believe inclusive teams build better products and companies. We try every day to build a work environment that empowers people to do their best work through continuous learning, growth and support of those around them. jobs.description: ABOUT DOCKER Docker is the platform at the center of how intelligent software gets built. For more than a decade, Docker has helped millions of developers and thousands of organizations build, ship, and run software consistently across any environment. Today, Docker extends that same trust to the AI era. Docker Hardened Images https://www.docker.com/resources/containers-are-the-new-supply-chain-attack-vector-on-demand-webinar/?at_exp=DO112.B0 form the foundation agentic code is built on, local and cloud Docker Sandboxes https://www.docker.com/products/docker-sandboxes/?at_exp=DO112.B0 isolate where agents run, and Docker AI Governance https://www.docker.com/products/ai-governance/?at_exp=DO112.B0 sets enterprise-wide policy. Together, they give builders and organizations the confidence to adopt any model, tool, or agent without compromising security, governance, or control. _______________________________________________________________________ THE ROLE Docker AI Gateway is our answer to the complexity of taking AI agents from prototype to production. It’s a powerful, intelligent, and secure control point that eliminates the toil of model orchestration, tool management, observability, and governance - so developers can focus on building incredible AI agents, not gluing together infrastructure. The Gateway sits at the center of modern AI applications, offering: - A model and tool routing layer with built-in security and cost optimization - A familiar OpenAI-compatible interface and MCP server - Unified observability and policy enforcement - Auto-RAG, tool injection, session summarization, and more We’re just getting started and we need exceptional engineers to help us build the backbone of the future of agent-based development. _______________________________________________________________________ WHAT YOU’LL DO - Set technical direction for core systems powering the AI Gateway 0 the model router, MCP gateway, and control plane - and make sure architectural decisions hold up as usage scales by 10x - Consistently identify gaps in our infrastructure, process, or tooling before they become blockers, and drive the fix from idea to production - Take a significant, hands-on role in defining, delivering, and implementing the Gateway's technical strategy, in close partnership with engineering leadership - Own the hardest, highest-ambiguity problems in the system: dynamic model selection, auto-failover, cost-based routing, and policy enforcement that has to work end-to-end - Act as the go-to expert for secure credential storage, session summarization, caching, and rate limiting - the capabilities everything else depends on - Build the infrastructure that lets us, and our customers, evaluate, replay, and backtest agent and LLM behavior with confidence - Mentor senior and mid-level engineers, and raise the technical bar for the team through code, design review, and example - Partner with product, design, and leadership to shape not just what the control plane UI does, but where the product goes next KEY PROBLEMS YOU’LL HELP SOLVE - Define the unified abstraction layer across diverse model and tool providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, AWS Bedrock) that the rest of the org builds on - Architect secure, scalable identity and credential vaulting for tool and model access, trusted enough to run at enterprise scale - Build the infrastructure for real-time and historical analytics of AI agent behavior that leadership and customers both rely on - Guarantee that policy enforcement and logging work end-to-end - from prompt to tool to response - with no gaps an auditor (or attacker) could find - Set the bar for developer experience through intuitive APIs and first-class observability - Take part in on-call rotation for your team, respond to incidents, debug production issues, and drive continuous improvement of system reliability _______________________________________________________________________ WHO YOU ARE Required Qualifications - 8+ years of backend engineering experience, with a track record of owning production-grade systems at significant scale - Deep specialization in distributed systems, cloud-native infrastructure, and API design - recognized by peers and cross-functional partners as a go-to expert, not just experienced - Experience building secure, high-throughput services (gateways, proxies, load balancers, policy engines), and a history of making judgment calls other engineers rely on - Fluency in Go and/or Rust - A track record of identifying systemic gaps - in architecture, process, or tooling-— and driving the fix across team boundaries, not just within your own - A strong product mindset, with real experience shaping technical direction rather than only executing against it - Comfortable operating with wide latitude: given a problem and significant autonomy in how to solve it, including when and who to pull in - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience BONUS QUALIFICATIONS - Prior experience with OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar LLM APIs - Familiarity with RAG architectures, vector databases, or agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain, AutoGPT, CrewAI) - Experience with policy engines (e.g., OPA), observability frameworks (e.g., OpenTelemetry), or API gateways - Understanding of OAuth 2.1, secret management, and cloud IAM systems - Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and microservices architecture - A track record of setting technical standards that other teams or engineers went on to adopt _______________________________________________________________________ WHY JOIN US? - Work on what’s next: The agent era is just beginning. Help define the infrastructure stack for the next generation of software. - Own mission-critical infrastructure: Be part of a small team building the backbone of secure, intelligent agent applications. - Impact at scale: Your work will touch tens of thousands of developers building AI-first applications. - Engineering excellence: Join a world-class engineering team that values simplicity, code quality, and deep technical thinking. - Remote-first culture: Work from anywhere with a team that trusts and empowers you.
